reviews.text: For a Casino, Resort, Entertainment Center - with 11 resturants off the strip, I wasn't sure what to expect. However, the rooms are large, the staff is friendly, the meals in every resturant are affordable (find out about the 7 dollar steak deal) and they have something for everyone. Rodeos, Bowling Tournaments, Singing, Dancing, we had a blast. And I was there for business! My husband was with me during the stay and we want to return this fall. They are minutes away from everything else Vegas as to offer.

reviews.title: Great stay in Vegas!
reviews.text: I'd come back here again!! The rooms were spacious and clean with a comfy bed. The service was impeccable and friendly!!! Awesome change of pace from the strip but conveniently located to get anywhere you wanted to go. The 11 options for restaurants satisfied any craving I had.

reviews.title: Must Go
reviews.text: My go to hotel casino.  Always clean and happening!!!  Best black Jack options and slots pay.  Must go if you have under 21 as there is large theatre and game area.  The pool is also huge and amazing. Lots of food options and reasonable prices.Stuff they’re always friendly and welcoming.

reviews.title: I wish it were better.
reviews.text: I stayed at the South Point hotel due to a work conference that was held there. While the rooms are spacious, the walls are thinner than a cheap apartment. I could hear my neighbor moving their chair and a ton of doors slamming at all hours of the night. Even with the comfortable bed, don't plan on a good night sleep. The casino does smell like smoke, although it isn't the worst one compared to the ones on the strip. The drinks at the bar are very reasonably priced, but if you plan on eating at any of the popular restaurants or getting ice cream during peak times, be prepared to wait in line. The staff was friendly and helpful- But you have to ask. I stayed for 8 days and the only time they came to bring new towels, bring toilet-paper, or empty the garbage was when I called and asked.

reviews.title: Great place to play and stay.
reviews.text: Very comfortable room. This is a locals casino and they offer great value. Check in staff was quick and friendly. Lots of places to eat from cheap to high end steakhouse. Lines for the buffet are long but evidently worth the wait. Lots of stuff to do.

reviews.title: This place has plummeted downhill from what the great fun place it used to be
reviews.text: We have stayed at South Point several times— used to be a decent mid-level hotel— but too many children screaming, running down halls, but never again after the last time of having NO sleep with a couple fighting all night and a baby crying  next (I’d cry too with parents like that.)  And something going on in the hallway (?)  it did not feel safe.  There is no one checking for room keys at the elevators so anyone could be in there!  We never booked a room there again— why take a risk when there are so many other places to stay.       But we usually do visit the casino frequently and have always had fun playing at South Point. Until this time.      After this last trip, we will not be back.  Hotel OR casino.  Ever.  (Even though we won!).     I won’t go into detail, but i will just say that the behavior of a casino dealer was just over the top too much. Disrespectful, OFFENSIVE, threatening, and unacceptable at any level.  Regardless of age, gender, or race.       I am sure it was not reported to anyone and would be overlooked by management.      What was once a must-visit casino stop is now a parking lot and stack of bricks to us.      Done.

reviews.title: Stay here for your business travel needs and conventions
reviews.text: I have stayed at this hotel two years in a row for my companies international travel convention. I have yet to be disappointed. The food at the restaurants is high quality and there is a wide variety of foods to choose from: American, Asian, Mexican, Dessert, Oyster Bar, and several bars/lounges. I highly recommend finding the ice cream/smoothie shop and the little hot dog stand.The rooms are quite spacious and come with a bathroom that looks nice and was very clean. The beds are very comfortable in comparison to most hotels I have stayed in making it easy to fall asleep and get a good night's rest. I also ordered room service which was cooked and delivered in under 30 minutes and again was good quality. Since this hotel is off the strip, there was concern the first time I stayed here that taxis or Ubers would be a longer wait but it is only 15-18 minutes from the strip and an Uber/Lyft arrived within 5 mins consistently. The hotel is so large that their truly is so much to do. There is a spa, pool, bars, casino, restaurants, gift shop, and even the largest horse/equine arena in the United States.The bell desk as well as the airport shuttle both were efficient with friendly and accommodating staff. Check in and check out was very smooth and the staff I interacted with was personable and very welcoming. The only complaint I have is that housekeeping opened my door without knocking first and did not announce themselves walking into the room. However it is partially my fault because I did not have the Do Not Disturb sign on the outside of the door.In regards to the convention halls, they get very cold so be prepared for that. However besides that, everything was clean and well organized with the staff and they were all very friendly. During meals in the convention halls, staff were timely and provided excellent service.Overall an awesome experience and am happy to stay here again.

reviews.title: Lackluster stay
reviews.text: Stopped being customer friendly, they used to have shuttle service to the Vegas strip they Stopped that so now ro stay there you really need a car. Next year I don't know if I will stay there. Rooms were ok but if not for bowling rate would have been overpriced

reviews.title: GET To THE POINT!
reviews.text: Okay where do I start.. This place is just FUN!The second you step inside it’s Candy to your eyes and ears!!! You walk into the casino and the bars and the Starbucks and restaurants and music!  I like the demographic… you have the older crowd activities ( like bowling leagues and equestrian shows) but also the younger groups have stuff to do there as well. There’s the bowling alley and a huge movie theaters that stays open late. The pools are gorgeous and they have an amazing fully equipped gym right across from the spa center.  South point has Shake Shack and Starbucks on  premises, along with a really nice Buffet, diner and other restaurants right there.,  I’ve checked them out. There are restaurants Mcdonalds and Dennys, and Japanese restaurant across the street. The ice cream parlor and Krispy Kreme is also on the premisesThe only thing I would say that was negative duringmy stay is sometimes you get a slight smell of cigarettes from the vents in the room.  If you have a Smoker next door. Also, played around those slots in April and May and noticed that not only was I NOT winning.. Those machines take your money back SUPER FAST.Listen Southpoint, you gotta give a little to get a lot.I’m headed back for business next week, and will be staying at “the Point “again.. I’ll post  on my experience there in July.

reviews.title: Yummy!!
reviews.text: Great food, friendly service, nice atmosphere!! Pricing not too bad. Food was truly yummy. Prime rib and mashed potatoes were excellent!! Wide varity of foods. Choice of all cultures. Desserts to die for. The keylime cheesecake rounds..AMAZING!!

reviews.title: Large and nice
reviews.text: We stopped in South Point for a short while on our way to Mesquite.   It is a large, very clean casino.  It was morning, so it wasn't too crowded.  They have a big, very good sports book.  Next time, we will stay there and check out their rooms.

reviews.title: Staff was friendly and helpful
reviews.text: The Resort was clean and the staff was very friendly and helpful. We were there because I was bowling in a tournament and were pleased with our stay. We were happy with the restaurants to choose from on premises and were thrilled there is a Starbucks!

reviews.title: We would stay her again .
reviews.text: We have stayed here several times . Check in was easy, and free parking in large lots.  Close to airport, and has shuttle to the airport, but no shuttle to the Strip.   It is a larger motel/casino  so does take some time to find check-in desk, and then elevators to your room. Lots  of nice places to eat inside, along with movie theaters and bowling and casino games . 10 minutes to car rental and airport, easy and quick to drive yourself.  Excellent value for the price and room. There is a  small resort fee.

reviews.title: Bowling tournament stay
reviews.text: We stayed here because of the convenience for the bowling tournaments. They room is very spacious, clean, and comfortable.The buffet, cafe, and Steak ‘n Shake were all very good places to eat. Gaming was pretty decent before the weekend, slots were spotty on the weekend. Nice variety of slots and table games

reviews.title: It is all about the staff
reviews.text: I wanted to say THANK YOU to the hotel front desk staff ! My daughter is staying at the hotel for the PCCHA REYZIN THE CASH DERBY. She needed assistance with room rates and access to the barn area. The women at the front desk was super helpful and kind to her. In this environment today it is all about the people.

reviews.title: Local favorite
reviews.text: Overall experience was very good. Staff were very kind and attentive. Special mention to ladies working at club desk and at showroom. We came for Sheena Easton's performances at showroom. It was well worth of travelling 6000 miles from Finland too see such a world class talent, vocalist and pop legend like Ms. Easton. We felt well taken care of during our 8 night stay. Hotel is super clean and has very good security. I highly recommend if you want to stay away from the Strip.

reviews.title: the best off strip Casino/Hotel ( also still with the Garden Buffet each day)
reviews.text: The Hotel/Casino is of course on the Las Vegas Boulevard but don’t let the distance to the Strip fool you: it is 15-20 minutes by car but for is that is not a problem.Very nice hotel, good rooms , most of them with fridge , clean bathroom and reasonable pool area, nothing special.Casino with lot of buzz, always busy, wide variaty of slots , old and new. Foodies will be pleased with more than enough different restaurants AND still the Garden Buffet for breakfast, bruch and dinner .And don’t forget the Arena with lots of ( horse-) events, always free of charge.For is the Orleans hotel/casino was the best off strip stay fot the past 15 years but we switched to South Point this hear.

reviews.title: Initial Encounter to Southpoint
reviews.text: AMBIENCE:  Large crowds with several venues for everyone.   RESTAURANTS:  Large selection with acclaimed buffet.  Steak N Shake and 24 hour Starbucks as well.GAMING:  Plenty of slots, tables and video keno machines to choose from.ROOMS:  Nice, clean and well-appointed.   Keurig coffee makers, safe, and refrigerator in rooms.LOCATION:  South Strip, away from the madness.SERVICE:  Overall, friendly and accommodating staff.OVERALL:  BEST choice for location NOW.  Casino is tight and Payouts rare.  However, only my 2nd visit.  To be continued...

reviews.title: Great rooms but slots are out dated
reviews.text: If you like slots, this is NOT your casino.  The worst selection…. I even asked to see if I was missing something.  Nope.  And even though I didn’t like them, I still through my money at them…. Bad choice for day one.  But it’ll save me the next two nights, because I won’t be gambling unless I can grab a seat at Pai -gow.  1*I’ve dined at Michael’s-  expensive and top notch-  my group won’t spend that kind of money- so won’t be enjoying that. 5*Rooms are fabulous!  A little warm for me, although I dropped the temp, they must have it on auto as I woke up and room is hot again.  But one of the nicest rooms-  lots of room (I have a king single- normally I’ll get double queens just to have the extra room…not necessary). and a great bathroom!  5*Bell desk is adamant that they won’t drag our bowling balls up to the lanes-  if I’m willing to give them $20, they should be.  They’ll drag them to my rooms, so I see no difference- 3*Still here…. Maybe dinner will be wonderful…. But, I’d I’m not going ti Michael’s, I doubt it.

reviews.title: Good Casino
reviews.text: South Point is a good local casino.  They have an enormous amount of slot machines and a very good staff.  This was my first visit, so I signed up for a players card.  They have nothing for new players, which is rare.  Overall, this was a good experience.

reviews.title: Business laced with fun.
reviews.text: Hotel is like a city made of restaurants and entertainment. Plenty of room to roam. The room was beautiful and cleaned by housekeeping each day.  The convention I attended was in a vast area with several meeting rooms. Lunch was served on this floor as well. No complaints about the food and the service. One negative note, my view from the 7th floor was a brick wall.. Very disappointing. Also, I have a suggestion for management - Please look in the bathroom on the wall between the shower and the toilet; it is a perfect place to put a hook to hang the bath towel.

reviews.title: You can’t beat south point casino.
reviews.text: south point casino is really becoming my go to place. it gets better with every visit, I love the bowling alley, since I’m on a league. I enjoy the Cinemark movie theater. I go almost every Friday and I love don Vito’s. great Italian food. the slots are very fun. I only play a few selected games. the sports book is my place to watch football. yes it’s off the strip, but not far away. rent a car or shuttle. Strip buses are great also. south point casino is my place to have fun. You don’t really need to leave. great staff as well. young people come here as well. south point arena a big plus in my book,

reviews.title: Security needs training to keep players playing instead of being 5'2 tough guys
reviews.text: Vegas local from across the city. I like playing South point because I usually do pretty well there and if I lose I don't mind losing it to southpoint. Plus it was my birthday.  I play in the middle of the night when it's less crowded. Every once in a while I'll go out and lay in my truck get a power nap and come back and play again so I don't have to drive 40 minutes back across the city. Last night security treated me like a homeless thug as I took a little power nap in my truck. They beat on my windows with what sounded like a nightstick and started yelling at me like a little man, tough guy, power trip that I couldn't sleep there. All they had to do was ask what I was doing but they wanted to be wanna be cops. I didn't argue with them, started up my truck and drove home. I will never Gamble at southpoint ever again nor will I ever spend my money on the movies or building or a show which I frequently do. I am a grain of sand to them put a grain has a dollar sign to it that they have lost mine.

reviews.title: Business trip
reviews.text: The hotel is affordable and nice. Lots of good food options and very clean. While I was there several conventions and events were taking place including the National Bowling Association and the Nevada High School Rodeo Finals. I never felt crowded and with the variety of restaurants lines but no long waits

reviews.title: Comfortable, quiet room.
reviews.text: Nice place to stay. Comfortable, quiet rooms for a good price.Excellent food in the cafe for a good price. Free parking garage or valet parking if you want it. We have stayed here a few time and enjoyed it every time.

reviews.title: Out of the way but  convenient this trip.
reviews.text: Good news is that Don Vito’s was excellent. Good, service and price. The Oyster bar was also very good in both price and service. The only complaint here is pass on the crab cakes. Too much filler. Get the crab cocktail instead. Room service was much too expensive. Going to the Cafe, open 24 hrs was inexpensive and all around wonderful.Our Jr suite was large and fairly priced. It got that way by furnishing the cheapest toilet paper money can buy and annoyingly no water in the room. You had to buy bottles even with this suite. The super duper shave and haircut was  a big disappointment. Besides nothing special it was impossible to get the guy to shut up about all his fabulous reviews etc. Not warranted in my opinion for $90.00 not counting tip. Overall, everyone was friendly throughout. Finally, make sure you make reservations, even during the week. I didn’t think I’d have too and didn’t. Consequently, we didn’t try the other restaurants.

reviews.title: Decent hotel off strip
reviews.text: This hotel was good for the price point. Off the strip (about 20 minute drive to the Strip). Valet was amazing. Free (besides rip, obviously). Rooms were decent but still some cleanliness issues (hair in shower). Restaurants close early which is a bummer. The one 24 hour was very limited because they moved locations to another restaurant at a certain time. Chose this hotel for its pool yet the pool was closed due to windy weather. The next day, they re-opened it but instead of the sunny side, it was just the shady side. Pool isn’t heated so that made zero sense.

reviews.title: Wonderful anniversary trip
reviews.text: Went for anniversary trip. Thoroughly enjoyed our three days there, room was comfortable to be in as well as the beds, slept good. Played slots and table games, I didn't  win much but spouse was consistently winning and kept us in the money. Ate at a variety of restaurants, they were all good, no complaints. The Primarily Prime Rib was the winner of all of them we tried, fantastic dinner and service. There is an abundance of things to do at this casino, stayed busy and entertained the whole time. Would recommend to anyone. Looking forward to going back in July for big bingo tournament.

reviews.title: Overall a pretty decent stay
reviews.text: The hotel rooms are adequate and pretty nice for the cost really. The beds are super comfy as are the pillows. The room is very clean and the hotel offer nice shampoo/conditioner/soaps foe the room.there is a safe as well. Now for the cons. The hotel was repairing 2 of the 6 elevators wh8ch you would think would be an issue but it really was .it took more than 20 min to get up or down. Additionally the didn't staff appropriately for Easter weekend so half of the pool was closed as well.after speaking with the management they basically said sorry stuff happens. No offers of any compensation were given . Lastly the restaurants we went to (buffet) was pretty decent as well. No complaints for the food.the hotel gift shop had a great selection. As well. Overall I would recommend but the small inconveniences bugs a little.noy enough to not stay again or give a good review .

reviews.title: Good value but not a 4 star experience
reviews.text: The best way to describe this hotel is that it is a good value, and it is ideal if you are looking for a place south of the main strip in order to visit Joshua Tree or the Grand Canyon the next day.  There were many things we liked such as the ample free parking and larger rooms that were decently appointed.  However, in typical Vegas fashion, you must cross through the casino (where smoking, vaping, etc is allowed) to get to the elevators. This is but the most pleasant thing for those who don't smoke or have kids, but I know there are many that do this.Yet, my biggest complaint would be that this is about as far from a 4 star experience as I have had at a hotel. While I have since learned that 4 star and 5 star ratings are more about the amenities and size of a hotel in Vegas, the lack of service was remarkable. While nothing was unpleasant, we had a marginally engaged reception worker and then just a vague point towards the escalators as my travel wearied family drug our bags through the smoky and outdated casino area. Nothing about it said...I am glad you are here.Yet, I must admit as I started, that it is still a good value based upon the price. I might stay here again for one night, but I would not stay much longer.

reviews.title: Missing amenities!
reviews.text: Beauty property. Rooms are spacious. Pool advertised as heated. The pool is not heated. No microwave or laundry facilities for guests to do their own laundry. Several restaurants to choose from. Slots are very tight though advertised as "loose".

reviews.title: One of My Best Casino Stays
reviews.text: I loved my spacious room. The view was spectacular. The room temperature was easy to regulate. Having a large number of dinning choices decreased my concerns, related to my food allergies.  The variety of gaming option made for a totally fun experience. I loved their BINGO. there was excellent all-around services and courteous staff.

reviews.title: Great property!
reviews.text: Excellent stay! This was our 2nd stay at South Point. The first time was because our flight was cancelled, and our airline put us up for a few days. Our 2nd stay was even better! Our room was immaculate. I have never stayed in such a clean room! This was our 13th trip to Vegas and we travel all over the U.S.  so I know what I am talking about. They have 11 restaurants on site, a bowling alley, movie theatre, and bingo! You don't have to leave the property at all, there is plenty to keep you busy. All of the staff we encountered were awesome. I really appreciate all of the security on the casino floor. I felt very safe late at night gambling after my husband went to bed. Their sportsbook is great, very comfortable chairs. They have a great deli and a Starbucks near the sportsbook for quick snacks and drinks. We plan to come back soon. We are gold with MGM and get comped rooms, but we loved this property so much, we will come back and pay for our rooms.

reviews.title: Huge hotel lots to do
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel and so much to do that you don’t really need to leave. So many restaurants, reasonable prices on everything. Only downside is the walls are thing and we spent a couple nights listening to the neighbor next store coughing and blowing his nose. I do wish they did have more gift shops besides the one. But, other than that I would stay back here again. Oh and for all the coke drinks steak and shake has it which is a huge blessing in Pepsi town

reviews.title: Good gambling and food options.
reviews.text: Lots of gambling and several restaurants in different price ranges. Asian, burgers, buffet, cafe etc. Helpful staff too! Very clean and well maintained facility. Steak n Shake has tasty burgers at reasonable prices. The Garden buffet was really good too with a large selection of different foods and free mimosas at lunch!

reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text: Attended the special bingo event and stayed 3/12 - 3/15/2023.  Have always enjoyed the casino and really like the multiple options of things to do.  Unfortunately, there were many areas that could use improvement.  Never saw anyone clean/wipe down machines.  Hand sanitizer dispensers were empty or not functioning in many places.  The bathrooms were not as clean as they have been in the past with numerous bathrooms smelling like weed.  I know that gambling is at your own risk, but this casino always seems to have very tight machines and this stay was no different.  Can count on one hand how many times I got into a bonus or needed to use a machine to cash out a ticket.  The bingo event was held in the exhibition halls.  The employees selling were wonderful and very patient. The bathrooms were filthy.  The smoking directly outside the doors was horrible!  There is a sign that says no smoking, but apparently that was only on the other side of the sign placement closer to the arena. It makes no sense.  It was ridiculous and annoying.  There needs to be a better exit strategy for after the sessions are over.  Is there only one elevator available for people to use?  Is there another stairwell or escalator that people can use? If there is, can there be better signage and instructions on where to access these?  The situation with the elevators to get back to our hotel room was absolutely ridiculous. The long lines and security personnel just yelling at everybody seemed a little over the top. It was extremely busy during our stay, but that is to be expected with big events going on.

reviews.title: Local treasure
reviews.text: I have started staying at this hotel due to a group who has a residency on site.  Have to say when priced right, this hotel is a gem.  Complimentary airport shuttle if needed, large and very comfortable rooms. Amenities including multiple restaurants that won't break the bank. Affordable gift shop for water etc.  Movie theater is great too.  Love the Keurigs in the room and having a mini refrigerator.  Room service at this hotel is still as room service is to be.  Most on the strip have it only packaged to go.   24 hour Cafe.  Some cafes in other hotels only open till 3:00 pm.  Staff is so friendly and welcoming.  Very popular hotel when Nascar, Rodeo, or Bingo come to town. Sells out often. Rates can go up .   Highly recommend this hotel.  For me, when I stay to see my favorite group, I have to stay put.  Ride share to/from the strip can get too costly for me and I am solo and don't have a car when on property.  But between the movie theater, bowling alley, etc there is plenty to do - or even just relaxing in the room.  Thank  you South Point.  My next visit might be June. Contemplating.  Might be spending a milestone birthday time frame with you.

reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.text: We had a suite on the 25th floor. It was fantastic view and was a huge room with a small kitchen and huge bedroom a big bathroom with a very large shower. The king size bed was very comfortable. The room was very clean and the hotel staff very nice.

reviews.title: This place is awesome!!!!!
reviews.text: We are locals and this is the BEST hotel and resort off the strip yet 5 min from all the glamor of Vegas!!The owner Mr. G is all about pricing and the old school affect!! Keep it inexpensive throughout the resort and they will come back!! The hotel has EVERYTHING  a couple to a family would want!!We just left the PBR/Tuff hedeman rodeo in their beautiful equestrian arena and wow!!, food unbelievable price! Drinks unbelievable price! What we paid for all food and drink there, would have been 1 beer at a strip arena and concert!!!Compd drinks thru out the bars on video poker!, restaurants top notch and high quality!! This is the ONLY RESORT that hasn't gotten greedy!!!Great job Southpoint!! U r a locals and visitors gem!! Please don't ever change!!!!

reviews.title: Fantastic Stay
reviews.text: My friend and I stayed here for 3 nights. The rooms are big and the amenities are really fun - bowling lanes are a great feature! We also played a few slot games and the coupon booklet helped us make our dinner choices more easily. It is a bit further from the strip, so we ultimately decided to get a rental car, but it was nice coming back to a quieter casino after long days on the strip.

reviews.title: Great Las Vegas Stay
reviews.text: We usually stay on the strip when visiting, however due to the timing of our trip we were in Vegas just before Superbowl. The rates at strip hotels were in my opinion unreasonable. We opted to stay at Southpoint. We had stayed cursed befire and enjoyed our stay. The rates are more than reasonable. Free parking. I use their Vaket parking and don’t mind tipping for the service. Bell luggage service the same way. Room was beautiful. You have a choice of 11 different dining options, as well as a multiplex theater and bowling alley. If you are into gambling they have slots and table games. It’s off the Strip, so if you are going downtown, you drive yiur car, cab or Uber . I’m 75 and find the ease of driving to Southpoint easier.I stayed Two days for less than one night at Ceasers.

reviews.title: Disappointing!
reviews.text: This was my first visit to South Point after many visits staying in various other Las Vegas hotels. The room was nicely appointed with two queen beds, a desk, table and two chairs, armchair with foot stool and side table.  Bathroom was divided with shower and toilet separated by a door from the vanity.  If my rating was based on the room alone, it would be much higher. However, the housekeeping was very hit and miss.  On check-in we were asked whether we wanted daily housekeeping and we confirmed that we did. In our 8 night stay we had housekeeping only 3 days.I found the quality of the food in most restaurants and the buffet to be very poor, with some exceptions. Fresh seafood from Big Sur Oyster Bar and Italian dishes from Don Vito's were excellent.  I was surprised to see that there was no security at the entrance to the hotel elevators and that anyone could access these and reach the the guest rooms.I would not recommend this hotel and will not return.

reviews.title: Happy to return after many years
reviews.text: Great large room with two queen beds. Large bathroom with vanity separated from toilet and bath with a door. Working table + table with 2 chairs. Comfortable armchair. Complete commodities including Keurig Coffee Maker. Safety deposit box and a telephone in bathroom. Much storage capacity.

reviews.title: Nice one night stay
reviews.text: Large hotel at the southern end of Las Vegas Blvd with all the amenities including a movie theater. Nicely appointed room at a reasonable price - less than $100.Multiple restaurants and bars. A buffet. Less traffic. 10 mins by Uber to the center of the strip.

reviews.title: Casino slot machine problem
reviews.text: When I was playing on slot machine 6550 the machine got disabled. At the point of time I bet maximun snd lost $800. The machine got disabled and and ask me to cash out. I called the manager slot machine to explain why the machine stopped all of a sudden and did not come back to operation. Once I I cashed out the balance. The machine came back to opertational. This is the first time I had in my life time  such experience in casino slot machine. This is a mystery to kickoff the player in between when you you are playing and lost heavily on the machine. The manager could not explain the reason why the machine stopped instead  he called the security. This is very bad part of casino management of South point casino Las Vegas. They insult the customers.  All customers please be cautious while playing high/max  bet in South point casino.They have the control to kick you out of playing slot machine when you loose more on any machine. In casino world this may be new scam. Please be careful and ask management to give proper solution when you come across such situations

reviews.title: Best Overall Value in Las Vegas
reviews.text: I've visited South Point many times to gamble, but this was my first stay at the property.South Point is located at 9777 S. Las Vegas Blvd, which is a little over six miles south of Mandalay Bay.  It is owned by Michael Gaughan who runs the place like casinos in Las Vegas used to be run:  Good gambling, cheap food with large portions, very reasonalbly priced hotel rooms and very clean.My room was on an upper floor and faced south.  I had a view of the M Resort and I-15.  The rooms have no carpeting, just hard floors which probably is easier to clean.  The room is very large and spotless.  No problems with the A/C, shower, sink or toilet.  Extremely quiet.  Beds were very comfortable and I got a great nights sleep every evening.   In addition I received a funbook that gave me multiple free drinks.The gambling is exceptional, one of the very best, if not the best in Las Vegas.  Video Poker reigns supreme at South Point.  Literally hundreds of machines that pay back up 99.8%.  Most casinos don't have video poker this good and if they do, they limit cash back and comps at the best games.  Not at South Point.  Easy to earn enough points for buffets.  Half point days on Mondays at all dining places.  Hot Dog cart serving $1.50 dogs during the day.  The biggest bowling alley I have ever seen and another bowling alley that is used for professional tournaments.  Also has a movie theater.Excellent bar top video poker and the best bar service I have had anywhere.  Just sit down and the bartender is there immediately.  Most bars will make you play a while to get a comped beer, but South Point gave it to me immediately.  I spent a lot of time playing VP at the bar.       Sports book is open 24/7 and doesn't have the "pay for the seat" nonsense found at Strip casinos.  Excellent deli near the Sports Book.  Buffet is the best value buffet in Las Vegas.  I'm sure it loses money, but it's a loss leader that brings in customers.   I also ate at Primarily Prime Rib, which is exceptional.   South Point is run the way most casinos were operated 20 years ago.  Actually gives a fair gamble.  The casino is very busy because of the good gaming odds.  I ran into casino workers from Wynn and Venetian who go to South Point after their shifts.   Amazing seeing the crowds there and the ghost towns of Sam's Town Sunset Station which have eliminated cheap food and drinks and tightened gambling odds.  I have been going to Las Vegas over 30 years (39 trips total),  and this is the best-run operation in town.  Since I always rent a car, I've been to every Strip, downtown and locals casino.   This is unquestionably the best overall experience I have ever had.  Michael Gaughan is old school and he knows how to get customers in the door.   South Point will be my home casino from this point forward.

reviews.title: vegas has changed
reviews.text: we arrived about 1:00 pm. went to check in line. was told check in is at 2:00 but for 20.00 we could check in early. already NOT feeling like a "GUEST" so they did not get the 20.00, I had to wait in line twice. they just dont care......... the resort fee is a scam, ohhhh but you get internet !!!! which is free for anyone on property. Vegas will now try and pry every cent from anyone they can. I dont see any need to come back to vegas cause its not the same. vegas used to want to make you feel welcome...... those days are past

reviews.title: DO NOT GO HERE
reviews.text: These people have no regard for the livestock they PROMOTE and keep outside in excruciating heat. When we were there, there was one small water bowl for probably 50 cows. Absolutely no shade either. Smallest pens ever. Have some empathy and respect for the animals you parade around and force to be shown. Disgusting.

reviews.title: Mixed Bag but Overall Good Value
reviews.text: We stayed for a horse show in the summer in Las Vegas so mainly stayed within the resort for six days.  The room was spacious and very clean,  bed comfy and view amazing so a great value for the price.  If you are not a smoker and come for another reason than gambling it’s def a mixed bag as its smoky from early morning on and the restaurants on site although the food is good,  get very crowded especially at mealtimes which can mean long lines and waits.  The Japanese restaurant Zenshen was very good as was Don Vitos and Primarily Prime.  Breakfast is the worse time to try to eat as there is one place offering a full breakfast and Starbucks in the very large crowded hotel.  We ordered room service a few days which was over an hour but better to be in the comfort of our room than smoky wait adjacent to the casino in line. The staff was super nice and especially the cleaning team.  Our room was refreshed everyday.  All in all fun for a long weekend but with some caveats to non smoking non gambling folks.  The horse arena is wonderful with bars and snacks all around and comfy seats (as much as possible).

reviews.title: Do NOT stay here
reviews.text: This place is disgusting. There are dozens of better hotels available for better prices on the Strip, so do NOT book here if you want to enjoy Las Vegas. There are few dining options, parking is a mess, the pool is boring, our window opens to a view of... a wall. If you want to enjoy shows or nightlife, you have to drive 10ish miles to the Strip. It's better than Motel 6, but Motel 6 is at a much better location, soooo... Just don't bother with this place.

reviews.title: 3 nights 7/31-8/3
reviews.text: 5th stay here after staying at many strip properties over 25 years. The restaurants are outstanding ( Coranado Cafe) for the money and the staff is top notch. Won’t stay anywhere else but here and looking forward to our next visit.

reviews.title: Great value but surly staff.
reviews.text: Last minute get away. Airport shuttle makes convenient if you just want a quick trip.  Great value for food and drinks. Average buffet. Other restaurants, all good. Good gambling and busy casino. Average pool with good food and drink prices.A very notable negative, which cost 1 star for the eating.......among the non-friendliest staff I have ever seen in a casino/resort setting.  I dont need coddling, but this compliment of staff, very bad.

reviews.title: Back from a Great Casino Collectables Convention at the Sound Point
reviews.text: June 2022 attended and decided to stay this year at the South Point during the Casino Collectables Association Show at the Property.  The rooms were very nice and spotless. The Restaurants were all very good and enjoyed the shows in the evening. Looking forward to a return trip next year !!

reviews.title: Don’t stay here if room type is important to you.
reviews.text: Checked in around 2 pm. Made reservations almost two months ago for 2 queen beds. When we checked in, the lady said we had a king. We let her know we booked way in advance and needed two queens as there were three of us. She said the best she could offer was a rollaway for $30 per night-  and we were staying 3 nights.Their hotel policy is bed types are NEVER guaranteed, per the clerk that checked us in. No waiving of fees for the rollaway. The rooms have no couches and hardwood floors. No options for three or four people, except more money. And they were sold out. She proceeded to tell us that it was our fault for booking during multiple events. I understand we’re just one family, but we’ve been coming here for years and never had this type of problem. I’m not sure if she was prejudice or she just didn’t like us. Another bowling mate next to us checking in with another rep was told we were all on same floor with pool view. We got the same floor alright, but a view of the roof and some type of trash or something. To top it off, more bowling’s mates of our (both Caucasian) checked in 2 1/2 hours after us. They too were given a king room upon checkin; however miraculously for them, their room was switched over to two queens with a pool view, same floor. I wouldn’t recommend this hotel if room type is important to you.  There are too many options to choose from. And their management not taking care of the issue, even comping a rollaway, putting us on a different floor, something… and again, doing it for others hours later was a slap in the face. Very disappointed.

reviews.title: Family Reunion with 200 Guests
reviews.text: I can’t say enough about this hotel not only did they have bowling and movies but we had a huge group of us playing in the High Limit Slots and the crew was cheering for us to win. Then we went to the tables and again the crew was so welcoming and excited to see us win. We always felt safe here and never had any problems finding our way around. Restaurants were excellent and so helpful and accommodating trying to keep us all together. I would stay here any day. Such a relaxing vacation. Blessings to all who work here.

reviews.title: "Amazing"!!!!!!!
reviews.text: Everything was awesome from the room to the food!!!  Went there to see the Righteous  Bros Show which was amazing to see. Last time we seen them was in 1995 at the MGM Grand.  The food was amazing as well.  The shopping and casino was great.  Would stay here every time we are in Vegas.

reviews.title: Great for families
reviews.text: Stayed off strip to be closer to family and I don’t think we’ll ever stay on strip again. The rooms are spacious and clean, the hotel has a ton of things to do for adults and kids, and we don’t need to leave the property for anything. We had the bowling alley, arcade and equestrian center for the kids, and adults of course get everything else lol. Also loved that it doesn’t cost anything to park or valet (but of course tip). The pool is also very family friendly and if you don’t want to be around kids, the hot tub area is 16+ only.

reviews.title: Unexpected fun!
reviews.text: The airline sadly cancelled our flight until the next morning and gave us all  room at this hotel. We were pleasantly surprised at what a nice stay we had. The room wasn’t fancy, but still a step up from a typical Holiday Inn or Comfort Suites. We didn’t hear a peep from anyone in other rooms or the hallways. Coffee maker in the room was a plus. There were plenty of open, inexpensive restaurants with great service. Staff was friendly. Every person we encountered seemed to be friendly and genuinely having a good time. What we enjoyed most was the casino. They had several Ultimate Texas Hold’em tables with a table minimum of only $5. If you have ever played this game, you know to play each hand, you need to bet at least 3 times the table minimum. So for $15 a hand that isn’t bad considering most tables on the strip were $25- some even $50-meaning just to play a hand you had to risk at least $75. We ended doing well and played a long time. I enjoy staying at the upscale hotels on the strip but next time we will definitely consider a stay here, and if we don’t stay we will most certainly come here to gamble.

reviews.title: Big Beautiful Clean Room !
reviews.text: I arrived from the free airport shuttle around 11:30 a.m. and they immediately checked all of us in and I was in the room before noon. (glad I did not have to wait til 3:00 check in time). The room was huge! I loved how clean and spacious it was! The elevators were non stop people but the elevators moved quickly. It was a very busy Easter weekend but I just avoided the huge Buffet line and my friend and I visted most of the other restaurants. The only complaint I had was the smokey casino. It was better when I went later that night and when I visited the casino early in the morning. Just a better ventilation system would be great! I would return! I enjoyed being at the hotel.

reviews.title: Big Sur Oyster Bar
reviews.text: Did a trip to Vegas over the Easter weekend. We had an early flight in before hotel check-in time so decided to get something to eat. All restaurants and buffets had long lines due to Easter but Big Sur had open seating at the counter. The service was amazing and friendly and the cooks engaged with you while preparing meals. We had the Clam chowder which was great followed by the Lobster Roll and Clams with Linguine. All the food was delicious and well prepared and tasty! Thank you

reviews.title: Poor service
reviews.text: Th cocktail service is the worst. I simply just wanted some water.  I had to leave my game and walk to the bar to get my own drink.  Thankfully there was a casino porter to watch my game. When spending good money now days the service should be GREAT. This was NOT my experience. Find another casino for your buck.

reviews.title: Not Las Vegas Glitz, BUT…….
reviews.text: Let me start by saying that I was here for a conference. My wife and I have been to Vegas a few times before over the last twenty years, and we love visiting this wonderful city.I felt it would be good to write this review for those who have visited Vegas and those who have not. So here I go!I’ve stayed at the Hilton for business and the Venetian and Caesars Palace for vacation. So if you’re coming to the South Point Resort, understand immediately that this is not Las Vegas. It’s not the glitz and glamour that you’ll find at Caesars, the Bellagio, the Venetian, Cosmopolitan and Aria. Those places have the “Wow” factor. Not at South Point. Those places have the well-known four and five-star restaurants coupled with a celebrity factor. Definitely not at South Point. The glitzy Strip Hotels have incredible  artwork and beautiful lighting. Not here. The Strip hotels have beautifully designed rooms with spacious bathrooms that have a separate shower and separate jetted-tubs. Not at South Point. Finally, South Point Resort is 7 miles from the Strip. It doesn’t take long to get to the Strip from here, but be advised it will cost you $40-$50 dollars via taxi (tip included). Also, other than South Point, there’s it much else out here. Your room may have a nice view of the nearby mountains, or it may be like mine: a view of the backside and the roof of the Casino. I mentioned BUT……this is what I mean: I don’t think South Point  is trying to be any of the previously mentioned glamorous Strip hotels. South Point is affordable. It’s clean. The customer service is excellent throughout. The restaurants are affordable. They are not 4-star to 5-star places, but the food is good and in large portions. There are numerous amenities. A very large and attractive pool. A large, well-maintained workout center that has 24/7 access. A large casino area that includes a large poker room and sportsbook area. Easy automotive access in and out and straight onto the Expressway leading into Las Vegas and the Strip. Large hotel rooms that are more than adequate. Standard bathrooms that are beyond adequate.Quick cons: the doors to the hotel rooms are thick and heavy. That’s ok, but they automatically close and when they do it’s very loud and can be felt in nearby rooms. Honestly, I’ve never experienced this kind of noise and vibration at the many hotels I’ve stayed. It’s quite shocking and will wake you up while sleeping. Next, the Casino allows smoking, but it would be good if this Resort could figure to circulate the air better. Last, the colors are dark. Everywhere.Pro: awesome attention to cleanliness. The sanitary conditions of the public restrooms are on the level of what you see at Disneyworld and the Bucces stores in Texas. Their ballrooms and meeting rooms are as good and in some comparisons better than other facilities nationwide. Very spacious, accommodating, and clean. An excellent facility for large conferences.

reviews.title: Enjoyable as usual
reviews.text: I just returned home from Las Vegas which i stayed at the South Point Hotel* Casino*Spa,and it was a great time as usual.South Point never has a dull moment,from all the machines,tables of all sort,restaurants,and great rooms so if you want nonstop fun action then the South Point is for you,...spend time there,you won't want to leave

reviews.title: Would not stay here again
reviews.text: There is always a line to access the elevators to your room, well less of a line a more like a crowd of people waiting to get on the elevator. There were also no extra blankets in the room, we had to call and wait for them to be brought up, I assume they are short staffed, and I felt bad for even asking.The walls are also thin, we could hear a phone alarm going off at 5:45am. We decided we were awake now and I went make the coffee, using the machine in the room the coffee was sour, the machine was dirty. The front desk offered to bring up a clean one, but based upon how long it took us to get the blanket, I declined and went downstairs to Starbucks.  This place is not for me, I don't like waiting to get to my room, when I want to rest or shower or whatever. I don't like a dirty coffee machine, as one wonders what about the rest of the cleanliness of the room?

reviews.title: My go to Vegas Casino Hotel!
reviews.text: We stay here in January every year.  We stay for good hotel most of the time.  However we have learned to love eating here also.  The steak, italian, prime rib, mexican, cafe and buffet are provide really good value for Vegas.  Suggest making reservations since there are a lot of conventions and events that fill places up.  I like how the resort fee is lower than most, parking is free and its fun to have some much to do on a whim.  My hot tip is to be sure to check out the coupon book the join the players club.  In early 2022 the coupon book had a lot of free drinks in different places.  Be sure to join the players club for a discount at the Garden Buffet.

reviews.title: First Stay at this hotel
reviews.text: Very nice facility. Bell Desk service was excellent. Front desk was ok. Room was not completely cleaned before we checked in and not cleaned at all while we were there. The toilet would not flush on our first day, but maintenance was thee to fix it in less than 15 minutes. The clam chowder is wonderful at the oyster bar. Overall, it was a good two-night stay. It is a bit off the strip but not too far if you want to visit the strip and it has all the amenities there that you will need. Loved the riding carts to help you get around and the rooms are large enough to park at least two and not stumble around. The k-cups were decaf.

reviews.title: SouthPoint is On Point!
reviews.text: My gal pal and I recently stayed at SouthPoint which is an awarded locals property located on the far south end of Las Vegas Boulevard (The Strip). We had a brief stay at SP in the past, but this was our longest stay - 4 nights. Are you looking for a low-key casino vibe with a property that has it all? If so, then SouthPoint is definitely it! Upon check-in each registered room guest receives a FunBook which is great for dining deals. In the hotel we have had both the City/Mountain and pool room view, I would suggest the pool view. We were located on the 11th floor, and the elevators were quick and smooth. The hotel rooms are well appointed, extremely clean and well maintained. Also, in the room is a mini refrigerator, safe, ironing board, iron, hair dryer, and a Keurig machine with complimentary k-cups.  For breakfast we ate at the Garden Buffet for $5.39 w/tax each with a player's card and the 50% off coupon from the funbook. Online reviews tend to be largely negative, often not stating any positives. Our visit to the Garden Buffet was on point, full spread breakfast options-bacon, sausage, hash, fruit, etc., an omelet station, and bottomless bloody mary's (which were just vodka and tomato juice, but hey, you can't beat the price!).The food options at SP are another on point feature of the property. The 24-hour Coronado Cafe has everything with an exceptional Chinese food menu and a Late Nite Specials menu from Midnight to 6 a.m. Craving Mexican food? Baja Miguels has it going on, however, it's only open Wednesday-Sunday. While at Baja Miguels, be sure to check out the Lunch Specials menu from 11 a.m. - 3:30 p.m., my friend and I each had an entree and margarita on the rocks for $10.78 w/tax each. We were craving crab legs and sadly due to the high market price of crab legs the Big Sur Oyster Bar was not serving the advertised crab leg special. A sign indicating such would have been appreciated at the host stand, but we had a lovely dinner nonetheless. We often parked ourselves at the many bars and played lots of bar top Keno. SP has numerous bars, with plenty of seating. And the cocktail service was on point! Our favorite was the 24/7 hour bar-Catalina Island Bar, and the 400 Bar which opens at 4 p.m. The casino vibe is that mostly of the 30+ age demographic and are respectful and courteous to all. Some hoots and hollers were heard on the casino floor which always add to the Vegas casino experience. There were a large number of Keno and Video Poker machines and the slots range from the old school 5-liners, to several of the hot new slots including Rakin' Bacon, Miss Kitty Wild Ride, Wonka Dreamers of Dreams, and Madonna. Also, the comps are easily accessible for those willing to reach out to a Casino Host at SP.During our visit in late November/early December there were sunny skies and temperatures in the low 70's, so we soaked in the resort's hot tub, which is spacious and private. It was nice to walk down to the pool area in my complimentary slippers provided in each room. The pool area was open 10 a.m. - 6 p.m., and we largely had the area to ourselves during the off season. Other great features at SP are the Bingo Hall, Bowling Alley, and kids Arcade located upstairs. Need to stretch your legs? Be sure to go outside of SP and walk the perimeter of the property. Given its location in a desired residential area you can feel safe and not be hassled by street beggars or tourist sales pitches. Also, there is a gas station just across the street as well as a McDonald's and Denny's if that strikes your fancy.SouthPoint definitely caters to a more mature clientele, however the resort, customer service, and locals casino odds are worth making the trip in my opinion. I love SP, and found my new favorite casino and look forward to returning again in February and discovering more of the property.

reviews.title: first time staying off the strip
reviews.text: We stayed in one of the suites. Tons of amenities! our room was like a small apartment. We had fridge, plates, and a dishwasher. The room had two rooms --one the bedroom with a large tub and a big living room. bathroom was huge --big walk in shower. the property is big so it was a little hard to find the pool. I would stay again

reviews.title: One night stay but was ok
reviews.text: Even though it was only one night stay, I really like this place.  It was away from the hustle and bustle of Las Vegas but yet still close.  The room I have was spacious and I like the wood floor than the carpet; which eliminate odor like smoke from the casinos.  They have so much to choose from to dine in.  Bell service was outstanding helping me with my luggage.

reviews.title: This Resort Has Everything!
reviews.text: First trip to Vegas since pandemic started.  Was pleased to see that all amenities were open at the South Point.  Room was great, food was good, and always found a place at the blackjack table.  The shuttle to and from the airport was on time.  Staff very friendly.  Will be going back in the future.

reviews.title: Relaxing week in Vegas
reviews.text: We visited for my hubby's birthday  we wanted to be off the busy strip and enjoyed the casino and restaurants we also had a great time in the jaccuzzi and pool. Housekeeping came everyday while we were out and the facility maintained good covid protocols. The week we were there was also a rodeo competition and we met great people during our stay. we took an uber to the strip for about 20 bucks but were happy to be back at the hotel since the strip was extremely busy even on a weekday...good all around and we will be back. the 24 hour starbucks was a dream come true

reviews.title: Great Resort with friendly associates
reviews.text: Stayed here for 4 nights.  It has everything you need!  The casino is huge and even pays off at times.  The dealers, hosts, and every employee we came in contact with was very friendly.  The restaurants were good.  We ate at the Steakhouse, and a bit loud on this night, but the steaks were cooked to perfection.  The Deli serves good snacks, and the seafood place was very good.   Buffet and coffee shop were good.There is free parking.  The Sportsbook is huge, has good odds, and many TV's to watch the games.  Rooms were very clean, beds were comfortable.  The free shuttle service runs on time to and from the airport.    The VIP host we use, Pam Wisdom, treats us well and is a pleasure to work with.  She is an asset to this organization.  Had a great trip, great resort, and will return again.

reviews.title: Loved South Point
reviews.text: Stayed for 6 nights. Room was large and clean! Our beds were comfortable and room quite. No issues. Housekeeping came only when requested which was fine with us. If we needed towels, garbage removed, etc we called the front desk and someone came right away.We had a view of pool and mountain landscape from the 19th floor.We enjoyed all the various restaurants, pool area, and the bowling alley! Having a 24 hour Starbucks was a plus!! You never have to leave! They have everything! If you forgot something it is most likely in the shop on the first floor.We took a quick 10 minute taxi ride to the strip.Hope to return in the future!

reviews.title: Horrible service
reviews.text: I arrived to the hotel for the first time ever, after booking through a third party website. I arrived to the hotel room and was given a room with no view....I'm literally looking at a back alley and a wall. I called to the front desk and was told that they are completely booked and we arrived early. They also said that's what I chose on the site, I clearly chose mountain view. I called back and Shelly the manager was very short with me and said like I said we are sold out, call back tomorrow. There may be availabilities.  I think her this is mu birthday weekend and I'm completely dissatisfied.  I will Never stay here again.

reviews.title: USBC Bowling Championship Tournament Family Trip
reviews.text: Stayed for USBC bowling tournament as South Point was the host facility. The amenities were fantastic, from the movie theatres to the restaurants. The pool and spa are the best in Las Vegas. All staff were friendly. When calling front desk to get any item, such as extra towels or coffee for the room, someone came immediately up to our room every time. Outstanding restaurants! Our favorite: The Del Mar Deli in the Casino Food Court  is like nothing in the entire Dallas, TX area we live in. It's like a New York authentic kosher deli, with homemade soups, even matzo ball soup! They have giant meaty sandwiches, and many unbelievable homemade desserts. Fresh baked bread, awesome sides like potato salad are all made fresh. The portions are huge! We couldn't eat it all and took food to the room each time! Amazing value! We look forward to Del Mar Deli and all the other great eating places at South Point every time we visit! Finally, the slots were loose and we won good money! $$$$

reviews.title: South Point stay 9-19 to 9-22
reviews.text: Arrived for my stay with my wife have stayed here several times without any problems. When checking in had a very rude clerk while checking in I asked for my 10% discount with my AARP or AAA she told me could not receive this discount because my discount was the coupon book. Will never stay here again. Stay was 9-19 thru 9–22

reviews.title: Great Stay
reviews.text: I haven't been to Vegas in about 5 years, due to the shooting and covid.  So it was time to come back.  Stayed 9/20-9/24.  I need to get out and see other people again.  Vegas was cowded.  I guess everyone has the same idea. I stayed here several years ago.  Decided to come back again I liked it then and they don't  charge for parking. Not happy with resort fee.  It was a good stay Liked the room. No carpet, more hotels should follow this.  Clean comfortable. Like the bed, pillows Two big ones and a small one.  Like the two chairs. They were comfortable.  The bathroom vanity was large. Toilet and shower in a seperate room.  Only problem with shower is pressure isn't good.  Like being sprinkled with fairy dust. The tub does not drain well.  I oped out for maid service.  I lke not having someone in my room.  I don't make a big mess so no maid service is not a problem.  Hotel is making up for lost time on food and other services.  Prices higher on everything.  There was a problem with someone at the buffet, waited 15 minutes before paying and there was only one person ahead of me. Something didn't go through on the register and the other person tried to help.  Don't know??  The rest of hte line backed up.  Food was good .  I like trying new things.  Also ate at Steak and Shake and Del Mar Grill.  Peaked at Star Bucks  to see what sweet rolls available for breakfast didn't see anything worth the high priced coffee.  Long line there.  Casino was good had a lot of video poker slots my game.  The casino was always crowded.  Masks a must have. Did not go swimming but looked at the pool.   I will return

reviews.title: Celebration Staycation
reviews.text: Las Vegas local here. Just got back from staycation at South Point. Was able to get an AARP discount! We got a suite - special occasion! They've recently done some renovations to the rooms - not sure if it's all of them, but our suite was really nice. No carpet in the room - less germs! AC worked extremely well. Ate at Steak 'n Shake (always good!), Coronado Cafe - twice (big portions, great food, highly recommend the Chinese chicken salad!), Big Sur Oyster Bar (oysters on the half shell and New England clam chowder were awesome - wasn't too crazy about their gumbo), and Baja Miguel's (great food and, again, large portions!). Didn't win in the casino but had a great time. Cocktail service on the casino floor is great - of course, we tip generously. Every employee we spoke with was nice, friendly, and courteous except the bell desk folks - unlike other properties we've stayed at, the bell desk folks didn't seem to want to interact at all. Valet is complimentary and well worth the tips. Hoping we earned some follow-up comps - would love to stay here again. Our usual go-to is Sahara - love Sahara! Now we have TWO go-to's!!

reviews.title: Don’t room charge!!!
reviews.text: Nice rooms - friendly service - very convenient for horse comps.  Be careful charging to your room - to easy to over charge you upon check out.  Had an experience w extending our stay and getting over charged.  Disappointing because we really enjoy the arenas and competing here…

reviews.title: Resort Fee
reviews.text: Be aware of a “resort fee” which is ridiculous.  You aren’t told about it until you check in.  I won’t be returning to this establishment.  It includes things that you would normally receive with the room, coffee, weight room, etc.

reviews.title: Rude valet
reviews.text: This our first trip in over a year to las vegas and our first time staying at south point hotel! Upon arrival at south point, I parked in the valet parking and waiting a few minutes for a valet to come. No one in sight, so after, a valet passes by and I tell him we are checking in and he's response is " that's nice"! The nerve of him and he could at least say do you need help, as I was going to say can you help us with parking, but he just continued on his Merry way! First day at south point, no brownie points for you!!! Terrible service!

reviews.title: The smell of smoking is disgusting
reviews.text: This is a nice appearing place, but going inside you are overwhelmed with the stink of cigarette smoke,  Humorously, the announcement says “Masks are mandatory and must be properly worn at all times.”  All you see are unmasked smokers. The stink is omnipresent and nowhere on the casino floor can you escape it.  When you sit at a slot machine, sure enough a smoker will sit right next to you and start hacking unmasked. We will never go to this joint ever again

reviews.title: Very nice stay!
reviews.text: I had a nice stay here! It was my first time staying here. Reception was fast and super friendly. A lot of things to do here: bingo, bowling, movies, lots of restaurants. Spa was nice. Rooms very nice and clean. Really nice pool. Sort of nice to be off strip for a bit, I could see doing a whole weekend in this area: South Point, M, the mall, etc.

reviews.title: Best visit to Las Vegas in forever
reviews.text: Room was neat and clean, well appointed.  Had a great meal at the buffet, the prime rib was excellent.  The Mexican restaurant was also very good.  The food here was good all around.  If you are interested in horses, rodeo and that sort of thing I would highly recommend this hotel.  My only complaint is that I had to wear a mask thanks to the Nevada governor's mandate.

reviews.title: Poor quality
reviews.text: Room floor was dirty, towel has blood stain scary! And they want you to reuse towels over and over again. If only i was able to book ahead i would have other better hotelChoices. I will never use this hotel again!

reviews.title: Beautiful Stay
reviews.text: From check in to check out, this property was fabulous. It was located off the strip, but only 10 min away. It has a beautiful bowling alley, theater, Bingo, arcade, rodeo, and many eateries and gambling. Had a lovely stay and will stay again.

reviews.title: Great Hotel
reviews.text: I have stayed at South Point twice now. The price is right and it's located right off the strip. It has a shuttle to and from the airport. There is an assortment of fanastic restaurants, many of them offering Happy Hour specials. We spent much of our time for 4 days in the hotel for a children's tournament. It's very child-friendly with a bowling alley, movie theater and of course the nice pool. You really don't need to leave! The staff is great and they really do take pride in their hotel. It's the reason I'll keep going back!

reviews.title: shows and garden buffet are excellent
reviews.text: for several years we have attended show here at Southpoint.  Every show has been excellent.  the staff is friendly and very helpful.  Sandy and her supervisor at the ticket office go out of their way to help.  We also visit the Garden Buffet. the food is so good.  and the staff is wonderful.  South Point is very clean and  and parking is easy to find and FREE.  WE LOVE SOUTHPOINT

reviews.title: Somewhere else next time
reviews.text: We were staying here only because it was a convenient place to stay on a trip home from Colorado. The price was good. If you have any luggage at all you will need to valet park as that is the only way to get a cart. I paid extra for a view room. The room is large, but you can hear everything in the hallway. We do have a view of the swimming pool and we are on the 8th floor, but this morning the gardeners started blowing at 7 am and it was noisy all the way up here. Had dinner last night at the sushi place and while the food was good, the service was rude. Our waiter overcharged me for a glass of wine that was not what I ordered and then argued with me about it. I had to involve a manager. If you are there because you love the casino or you are attending a function there it is probably fine, but there isn’t anything that would make us go back.

reviews.title: Rude Casino Dealer(s). Shame you and talk trash about you if you aren't tipping enough!
reviews.text: Welcome to my review of my experiences at SouthPoint. First I am a local, therefore I frequent this property quite a bit. Today unfortunately I chose to play Ulitmate Texas Holdem and was graced by a dealer by the name of Elizabeth from Cuba. This was on her nametag and is the only identifying info I have.2nd hand playing I get a flush and decide my third hand I will "toke bet" on the Trips spot the following hand. While looking at my cards in a very normal manner (I am a dealer myself Pit games along with a pro poker player, I understand cards.) Elizabeth called on me to not "pick up my cards like that" in a very rude manner. I asked how I am hurting them and she found an issue with it, so my tips ceased. The next hand between hands 4 and 5 I pulled out my phone to check my screen below the table and again, Elizabeth chewed me out saying "no phones at the table." Her cell phone was actually on the table and she slowed the game often checking it. (I guess SouthPoint allows their dealers to have their own phones on the table..) Moving on...I win a few hands in a row for a couple hundred bucks and Elizabeth from Cuba notices I have not tipped anything since her first outburst. She began to make snide remarks to other players out loud, far louder than normal voice saying "oh thanks for the tip try" "dang we didn't win our tip, unfortunately only one player is actually winning, and looked at me while using these disrespectful and snide remarks." I advised the table I too am a table games dealer in Vegas and completely understand her remarks and why I am not tipping. A couple hands later I kid you not, I am in seat 2, Asian man in seat 3 was sporadically toke betting, this man is ON HIS PHONE TALKING during a hand, Elizabeth from Cuba says NOTHING TO HIM. Player in Seat 6 (Caucasian male) was also on his phone ABOVE THE TABLE and again, Elizabeth from Cuba DID NOT SAY A WORD. Moving onto other times she singled me out... I asked another player if I could gift him $5 and he plays it on his Trips spot (since he wasn't playing it) and he said sure. Elizabeth from Cuba elected to stop the game and call a floor and tell the floor what we did and stop us from betting more money?!?!? That's insane. I have dealt in multiple casinos and cannot believe how she chose to target me for not tipping and ostracize my movements.In moments where her floor would come over again, she would look behind her (against policy) and talk to her floor in Spanish. Unfortunately for her I know some spanish and understood she was speaking negatively about me to her floor who responded back in Spanish. Zero positive customer service from either individual. I am appalled by the lack of professionalism from the dealers. Elizabeth from Cuba also argued with me saying "You are a dealer you should know the rules." The worst part of all of this was when I was having a conversation with a player in Seat 5 about my experience and how I find this targeting by Elizabeth to be poor service, she interrupted our conversation to tell me "We didn't have any problems with anyone until YOU came!" I am blown away that a dealer can talk this way to a frequent guest. I HAD to write this and bring it to the attention of tourists so they can make a calculated decision on where to stay. From my experience at SouthPoint. If you see Elizabeth from Cuba on a table, I do not recommend playing with her. She will make disrespectful comments to you, about you to others, and shame you for not tipping when you're already down hundreds.

reviews.title: Had to book a room due to circumstances
reviews.text: Lines were long which was expected but the lady jasmine that checked us in was very rude and had no personality, she was just very rude and thought she knew better then us. very disappointing. rooms were clean and very nice. also the cocktail waitresses downstairs are very rude, they take forever to come around to take orders, one cocktail waitress in particular went around taking orders and we asked for two beers and she said she would be back but just ignored us after telling her multiple times, that is unacceptable and very poor customer service, we spent 4 nights there and spent lots of money to be treated that way is not right. i was very disappointed in the customer service. smh.

reviews.title: South Point jewel
reviews.text: South Point is very close to our place in Southern Highlands, it stands out, its beautiful, they have steak and eggs for $5.99 from 12am to 6am, its really worth it, you will like it, you should check it out, service is great,  its a great place to bring visitors

reviews.title: Long lines
reviews.text: This was my first time staying at South Pointe.  Overall, the nonsmoking room was pleasant.   Pro: off the strip, which is less traffic and noise. Pro: plenty of parking in the garagePro: Starbucks opened 24/7Pro: hardwood floors in the room made it coolerPro: Housekeeping daily was great Pro: Check-in and out was easy and fast Cons: The walls are thin, so you can hear the noise in the hallway and the hotel doors are heavy and are loud when they shut.  Cons: A few kinks of repairs while we were there, but they came and fixed them right away.  Cons: The TV remote was not working all the time, so we just didn't watch tv that much.  Cons: The shower pressure is very light.   Cons: Buffet and Cafe restaurants on-site always had the longest line.  Up to an hour wait.  Cons: The filtration system in the casino area was poor. Lots of people smoking. Cons:  Elevator floors were filthyCons: slots were not very loose.  Cons: The pool was nice, but not too many shaded areas.

reviews.title: Great place for a relaxing get away to Vegas
reviews.text: I've been going  to the South point for years. Lately, they've really cut back on my comps, because I've had a few good trips. That upsets me, but I keep going back because I like the casino/hotel/race book.  The race book is top notch and the people working there always make me feel welcomed. So if you are a horse player this is the place for you. They have a good selection of machines and table games. The silverado cafe is great, so is the oyster bar and the coronado cafe. Good food at nice prices. I love this place. It's just has such a laid back feel to it.

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: I recently stayed at South Point and plan to return.1.   Check in and check out were extremely quick and easy.2.. The room was clean and it was nice to have housekeeping daily.  A free refrigerator was appreciated.3.  The casino has a lot of slot machines that were not on the Strip.4.  Everyone we encountered was friendly and happy.5.  Corando Cafe has outstanding food and wonderful service.6.  The food at Garden Buffet was delicious and so much better than the one at Caesars.7.  Taking the shuttle to the airport was an unexpected and welcome surprise.I look forward to returning soon.

reviews.title: Suites designated as Non-Smoking on the website are actually Smoking rooms
reviews.text: We booked a Specialty One-Bedroom Suite on the 25th floor, the largest and most premium room available at the South Point Hotel and Casino. We specifically booked a NON-SMOKING room (which shows as such on our confirmation, and still shows that description on South Point's actual website). When we arrived, the front desk staff also initially confirmed that it was a NON-SMOKING room.However, when we entered our suite, we saw at least four ash trays with matchbooks in various places around the room, and the room had a subtle stink. So we went downstairs to ask the front desk to move us to an actual non-smoking room.This time we were told that the suite wasn't "technically" a non-smoking room, but rather a SMOKING OPTIONAL room. (Yes, that is actually what the staff said!)We asked again to be put into a NON-SMOKING suite, not a "smoking optional" room (since that just means it's a smoking room, obviously). We were told that "all suites are "smoking optional." And that was that. No apologies, no consideration, nothing.So if you don't like being lied to, don't enjoy the stink of smoke in your non-smoking room, and don't enjoy smelling like burnt tires after walking through the smoke-filled public spaces (which are all adjacent to the restaurants, causing them to smell bad too despite not allowing smoking in the food establishments), then this probably isn't the hotel for you. There's a reason the most expensive suite in this dump is only $235 per night!It's especially disappointing because this hotel has the best restaurant in Las Vegas – Michael's. It's expensive, but for good reason... absolutely the best service, best food, and best atmosphere in the area. It's a shame Michael's patrons have to walk through all the filth, stink, and stupidity to get to this spectacular steak house.

reviews.title: Pretty Darn Good!!!
reviews.text: I recently traveled to Vegas for a training, and the South Point was a recommended hotel. I could have stayed closer to the Strip at one of the higher-end hotels (for 3+ times the price) but decided to stay here instead - and I'm glad that I did!Friendly Staff - The very first thing that stood out right off the bat was just how friendly and warm the staff were - from the front desk at check in, to the spa, to the waitstaff, to the ladies in the gift shop, to the folks who took care of the wake-up call, to the airport shuttle driver - (well, ok sure, there was that one waiter at one restaurant who was all business and rushed us a bit, but that was the exception) Overall, the staff provided a welcoming, down-home comforting vibe that you just don't get at most places.Room - Very surprised at how nice the room was! I got a premium King and the room was HUGE and VERY clean. It had a mini fridge, a Keurig coffee maker (with lots of coffee pods provided), hairdryer, soap and shampoo/conditioner and lotion, and LOTS of towels (although oddly, total number of towels provided on the rack was inconsistent each day). I really liked that room had two easy chairs as well as a little dining table with two chairs. Note: Room did not have any tea or glassware/coffee cups, just paper cups in case that matters to you. My fav "nice touch" was the complementary slippers : )  Tip: Get a room further away from the elevator because the area close to elevator bank is noisy and can be quite warm with the high temp weather. Overall, loved the room.Gym: Delighted at just how nice the gym was  too - tons of great modern equipment, weight machines, treadmills, elliptical machines, pull-up bar, water station, air conditioned (Tip: you can also buy bigger bottles of water and Gatorade at the fridge in the Spa right outside the gym). Everything you need for an awesome workout.Variety of Dining Choices - I'll admit I was a bit concerned that there weren't many outside restaurants super close by - but it turned out there were more than enough choices at the South Point. The prime rib restaurant was by far my fav - also loved the burger spot (special line for to-go orders) and the ice cream place (get the peanut butter crunch smoothie!). All were quite good and reasonably priced (except the steakhouse) Tip: Be sure to make a reservation for the sit-down restaurants well in advance through the hotel website via Open Table: the reservation process was super easy, and I'm glad I didn't have to wait in those very long lines on Friday night. Tip: Get to Starbucks EARLY in the morning, especially if you're headed to the airport - the line can be really long.Gift Shop /Liquor Store - The shop had great amenities -clothes. toothbrush, toothpaste, lots of  clothes, sparkling waters and even kombucha and a few snacks. I wish there had been some yogurts and some fresh fruit options (but they did have a few things like that at the deli.... and Krispy Kreme upstairs had yogurt and even cups of sliced vegetables - who knew?) Shuttle - Loved that they provided an airport shuttle. Wish that it picked up at the airport more frequently since I missed the one I had reserved and ended up paying $30+ for a taxi. But glad they had a shuttle available on day of departure. Tip: Bring small bills for a tip for the Shuttle driver - thanks for lifting all those heavy bags in the 112 degree heat!Overall: Is it super fancy and glamorous? No - but it's a fun, relaxed comfy, local vibe. Can you bring your family there? Yes, saw lots of families with kids out at the pool, and several groups of tweens and teens running around in packs looking absolutely giddy with delight near the movie theater, ice cream, and arcade. Would I bring my parents/grandparents here? Yes, for folks who want some fun but don't want to be on the Strip, this is a good place to come for a fun weekend. Did I need to bring that extra bag of super fancy clothes? Not really - most folks were dressed nicely casual, and some did dress up a bit for dinner. Do I wish I'd brought my darkest sunglasses and worn them inside? Yes! It was so bright on the main floor, I thought my eyes would bug out (Tip: bring your blue-blockers!)
