Did it get a little crazy at times? I hope so! Hey it's Vegas, not Sunday school, right?  Sure there were a few super rowdy group as expected, but everyone was having a blast. People overall were quite friendly and everyone just seemed really glad to finally be out! (Also, there were lots of calm security folks around keeping an eye on the elevator bank) Would I stay here again? Definitely - it's a pretty darn good place!

reviews.title: USBC 2021
reviews.text: This was our 4th stay here over the years..  We were in a handicapped room which was not needed but that was OK.  Very inconsistent with number of towels daily.  Started out our stay with 2 bath towels and 2 wash cloths.  No hand towels.  Toward end of stay towel amounts and variety increased (we hadn’t requested more but we were glad for it).  Rooms clean.  Coffee in room..  Some also got tea.  The addition of tea was appreciated by those who got it.Glad for added security asking for room key before boarding elevators at night.Restaurants always busy.  Assuming they are short of help like everywhere else.  Make reservations early into your stay.  Long lines at buffet and Steak n Shake as well as Coronado Cafe and Del Mar.  snack at bowling alley (where doubles and singles were played) really slow…..

reviews.title: Garden buffet at South Point Hotel and Casino
reviews.text: We visited my sister in law in Henderson last week-end (June 25,2021),  and told her that we missed Las Vegas buffet.  She and her husband took us to Garden buffet at South Point hotel.  We're all surprised of their price and the variety of food they have. Their food are high quality food, their services are exceptional.We highly recommend this buffet to anyone who loves buffet especially in Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Never again
reviews.text: Decided to do a staycation and went with South Point since there’s so much to do at this property. Rooms where clean and spacious. Machines were a little tight didn’t win but love the fact they have a variety￼ from old to new machines.Overall was a good experience until today in the morning!! When checking in I requested a late check out. At 10am housekeeping came into our room. We were very surprised since this has never happened to us and any other property. She was very loud and was making so much noise outside our room came again 1 hour later to knock and trying to open the door again. Finally got up getting ready to leave housekeeping again Tried coming inside so I called front desk to confirm I  had  a late checkout and then spoke with Shelly the “director” who by the way was the rudest person.  I asked if i had a late check out she said no but she can go ahead and add it I told her their no point now since it’s 12:45pm and about to leave.  She then told me your a local and you should know housekeeping starts cleaning rooms early I told her I actually do work at a casino property on the strip and that’s not what we do. Check out at most hotels are at 11am and front desk always communicates with housekeeping to notify what rooms are checked out and what rooms need attention not go knocking at all the doors and see which ones are empty. Because of this I will never return! My staycation started fun but because of Shelly she ruined my weekend. Never again!

reviews.title: Love this casino and hotel.
reviews.text: We love this place. This is our 4th time staying there. We come to bowl nationals and this place is perfect. It’s off the strip which is great. They don’t make you pay for parking which is sooo great. We love the bingo there. We go several times a day. The ladies that work there are so nice and knew us by the end of our visit. The staff is so great and so nice. We love it and will be back next year.

reviews.title: Away from the strip but still nearby
reviews.text: This hotel is on the strip but a couple of miles south of the busy strip area.  This hotel is lovely - clean, comfy beds, quiet, with all the amenities you would expect at a Las Vegas hotel.  There is a casino, a bowling alley, a movie theatre, several fine restaurants, a spa, shopping, etc. We stayed here on the busy Memorial Weekend 2021 when the whole world was reopening after the pandemic.  Everything seemed to be running smoothly even though it was the first big holiday weekend, so hats off to the management and employees who were working so hard to meet everyone's needs.  This was my first trip ever to Vegas. If I ever return, I'd stay here again.

reviews.title: Great place great staff
reviews.text: I have been in the South Point many times over the years but this was my first time staying there.  I had a complete wow experience.  Every single staff member I encountered was polite , smiling and helpful. This place is huge and it is really well cared for and clean.  Pool area was great.  The rooms are great.  The bed was super comfortable.  Loved the wood floors in the room.  The room was spotless looked brand new.   There are a lot of great food options.  Don Vito's was great. Loved the prices and after midnight menu at the Coronado cafe.    I highly recommend staying here and will be back there soon.

reviews.title: Great hotel off the strip
reviews.text: This is our go two hotel off the strip!  We love the room looked renovated food always good at the buffet prime rib and Coronado cafe steak and eggs after midnight for $6.95 you can’t beat that !! Great service they have bowling alley movie theater Starbucks  great service !!! My family came in for birthday celebration they love Southpint !! Can’t wait to return in fall !!

reviews.title: Everything you need
reviews.text: Well my wife and I booked this property because it was off strip and figured we would avoid the big crowds.  Well that really didn't work out because there was a 2 month bowling tournament going on.  Place was packed.  But it was all good.  The place has plenty of places to eat.  I had Steak and eggs every morning for cheap.  Everyone working there was incredibly nice and respectful. Between midnight and 10AM they did intense cleaning everyday.  The rooms are spacious and comfortable.  The worst part was trying to get into the buffet.  The line at anytime was at least an hour wait.  Never got to try it.  Nothing is worth waiting an hour for.  But it must have been good because it was busy.This place is like a small city with some really nice folks working there.  Book it you won't regret it.

reviews.title: Was just ok not like the strip at all
reviews.text: We were there for 3 days it was just okRestaurant Coronado we had to get up and leave because the service was so bad . We went then to zen shrine restaurant they had terrific lobster  the employees were ok some better than others . Food was excellent Played slots a lot but no one was winning very much so went to the room . So I’m guessing staying on the strip would be a lot better . We had room service but  was overly priced!  We paid 79.00 a little extra it was good but very pricy  We will not ever go back to this casino !

reviews.title: Mistake Corrected
reviews.text: I was celebrating getting my 2nd vaccine with a Vegas trip, but made the mistake of booking another property for my 5-night visit.  After the second night, I realized that I should have gone with my old stand-by - The South Point.  Nearly all staff at my first choice were some form of cranky, however, when I got the South Point, I feel that my vacation actually started.  I've stayed here many times before, and was once again treated to exceptional professionalism, a clean facility and all the comforts I've come to expect from past visit.  It was good to see that unlike most other properties, they also had all of their restaurant open, including the buffet.  I wish I had scheduled my entire stay for the South Point, but I'm glad I cut my losses after two nights and moved here for the last part of my stay.   I won't make that mistake again.

reviews.title: A great long weekend get away
reviews.text: We took a long weekend (Wednesday to Sunday) family trip to the Southpoint and had a great time.   The staff was friendly and the room was clean and well appointed.   My kids loved the bowling and arcade, my wife and I enjoy the sports book and great bartenders.   High recommend the Del Mar Deli, a lot of great food at good price. Already looking forward to our next trip back.

reviews.title: Amazing first trip
reviews.text: My husband and I took a last minute trip to see family. We were amazed at all the things to do there. Since covid everything has been crazy, all the staff are very good at keep everything clean. They have several restaurants that did not disappoint, have rodeo events, bowling, a movie theater, bingo, along with all the casino games. We went to a race one day and they have a bus that takes you back and forth to that. Everything was very well organized. We will be back for sure.

reviews.title: Great time
reviews.text: What a great time!!  The rooms were spacious and clean, you never need to leave the resort.  We ate at Zenshin's, Steak and Shake, Coronado and Baja Miguel's and would give them all 5 stars.  Great service and wonder food.  Where else can you get $1 Bloody Mary and Mimosas?  We will definitely be back, this will be our go to place when visiting Vegas.

reviews.title: Highly recommend
reviews.text: I love the Southpoint! Staying here was so much fun and felt very safe and clean! Friendly staff and so much to do. They made sure everyone was wearing mask and social distancing! Would highly recommend!

reviews.title: A lot to do and great values
reviews.text: I have stayed here before and not noticed that they have a bowling alley- and it was open! A movie theatre, that was also open!  Sadly the pool was not open even though I called a couple days before arriving and was told it was open. They give you a coupon book at check in and we got a buffet- that was great for 2 for $10. The other restaurants are very reasonable and the Shake Shack has many half off times. Best alcohol prices, $3 for wine $4.50 for beer. I was just annoyed that in the fitness center there was someone there who was supposed to be cleaning and making sure people were wearing their masks.  He obviously hated the job, he rarely if ever looked up for whatever he was looking at, he didn't even notice that there was a man who wore his face mask around his neck the whole time.  I kept looking over at the attendant to get his attention but he never looked up.  After watching this guy for 30 minutes walk around without his mask, I finally walked to the attendant and asked him if he was supposed to monitor masks, he said yes. Told him one guy was not wearing his, there were only 3 people in the fitness center and I had to point him out to the attendant.  He finally said something and finally got up and started cleaning equipment. The other annoying thing was that our room keys kept not working.  Really annoying to keep having to get new ones at the front desk. Other than that I really like this hotel, it is nice and quiet and has a lot to do.

reviews.title: Only buffet opened in Las Vegas 7/7 with great prices.
reviews.text: Congratulations.  They are the only buffet opened 7/7 offering breakfast, lunch, dinner, special holiday meals, seafood night, champagne brunch and prices are reasonable.  The only other buffet that just opened for limited hours is the Wicked Spoon and their price is around $45.  South Point offers family friendly prices.  It is off the Strip, but that also means less crime.  Someone was recently killed on the pedestrian walkway between Bally's and the Cromwell and I believe he was a police officer with an Asian girlfriend.  South Point is SAFE!  Free parking. Asians welcomed. I am Asian. But there was one problem and it was the St. Patrick's day buffet.  What a waste of good food because it was cooked improperly.  Almost all the meats dry and over cooked -  the little steaks I couldn't cut with my knife, brisket all dried out a was the corn beef, trout, salmon, turkey, lamb, brisket - so I had almost a meat free meal.  And on the other hand vegetable under cooked and rubbery and hard to cut - cabbage, broccoli, carrots.  But the Mexican and Asian station are always consistent and the food is good at those stations.  Salad - you can't go wrong there and no problems with the dessert station.  Their red wine is very good.  The price is excellent - $12.99 for the St. Patrick's hotel buffet which included one glass or wine.  Service is great.  Atmosphere is comfortable.  A great place for families, seniors, and even single people.   The casino was busy and not deserted.  A lot of other restaurant facilities are also open so you do have a choice but what makes the buffet extra special is that while 39 other buffets have closed, this one pushed forward to open and it is part of the Las Vegas experience.

reviews.title: Bowling nationals USBC
reviews.text: We like staying at south point hotel and casino .. we have never had any trouble with our stay here , the management has always done everything they could to accommodate us even when our flight was changed we were comped 2 nights to help us ! Great pool and lots of entertainment in the hotel .. 2 bowling Alleys and anything else you want to not leave the property ! The dates were not March 2020 but many times and several years back to back .. the app wouldn’t let me change the date that far back ..

reviews.title: Las Vegas trip
reviews.text: A friend stayed at this hotel and we visited. It is children friendly has more activities for them so it nice for the family. All you need is here. Nice rooms. Fun slots. Kates koner ice cream shop was tasteful. Coffee shop was convenient and prices weren't ridiculous. Security is on it. If you are load and obnoxious you will get dealt with. Be sure to have your face mask on cause if not security will tell you if you eating after drink or eating must pull mask up or after smoking must put mask up after each puff.

reviews.title: A great place to stay and relax
reviews.text: Very comfortable , well maintained with very helpful staff and  a very secure atmosphere. The restaurants are as good or better than a lot of the other "strip" hotels and the casino has a relaxed feel along with free parking this this hotel and casino has everything you need for a great stay

reviews.title: Great Value!
reviews.text: This Casino is the best value in Vegas. The Casino has a wide variety of new Slot Machines as well as Gaming Tables,and Betting.I hope that you enjoy catching a movie, or bowling a few games on the well maintained lanes. Multiple bars, Dining, Cocktail Waiters and jackpots await. Price to lodge here is very reasonable, and standard rooms are well appointed and spacious.

reviews.title: Wonderful Stay, The Best
reviews.text: My wife and her friend stayed here while playing a golf tournament in Primm NV., after leaving the Primm Hotel which was a terrible place.  Everything about this hotel, casino was great.  The rooms were superior, the service was great and the restaurant  we ate at, The Steak House was very good.

reviews.title: The Casino is ripping people off when cashing out tickets at the Kiosks
reviews.text: Was playing some video poker on Saturday evening and when we were done, we cashed out our machines and put our tickets in the redemption kiosk and the machine provided all my paper money, but it did not provide the coin money.  It is literally stealing people's money a quarter at a time, etc.   It printed out a ticket, which thankfully I grabbed and walked the block and a half to the Cashiers cage.  I didn't even have to say anything to the employee at the cage. As soon as she saw me place the receipt on the counter, she slid my quarters to me and never said anything at all.   So this is what they are counting on.  That every customer that has coin left on the redemption ticket, that doesn't want to be bothered with walking all the way to the cashier, the casino keeps that money.  This is stealing!   For me, even though it was only 50 cents, it wasn't the money, it is the principal of the thing.  We put our money in your machines to play, but when you cash out, they steal your change.  This is not right so please beware!

reviews.title: Great pricing
reviews.text: A little disappointed the rewards account didn't offer any free slot play but impressed it offered discounts on dining. I took advantage of that.Enjoyed the atmosphere and the pricing was right. Will come back!

reviews.title: Nice independent casino
reviews.text: We really enjoyed this casino.  We were not winners, but our money lasted longer than other places.  They have a lot of different games, that I’d never seen before, which is always fun for me.  Plenty of places to eat.  Very friendly staff and a nice bar in the middle to sit and watch a football game, with no pressure to spend on drinks.  We had coffee.

reviews.title: relaxing fun
reviews.text: This hotel is beautiful,clean and has everything you could want for a visit without being in the crowds on the strip.  The pool is beautiful for a quick dip or just to lay in the sun.  They have many restaurants to chose from and the buffet was great.  We will go there again on our next visit.  the sanitizing stations were plentiful and always at your finger tips.

reviews.title: I wouldn’t stay here again
reviews.text: Unfortunately on our first full day we were awaken to a horrible sound. Turns out there was a fire under us. Our boys wanted to use the gym equipment as they are student athletes, even with our presence they were denied access. We couldn’t go back up to our room it was 6:30 in the morning and pretty much forced to leave. Considering we didn’t want to sit in a smoked filled casino. It was 6:30 am and our options were limited. I voiced my complaint to the front desk and was told there was nothing that could be done. We later returned and was given a refund for resort fees, really? We were also disappointed that the shuttle service wasn’t available. I understand our stay is during covid, the hotel is open, the Buffett is open, exactly what more of a risk to run the shuttle. My husband and I played bingo with my Mom, the staff in the hall was very helpful to us. Our housekeeper made sure our room was cleaned daily. Each day our room was cleaned well and smelled amazing.  Our boys enjoyed the bowling alley and game room. While in the casino we asked for drinks, the girls never came back on multiple occasions. We would rate our overall stay ok. I don’t think I’d ever stay here again. We only stayed here this time because my Mom loves the bingo hall. Not the worse stay but definitely not the best. The beds are a little hard. The hotel is clean but the casino is a cloud of smoke.

reviews.title: WONDERFUL OFF-STRIP HOTEL AND CASINO
reviews.text: Just returned from a six night stay at South Point Hotel and Casino.  Wonderful stay!  The rooms were clean and spacious.  Having a Keurig coffee maker and a frig in the room is an absolute plus! Due to Covid-19, there was no daily housekeeping, but the housekeeping staff were always quick to respond whenever we needed any clean towels, more coffee, etc.  The casino is nice, well-lit and bright.  They also have a bowling alley and movie theater.  The food at all the restaurants we visited was tasty and reasonably priced.  Would highly recommend this hotel to anyone planning a visit to Las Vegas.

reviews.title: The worst customer service....EVER!!
reviews.text: We stayed for an equestrian event from Sept 3 a Sept 6 and we accidentally left a medication in the room fridge. When we realized and called to have it picked-up or shipped, we were told it had not been kept cold since being found! Obviously, at this point it is no longer good. We were basically told by the Director of Hotels, Shelly Essex, ‘Well, you should not have left it in the room.’ Well, if we could all be as perfect as Ms. Essex, what a world it would be...huh!!?? Her lack of common decency/customer service was astounding. I will most likely making other arrangements in the future.

reviews.title: South Point Plus and Minus
reviews.text: As a local we decided to head over to South Point for a few nights - we had stayed there when the casino first opened and wanted to see how things progressed.Room Notes: South Point rates are decent and the rooms are large, they offer Keurig coffee makers, a frig and a safe.South Point checks your temperature at the check in desk but not for anyone entering the casino?  We found this to be odd since we have been going to numerous other casinos and the protocol has always been to check everyone entering.I was hoping to give South Point a higher rating, actually its a 3-1/2 stars because of the cleanliness of the elevator board, room and hallways.Lets start with check in and the casino.The Staff was Outstanding, Covid-19 compliant.Front desk accommodated us right away - the casino is clean with attendants handing out masks - friendly and very kind.The Casino was fun and we played the tables and slots.The tables offer low minimums which is nice also the waitress staff was always around. Plenty of modern slots - a real plus for South Point.Our room however was a different story.It had been poorly cleaned, with remnants of the previous occupant.Under the bed you can see debris that were never vacuumed, the floor with partially wet from moping & the floor wasn't even really cleaned. After walking around my shoes were sticking to the floor.In a pandemic world you would have thought that the room would be sanitized and spotless - I was afraid to touch things, so we cleaned the room ourselves including wiping down the floors. (Gross)Note: there is no daily room service in any hotel - so you have request new towels and amenities if needed.The hallway leading from the elevator to the room was also not vacuumed.There's a seating area between the elevator and hallway, it had cigarette ashes on the floor for two days .  On our last night someone just left a beer can in the same area that wasn't never picked up & was still there when we left the next day - it made the room experience very dumpy.The Pool area and service is very good, The pool waitress Destiny provided excellent service and was helpful with pool info questions.  As in the Casino there were attendants passing out masks to anyone who needed them.Buffet:  It's open and sanitary - at least when we went in the mornings for breakfast (it was still early) -so there weren't many peopleThey provided hand sanitizing stations throughout and everyone was wearing a mask.  The food is served for you by kitchen attendants (wearing masks and gloves) - all the food is protected by glass, this will probably be the future of buffet's for some time.Overall a number of good food choices, we didn't notice any bagels or toasters but we weren't looking for them.The omelet guy was a bit unfriendly and had an edge - my wife ordered eggs Sunnyside up, he barely cooked them and when she questioned it he said "this is what Sunnyside egg is" - that was horrible service, he should just said I'll cook them a little longer, what a jerk.I don't think well ever come back - if your looking for a discount it's ok

reviews.title: 3 1/2 Stars
reviews.text: Let me start by saying there is nothing wrong with South Point. I would rate it 3 1/2 stars or a little better than average. The room was clean and roomy. The staff was friendly. No complaints except that in my view, the bed was not all that comfortable. There was nothing that I experienced in the hotel that set it apart from others in the same price range. It was pretty average. The shower is a tub/shower combo which the newer hotels have moved past. I’ll likely stay here again as I enjoyed the poker room. The casino amenities and food options are a plus but that’s to be expected in a Las Vegas hotel.

reviews.title: Really nice hotel
reviews.text: We have been to South Point before.  It is clean and fully operational--valets, bellhops etc. The buffet was open and very good.  No wait to use elevators. Really a nice casino and experience.  Everything clean and nicely maintained.  Very professional, even during Covid.

reviews.title: Many Photos added. Excellent stay.
reviews.text: My wife and I stayed at the South Point on a Sunday stay. Large room, supper comfy bed, great shower and good choice of channels on the TV. Easy parking. Fantastic pool and gym. Great bowling center, casino, Race Book, Sports Book and restaurants. Super friendly staff. Management should be proud. Keep up the great work! Excellent stay and I will return.

reviews.title: Family Funeral
reviews.text: My wife and I stayed at the South Point Hotel. We stayed at this hotel seven years ago for a wedding. We remembered how nice the hotel was and how friendly/helpful the hotel was. So we decided to stay at the hotel again. Happily I’m glad to say that the hotel hasn’t changed. The rooms are spacious, clean, and affordable. The beds are comfortable. The showers have excellent water pressure. The room has great amenities with plenty of room in the closets. The hotel is not on the Las Vegas strip, so if you plan to go to the strip you will need to make arrangements. The hotel restaurants are excellent. The only problem I saw with the hotel was the following. When we stayed here last time, the hotel was relatively new. The air circulation was a lot better. Since the restaurants are not enclosed and next to the casino, you tend to get more cigarettes smoke than normal while at the restaurants. Otherwise the stay was worth the price and I still recommend the hotel.

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: 2/515 hours ago on  GoogleWell this trip to South Point started on the wrong foot. We were towing a car in a trailer. They had us park across the street with the big rigs. The giant parking lot was empty. You could have parked 100 trucks pulling trailers sans a concern for space, yet at 106 degrees we had to walk across the street to get in the casino. Then with only 3 people in line, we waited 30 minutes to check in. At 4:30 on a Friday night they had 1 person working the desk. This was when they first reopened during Covid. They would clean the credit card machine but made no effort to clean the counter everyone was leaning on. Then the room. Semi clean with papers left from a prior guest. So we wiped everything down. We were given discount coupons for drinks or a small % off a meal. We went down to try to get a drink and a meal with the coupons. Every bar and/or restaurant they gave us a coupon for was closed. What was the point? After we were told there was cocktail service in the lounge. So we went. Waited 20 minutes and had to go to the bar to ask for help. They were dismissive. Eventually a waitress came. When we ordered a second beer we were told we had to close out because she was going off shift. So the end result is the staff was dismissive, uncaring and the service was poor. The rooms are average, but be careful if they are or aren’t properly cleaned. They got 2 stars for price. But beware. The price bring the best people. Can’t wait for a Raider game. Therefore I am done with SP.

reviews.title: Spa Coastal Del Sur ( hair salon) inside southpoint
reviews.text: Koryn G (licensed Cosmetologist ) professional, the BEST. She took the time too listen an understand my needs in what I wanted my hair too look like.Set by far one of the best hair salons I've been to in quite some time. Well done and excellent job Koryn. I would highly recommend coming here and asking for this particular person to help you out on what you're looking for in your beauty look. Did a fabulous job. Thank you, thank you. Go see Spa Coastal Del Sur inside South Point Hotels and Casino.  Again thank you Koryn ( I'm always coming here for my hair, It's a long drive but it's worth it coming here southpoint. 😍😘

reviews.title: Good value for Las Vegas
reviews.text: We had a large room with a faux wood floor, a small table with two chairs, a desk and chair, dresser, and lounge chair.  We appreciated the Keurig.  The toilet/shower were separate from the sink.  The bathroom had poor lighting, but the lighted makeup mirror helped.  The shower head was good.  The bed was comfortable but sloped to one side.  It was quiet at night.  We got a  half-off breakfast buffet coupon.

reviews.title: First COVID-19 travel experience
reviews.text: While in line to check in for our five night stay our temperature was taken by a fixed scanner. Mine was taken again when I stopped at the front desk to ask a question. I find it odd that temperature was not taken for casino guests. Our room was clean and comfortable and we felt safe with the listed safety measures. Our only complaint with the hotel facilities was that our hallway did not appear to be vacuumed during our.The restaurants that were open appeared to have proper social spacing.The casino had every other slot machine turned off and the table games had half of the seats removed but less than fifty percent of the casino patrons wore masks.

reviews.title: Late Lunch
reviews.text: With five hours to killand with restaurants having only opened in the last few days, I thought it might be a good idea to have a leisurely lunch in Las Vegas. The strip hotels I stayed in I just enormous and beyond that, it costs a fortune to park.  I had heard good fast from locals about the south point, so I headed off to that casino. I found a parking spot next to the handicap area on the second floor. It was just a few feet to the elevator which opened up very close to what I believe is the main steakhouse. It did not open until 5 p.m. so I walked on several feet to a large Cafe. With my foot in a cast, distance was an important factor in my choices.  I couldn't have made a better choice. From the moment I walked in and was greeted by the hostess, everyone I encountered was very pleasant and helpful. Service was excellent!  my iced tea was replenished without my having to ask. My server as well as other staff members stop to make sure everything was okay. Not too often, just right.there were specials that truly were specials. As an example, chicken fried steak was about $18 or as the special prime rib was $14. I ordered that cut medium rare and enjoyed a simple but fresh dinner salad while waiting for my entre.I was pleasantly surprised when a 1 inch thick slab of meat carefully trimmed and cooked to just the right temperature was put before me.  It had to weigh a pound. It was so tender that I suspect it had been dry aged.  It was accompanied with baked potato and a saucer that held butter, sour cream and a horseradish sauce.  Not only was the restaurant stuff for light but so was the security officer I asked a question of as well as I believe a janitor type that directed me to a ticket cashing machine where I salvaged some of the money I had put into a slot machine!This was a large casino and there were many other restaurants and I'm sure shops that, due to buy condition, I was unable to explore.  But I'm anxious to return with my wife and was our daughters and their families when they come visit.

reviews.title: Stay away if you are afraid of covid - hotel is not ready to reopne
reviews.text: So it is opening day.  there are no body at the doors checking temperature or giving out free masks like at the orleans.  tables do not have sanitizer.  there are some additional sanitizer throughout the casino, but they are hard to find and see.  if you want a free mask you need to go to hotel check in area.  around 80% of people are not wearing masks.  the place is crowded.  it looks like people are making up for lost time.  every other slot machine is turned off.  i play poker so i went to the room.  they are 5 people games.  around 20 tables going,  the wait list was around 18 i gave up after an hour.  i tried the rewards kiosks all of them are off.  i was told there were no promotions at the moment.   the sanitizer in the casino is sticky.  better option is the orleans to gamble.

reviews.title: Love this hotel/ casino
reviews.text: Everything you could want under one roof! Great food, comfortable rooms, lively casino.  Don't have to go to the strip to have fun! Tour bus picked us up at hotel to go to Grand Canyon and Hoover Dam. Great sideline excursion!

reviews.title: south point best in vegas
reviews.text: south point best in vegas cant wait till covid 19 is over and we can go there ,great food ,great rooms ,good pool ,good gambling ,freindly staff ,from valet to waitress to bar tenders ,cleaning ladies,bingo staff ,gift shop,box office and special thanks to security staff who make you feel secure while on property , over all i want to be there yesterday but again covid 19 have to stay safe !!!!

reviews.title: 20 Time Customer
reviews.text: We watched South Point being built  as we drove into Vegas and we promised each other we would stay there when it opened, we’ll it opened and we’ve stayed there ever since. We’ve read reviews from other people but I have to say we haven’t experienced a bad stay yet.We don’t take advantage of the Gym or the Pool so we can’t comment on those. We always get a room with (2) Queen beds and  ask for a refrigerator, the room is 500 sq ft and plenty big enough for the two of us.We also stay on the lower level rooms so we can’t comment which rooms have a good view..We do take advantage of the Race and Sports Book and the Slots, the Horse betting area is one of the largest and have smoking and non smoking areas to sit and bet..We take advantage of the Fun Book they offer when you check in and use it at the Garden Buffet for Saturday Brunch ... We always have dinner at the Silverado Steakhouse Saturday night and stop at Steak and Shake for a late night snack..Parking your own car in the parking lot isn’t bad and it’s not much of a walk to the Casino or you can park in the parking garage..Before Southpoint we’ve stayed at the Frontier, The Stardust, Monte Carlo,The Aladdin, The Golden Nugget, The Silverton and a couple of hotel’s we’d like to forget on Koval between Tropicana and Flamingo ( I think they’ve been torn down).We are looking forward to our 21st stay when they open back up...

reviews.title: Visitors
reviews.text: Had a wonderful time.  Had to leave early through no fault of South Point.  Will be returning at the first opportunity or as soon as we are able to visit again and as soon as the Coronavirus pandemic allows.

reviews.title: Great casino and hotel
reviews.text: The Southpoint is located south of the airport on the strip. It is a very clean place with very friendly staff, free parking, many nice restaurants, cool things to do and reasonable prices. They have a large bar, the Grandview, as well as other bars on the premises.We stayed across the street so we were in the casino many times to eat and fool around. We can recommend Silverado Steakhouse, the Asian restaurant, the prime rib place Primarily Prime Rib, and the shops. The only place we would not recommend is Steak and Shake, please see our review for further details. We would have no hesitation staying at the Southpoint in the future.

reviews.title: Pool never open
reviews.text: On our last night, the pool was closed due to "poor weather", despite the weather being fine with blue skies and same as the previous day when the pool was open. Staff didn't care that our last day was ruined as we were unable to relax in the hot tub and instead had to wait in our room. Price we paid was not worth it as we were looking forward to enjoying the hot tub and pool. If visiting in the future beware, as you could be paying full price for a hotel that doesn't offer full amenities with a closed pool and hot tub due to poor weather even if there are blue skies and average temperatures. The only conclusion we can come to is the pool is unnecessarily closed for cost cutting measures.

reviews.title: Poor
reviews.text: Currently staying at South point hotel and casino. I usually visit this hotel due to the long opening hours of the pool and good facilities, have been visiting for years Sadly on this occasion standards have slipped. Foul smell on whole floor (22) Pool is currently 'closed' due poor weather despite it being sunny outside and no rain When asked if it will be open later - staff stated no and could not give a reason To top it off, we were told that there would be no discount on the resort fee as the pool is 'complimentary' - who knows what the resort fee actually covers here then Will be staying back on the strip from now on .

reviews.title: This place was a really good stay
reviews.text: Stayed here for a photo-booth convention and i was blown away by how convenient everything was. The food places where fairly priced, the customer service was very good, instead of getting liquor from a liquor store they have there own liquor store inside the hotel which had really good low prices . The room was nicely sized with a good view (13th floor). It was just really cool.No microwave in the rooms which is wack! but other than that 5 star rating.i would def come back to chill the strip was like $16 dollars away if u take uber but they have shuttles for that 2!

reviews.title: Dinning was Horrible
reviews.text: We stayed 3-1-20 thru 3-4-20. The room was OK nothing to write home about, even won some money on the slots however very bad drink service. Sports book is very good made some bets on this years Masters and was given three drink tickets which was very nice. The dinning however was another thing, went to the Buffett Sunday night and it was the worst food ever had in Las Vegas and been coming since 1985. I like my prime rib rare but what I was served was raw, I mean blood running all over the plate tried to cut a piece and could not. I contacted the sever and he appeared mad that I complained. Tried other things such as beef fajitas and the where too tough to eat. My wife also said all of the seafood items she tried were cold and horrible. Then are second meal was at Big Sur Oyster Bar for lunch on Monday. I had the Lobster roll and it was like a Tuna fish it was horrible could not eat it. My wife the Linguini & Clams and it was also not eatable. We paid the bill and got out of there and went down to Steak & Shake to get something we could eat. When we check out told the front desk clerk and she could have not cared less.

reviews.title: Very nice!
reviews.text: I had a very short trip through South Point but can't wait to go back. Off strip, but it has everything you might need.  Plenty of restaurants and gambling. The rooms were very clean and I felt safe and secure.  The doors are very solid, and shut very loudly so that look some getting used to.

reviews.title: South Point is awesome!
reviews.text: We stay here often and always love it!  Plenty of Restaurants to try.  The pool area is great.  If you have children with you but you would still like to play then They ALSO have activities for them.  Bowling and Theater right in the Hotel.  It's a very quick drive to the strip if you want to do some sight seeing.  I personally love to take my exchange students to Hershey Store, M&M world and Coco Cola store.  The price is right and you miss the horrible traffic of the city.  Enjoy!

reviews.title: More 3.5 - interesting stay
reviews.text: I stayed at the South Point for 4 days over the February NASCAR weekend and, for a "non-Vegas" guy, it was a very interesting stay.  I booked the highest end NASCAR package, which included race tickets and transportation to and from the track.  The casino is owned by the family of a long-time driver and many of the teams/crews stay there during the weekend, leading to some completely random interactions.The hotel is about a $20.00 - $30.00 cab ride from the airport (depending on the time of day) and about $35.00 to the strip.  Parking is free at the hotel and it is a crapshoot (pun intended) when it comes to renting a car.  There is a scheduled airport shuttle, but it does not operate for late night departures or arrivals.As for the hotel, registration is to the right from the main entrance and amidst the rather large casino floor.  The staff was pleasant and explained the aspects of the package and I received 2 coupon books good for food and gift shop discounts and multiple free drinks.There are multiple restaurants with a wide variety of cuisine.  I ate at Baja Miguel's (fine), Primarily Prime Rib (disappointing and expensive) and the less formal but very good Big Sur Oyster Bar (right on the casino floor).  The Garden Buffet was actually very good at a very reasonable price (which is discounted for club members) and the Coronado Cafe was also fine.As for the casino, there were numerous table games, with a sprinkling of $5.00 tables, but most were in the $15.00 - $25.00 range and there were also multiple slots and video poker machines.  It was relatively crowded the entire weekend and it was very low intensity.  The sports book was tucked off the side of the floor and while there were multiple screens, it was a little forlorn and could use an upgrade.As for my room, I was on the 16th floor and, most notable, it had a wood laminate like floor with no carpeting at all.  The bathroom had a full tub and shower and there was a mini-fridge which could be stocked at the gift shop downstairs.  The bed was fine and there were multiple charging stations.  The best description of the room is probably "functional".The pool area is rather large and quite attractive and the hotel also features a 16 screen movie theater, a huge bowling alley, bingo hall, a medium-sized arena (a horse show was taking place over the weekend) and multiple conference rooms.During my stay, the resort was bustling and this is a good off-the-strip alternative to downtown.  I would absolutely stay again for NASCAR weekend.  For other stays and in my personal circumstances, probably not.

reviews.title: Easy place to stay in Vegas
reviews.text: We enjoyed our stay at South Pointe. It is friendly. Nice to be away from the busyness if the strip. Easy free parking. I enjoyed the yoga classes Friday,Saturday, and Sunday. The pool and hot tub were a great temperature and very relaxing. Plenty of lounge chairs and good music there. We ate breakfast at the Garden Buffet which was huge and very good. Did not like the smoke in the casino itself. We would stay here again. The rooms were great.

reviews.title: Business and Pleasure
reviews.text: I recently attended an industry convention at the South Point Hotel. My husband accompanied me. The room was spacious, well designed and the bed was very comfortable. They have a fantastic pool and hot tub ( it’s more like a hot river that encircles an island-very nice). We don’t gamble but the casino was huge and surprisingly not as smoky as I anticipated. I never felt “yucky” after walking through it. During our free time we saw a movie in the giant theater complex ( clean and comfy), and went bowling ( 70 lanes-largest bowling alley I’ve ever been in). One night we took advantage of happy hour (4-6) at one of the many restaurants. This one was the bar attached to the Mexican restaurant ( great food-we had dinner there). Margaritas ( very good, not the super cheap ones we’ve seen on other casinos), well drinks and beer were $3 each and bar food was half off. We had three drinks, chips with beans and guacamole and two tacos for $17- such a deal! For horse lovers, the hotel has a huge area and stadium seating and hosts completions and horse shows there. This was an unexpected feature that we found very interesting. Overall, we thought the hotel was great on all levels-cleanliness, service and and amenities. Good for business and pleasure.

reviews.title: Varied restaurants for diverse tastes.
reviews.text: Lovely, large casino.  Very clean, pleasant atmosphere,  Staff is very professional and friendly.  I would return anytime. The restaurants provide varied menus and each has lovely surroundings.  Many varied forms of entertainment available.

reviews.title: Our First Time to Stay at South Point
reviews.text: We have been going to Las Vegas for over 20 years and have stayed at numerous hotels.  We decided to give South Point a try and we were not disappointed. We arrived on a Tuesday around noon and were surprised that our room was ready and no extra charge for this.  Great news.  Our room had hardwood floors with soft plush towels and bedding.  Ample electrical outlets and numerous tv channels.  They have an airport shuttle but we did not use it.  The casino is bright and very large.  They have a great variety of slots, video poker and table games.  You will need a car if you want to go to the strip or downtown but you can’t go wrong with staying here.

reviews.title: Just an overnight
reviews.text: Stayed at south point hotel on a trip back from SAN diego. Was pleasantly surprised. Very clean, staff was courteous, and casino was fun. When back in Vegas would not hesitate to stay there. A little off the beaten path but nice.

reviews.title: Everything in one place
reviews.text: Was here for a convention (one of many annually in Vegas). For some one who doesn't need the "strip" this is the place. Multiple restaurants (prime rib, Mexican, Italian, Deli, Oyster bar to name a few.Ample tables and slots for the gambler, movie theater with current movies and a bowling alley and a horse arena with regular event.Rooms are big and clean1 of the best shoe shine stands anywhere!!!$15.00 Uber to the strip or Fremont street.great spot no matter why your in town!!

reviews.title: It’s always a good time
reviews.text: South Point is always a stopping point or a place to stay whenever we are in Vegas. First we really appreciate the parking lot across the street for RVs or semi’s. (I’ll touch on this later) The rooms are clean and staff is always friendly. For the most part we can usually use our comps for our stay even during the busy times. Another key part is that they offer free parking. Not like the other casinos on the strip that want $20 to park.  In my opinion if I’m going into a casino I’m going to drop more than that in slots and the $20 to park takes me away from entering those other casinos. Since we are on the subject of parking. There has be a couple times that the parking across the street was closed off for an event so we saw some other RVs parked in the main parking lot. So we fell suit and parked with the rest and found out as we where leaving that we can’t park there and the security told us to park on the street over. I mean he was totally cool but I think they could have told us since they saw us pull in. But none the less I always enjoy staying and playing here. See you soon.

reviews.title: Las Vegas Shoot
reviews.text: I recently attended this venue of over 8000 attendees, and both the hotel and conference staff consistently went above and beyond to ensure my stay was excellent in all areas.  My only complaint is that there were parts of the hotel with an abundance of cigarette smoke around, but this is to be expected at a Vegas casino resort.  My room was terrific, clean and with a great view.

reviews.title: A Cool Buffet
reviews.text: I was disappointed in the lack of heat for most of the dining choices. I alerted the manager, who seemed disengaged with my conversation. She said she would have it checked. I was leaving the buffet when I finally got her attention. I was worried about the health situation of food not being at the proper temperature, especially since I had attempted to eat some. The snack bar has enjoyable convenience food at great prices.

reviews.title: Comfortable night just outside vegas strip
reviews.text: Beautiful clean an d spacious room. Disconcerting to walk through lots of slots and casino. Would I go again? Maybe. It is a massive hotel. Service is good but very American. Lots of restaurants and bars but we did not use them

reviews.title: Great Casino
reviews.text: Was staying at the Grandview next door but spent a lot of time in South Point. Fantastic and reasonably priced dining options, enjoyed the movie theatre and bowling alley. Great poker room and slot club too.

reviews.title: Budget-Friendly Vacation Option in  Vegas
reviews.text: South Point offers a respectable room product and wide variety of dining and entertainment options packed with a number of valuable perks that make this property a great option for budget-conscious travelers.   The hotel offers free airport shuttles and discount drink and meal vouchers at check in as well as a resort fee that is 50% less than the major strip properties.While it lacks the glitz and glamour of the resorts in the heart of the city, it offers all of the gambling options and many other entertainment options including a movie theatre and bowling alley for room rates that are priced well below the strip hotels.So for a Vegas experience at savings that can approach 50% or more compared to the mega MGM / Caesars resorts, this is certainly a property that merits a look

reviews.title: South Point Warm, Comfortable, and Quiet Relaxation Oasis
reviews.text: Our annual Mecum Motorcycle Auction visit to the South Point brought us back for another weeklong visit January 20-27, 2020.  After five years, each visit is better than the last.  Nothing much changed since our last long visit, the hotel staff is quietly efficient, everything is spotlessly clean, and the many restaurants are all in good form.  We have a lot of business to take care of during the auction, so we rarely leave the hotel when it's time for a meal.For us and our many friends, we find it hard to beat the Coronado Cafe, which has a very large menu, reasonable prices, and very good food with service to match.  This is a large place with a high meal volume (especially for breakfast) but the line moves fast and the wait never too long.  We also made time to eat many dinners here (look at the Daily Specials) and there is a full Chinese menu available too.  Everything is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week,  and if you're dining alone there is a nice long counter with bar stools to sit on.The rooms are very clean and well serviced every day by an attentive staff.  A lot of the rooms on the North side of the building have nice views of the downtown skyline.  During our visit we also ate excellent dinners at Asian Fusion, Don Vito's, and the Mexican place upstairs off the casino floor.  Every meal was perfect.  We all enjoyed our stay and look forward to returning every January to the South Point.  Highly recommended!

reviews.title: excellent review
reviews.text: South Pointe is a excellent Hotel and Resort for the whole family.  It has all the amenities for the whole family (great spa, swimming pool for adults, teenagers, and little ones,movies threatre, bowling alley, arcade area, great shows for adults, and a variety of great restaurants.

reviews.title: This has got to be the best casino in Vegas
reviews.text: By comparison to the larger chain casinos this one is the best.  It has something for everyone to do, if you like to gamble the odds are better than most.  Like to bet on a game, large sports book, play holdem large poker room.  Rooms are nice, I like that they don't have carpet, so you know what  you are stepping in.

reviews.title: Great rooms & good food
reviews.text: Pleasantly surprised at the high quality at South Point! We had not stayed here for several years, as we usually opt for a hotel on the Strip. The rooms are clean, comfortable, and look great. The restaurants exceeded our expectations; the quality of the food and service was very good, especially for such reasonable prices. We had a fantastic meal at Zenshin during their half-price happy hour (and the meal would have still been a great value at full price). We would definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: Southpoint Casino
reviews.text: Good casino away from the madness of the main strip has great facilities and Don Vito restaurant is a must. Plenty of parking which is free unlike many on the strip.Has a bowling alley and cinema that offer discounts for over 55's

reviews.title: Nice getaway
reviews.text: We stayed here on Christmas Eve and Christmas Day. The hotel was decorated nicely. The rooms were spacious and they even gave you slippers to wear. The staff were courteous and attentive. We would stay here again.

reviews.title: The Coronado Cafe
reviews.text: As locals, we and our friends, enjoy eating at the Coronado Café at the South Point Hotel and Casino.  Both the food and service keep us coming back!  Had lunch there again last Thursday.  Bet and our guest had Chinese, and I had the Prime Rib Special.  Too much great food at a more than fair price.

reviews.title: Mecum auction visit
reviews.text: We stayed here last year, great hotel, not as busy as the strip, check in and out was friendly and easy, plenty of nice restaurants, bars, gambling, hostesses are attentive, Don Vito’s serves the best Lasagna I have ever had, room was clean and tidy, comfy bed, nice products in the bathroom. Hope I get to visit again soon.

reviews.title: Excellent All-Around, Would Stay Again
reviews.text: We were very impressed with our stay at the South Point. The customer service was excellent, our room was very spacious, quiet and clean, and the location was perfect, being close to the Strip yet just far enough to way to be out of the chaos. We found the hotel to have everything we could need as well. We took advantage of the movie theater, there was good variety with the restaurants, and the cost-effective buffet definitely hit the spot each morning. We will definitely stay here again on our next visit!

reviews.title: Great Hotel
reviews.text: The room was clean,  housekeeping did a good job. There are a diversity of restaurants (Italian , Mexican, Chinese, seafood, steak houses, huge buffet), The customer service was great, and the have a wide variety of arena events. There also is a spa, pool, bowling alley, and movie theater and gift shop.

reviews.title: Had a great time
reviews.text: Casino was busy so did get smokey. Restaurants were great! We especially enjoyed Zenshin. Loved the bowling alley and movies on site. Beautiful pool and hot tub area. No complaints about our room at all.

reviews.title: Great Hotel and Casino
reviews.text: It’s a very nice place to stay while visiting the Mojave National Preserve, which is about 60 miles south of South Point. They have several excellent restaurants and a very large casino. Their staff is helpful and very accommodating. We always stay there on our trips to the desert.

reviews.title: Awesome Day!!!
reviews.text: Decided to take a break from the Strip and 6 of us headed to South Point.  Plan was to grab some lunch at the Cafe and check it out.  Ending up staying there until midnight.  Cafe breakfast lunch/breakfast was great!  Played blackjack for hours.  Good table minimums and pays 3/2.  They also have double deck pitch was is my favorite.  A couple of us decided to enter the 2 p.m. poker tournament.  Well run, great room!!! Cashed!!  Hit the tables again then we decided to grab dinner at the Silverado Steak House which was recommended by one of the dealers.  Great dinner, nice ambiance, good wine and service,  very reasonable compared to the strip.  Hit the tables again for a couple of hours before taking off.  I believe this will be my new "Go to".  Next trip we will stay here and take the trip to the strip for a day.  Love SP!!!

reviews.title: Off Strip hotel with Strip feel.
reviews.text: Large hotel with casino off main part of strip in Vegas. Rooms are large and nice - mine was clean and I liked that they don't have carpet. There was a small fridge in the room. The casino isn't as large as what you would find on the strip, but is brighter and cleaner than those downtown. Drink prices were reasonable. Hotel got mixed reviews from others at the conference I was at, but I didn't have any problems and would stay there again. The only negative from my perspective was that the ventilation system in the casino here doesn't seem quite as good as most of the larger casinos - there's quite a bit of cigarette smoke smell. It isn't overpowering, but if you have respiratory issues it's something to be aware of. There's also a movie theater and a huge bowling alley on site which was fun.

reviews.title: Rooms Good - Far From Strip
reviews.text: Stayed during CES 2020. Rooms were large and clean which is the main thing. It is a distance from the main activity and if this suits then it is ideal. The Casino is the usual as expected but is good value for Alcohol versus the strip Casinos. I probably would not stay again but this is only because of the distance from where I needed to be.

reviews.title: 1 night stay.
reviews.text: thank you so much for the opportunity to stay in your beautiful and  well known HOTEL AND CASINO.and a  favorite   of so many not only locals; from all the other states and tourist all over the world..   more power.

reviews.title: Massive hotel
reviews.text: We got put here last night as our flight was delayed. Very fancy for us, huge place!! Didn't get to experience much just two restaurants. The meal vouchers we were given were a major pain as buffet restaurant had to enter them individually which took over 20 minutes. Then the one place wouldn't take them for breakfast. The smoothie place needed a printed copy so we had to go to the business centre to get them printed! The lady in there was super helpful & fabulous!! Couldn't book seat on shuttle as have to 24 hours in advance, we weren't there 24 hours in advance! Had to laugh as my 15 year son was waiting for his Dad to play his $2 on the slots & told he couldn't watch as under 21. So he took one step back & played on his phone! No problem!

reviews.title: Steaks and shakes
reviews.text: I only walked in to kill time but found a restaurant named Steaks and Shakes. An unexpected find that had a really good chili dish. The 5-point chili. It had everything. And they served it over spaghetti noodles. As it turned out, a brilliant decision. Smothered in grated sharp cheddar cheese and cooked to perfection.

reviews.title: Fantastic Place with fantastic people
reviews.text: This hotel and their people (staff and hosts) will make you enjoy your stay every time.I've been going to this casino for over 10 years now......never stay anywhere else. We go on average 2 or 3 times per year.  I am a poker palyer...and love their poker room,  My wife loves the bingo hall....and is there almost every session while we are visitingThe people (staff and hosts) are so friendly....and we have made friends with most of them. A lot of them know us by name immediately when we see them....and are always trying to make our trip as great as possible.Want to know how great a hotel is?  Find out what the employees have to say!  All the ones that we talk to have nothing but praise for the owners and managers of the South Point Casino and many have been working there for years and years.Also, if you are a "casual" gambler.......you will be able to eat at the buffet, diner or cafe for next to no cost. They will likely not refuse you this benefit......all you have to do is ASK!!!.   My wife and I have been enjoying this perk for over 10 years. ....and we are not huge gamblers. There point/cash back system is the best that we have found.  Always take advantage of their offers.  My wife always enjoys her Monday bingo sessions because her points have "double" cash value on that day.  She can play bingo almost all day at no cost .. from points earned playing while we were there or maybe points carried fwd from the last trip.....Your points never expire!!!  that I've noticed  anyhow.

reviews.title: Good if your not interested in strip or downtown.
reviews.text: Place was clean and the rooms were good sized.  Food is typical, dried out tasteless crap as every other casino.  There is no concierge, there is no shuttle to the strip, which is 10 miles down Las Vegas Blvd.  probably will not stay here again.

reviews.title: Awesome!
reviews.text: This is a late review due to holidays and being busy. We originally booked another hotel, which fell through.  I literally booked with south point, the Sunday before Thanksgiving and just 3 hours before we were destined to arrive and I was a able to get in with out a problem. In fact, I was able to cook 2 rooms.  The rooms were phenomenal.  So spacious,  comfortable,  newer looking and quiet.  Since we were staying for a few days, there was so much room to move around and not have to be kn top of one another. I utilized the gym every day, which was awesome. One of the best hotel gyms I have ever seen. It was so nice, clean, roomie and had every piece of equipment along with more than enough treadmills. Usually it's tough to even find an available treadmill at other hotels. We also utilized the spa and barber salon. The staff at the salon were super friendly and my 11 year was happy. We were able to go the movies and had a variety of eating places to choose from. We also were able to leave the kids in the room and feel safe about it while we went to watch games down at the bar. I definitely recommend this hotel to anyone and will definitely stay again.

reviews.title: D3 Hoops Tournament
reviews.text: No need to leave this resort unless you want to! Plenty of restaurants to choose from, casino, movie theater, bowling alley and bingo. Equestrian arena and sometimes basketball arena. Comfortable clean rooms. Highly recommend!

reviews.title: A Great Overall Experience!
reviews.text: Checking in was quick and easy and the girl at the registration desk was delightful.  The room was beautiful, clean and comfortable.  Restaurants were a wide variety, from burgers to steak houses to pasta and even sushi.  The movie theatre was well worth the visit, with large recliner seating and extreme digital (a little loud for me and I had to put cotton in my ears, so beware of that feature)!  Gambling was up and down, as it is in most casinos, but their tables were constantly full and people seemed to enjoy themselves.  The price was right around $100 a night for the room after all the fees were added.  I would definitely stay here again, and because they had so many things available right there, we never left there the three days we stayed!  The coffee shop had excellent coffee and the Coronado Cafe was a great breakfast start to the day.  Enjoy!

reviews.title: One Night, no more
reviews.text: Spent one night because weather delay on i15 turned back traffic to CA. Good venue for craps, $5 table, double odds. Crowded, traditional casino format. Cattle-like food courts, prepare to stand in line for mediocre food at mostly every restraunt. Front desk, matter of fact, not friendly but not antagonistic either. Found a lower rate on internet, they made me register on that site to get a 13 dollar difference. This underscores my point. They push people in and out. If you stay, don't anticipate customer attention. In fact, don't expect much, and then you will be OK. Rooms are mediocre, like the beds. Our bed had seen better days. Won't be back here to stay, but then again hadn't really planned to stop here in the first place. Regulars probably like the bingo and movie theaters which is a draw. But then again, the theatre seats are not too comfortable. So, you get what you pay for.

reviews.title: Not so much
reviews.text: Although the staff was friendly and the room was nicely laid out, I wouldn't do it again.The bed was really hard and unwelcoming, the pillows matched.  Most importantly, and most disturbingly, the shower produced nothing better than not-quite lukewarm water.Too be fair, when we reported that at checkout, they did drop the $21 resort fee, which was nice.  I'd rather have had a hot shower.We had dinner at the Mexican place.  It was...adequate.

reviews.title: A Nice Place to Stay
reviews.text: I'd say it's out of the way, but one can get anywhere from anywhere in Vegas.  This hotel is a few miles from the Strip but we were fine with that.  We stayed at the South Point because it was the venue for a Basketball Tournament we were there to see.  The hotel, itself, is clean, nice rooms, decent restaurants.  We liked that there were movie theaters on-site, as well.  The room was large and mostly quiet.  There were a lot of high school kids at the hotel for various tournaments.  The casino was very kind to me and I came home with my gambling money and then some - even after expenses!  We'd stay again.

reviews.title: Southpoint December 2019
reviews.text: As always the Southpoint didn't disappoint. I was in town for a convention and they took great care of us as they do each year. I hadn't tried the deli until this year and I had several meals there and they were all delicious. As well, the banquet food is fabulous even though you wouldn't think serving 800 people could be. No disappointment!

reviews.title: Thanksgiving 2019
reviews.text: Great hotel and casino.  Quick check-in.  Large, clean rooms.  Casino had everything you would need.  Great food choices also.  Friendly staff.  I would recommend this hotel and casino for all types of stay.  Family friendly too.

reviews.title: Great
reviews.text: Our trip was great, the stay was great and the casino was the best, we didn't have to go to another casino the whole 6 day stay. Our next trip will be in Jan or April and we will be staying there. The restaraunts were great places to eat. The staff was helpful and we had a great time.

reviews.title: BEST HOTEL IN LAS VEGAS
reviews.text: We absolutely love the South Point.  The Rooms are spacious and renovated; Excellent Variety of Restaurants, Tremendous Equine Events, Courteous Staff, Movies and other activities. We have stayed here since it opened and never been disappointed.

reviews.title: Awesome as always
reviews.text: SouthPoint Casino always delivers the best family experience in Las Vegas. There is always something to do there with the family.  Even without the kidos, we always stay at Southpoint.  Best restaurants,  best entertainment,  best payouts on slots!!!! Always come home a winner from Southpoint casino!!!

reviews.title: Ok
reviews.text: Last minute booking just to break our trip to Grand Canyon.Hotel is not close to the center, about 15 min driving. A bit old but at least the room was clean.More then one night don’t think I will chose this one

reviews.title: Poor customer service Dated 1bedroom suites
reviews.text: First I would like to say this is an honest non bias review of th Southpoint hotel. Pros: In house amenities like a bowling alley, movie theater and numerous restaurants. Clean rooms. Free self parking.Cons: Discriminatory,Judgemental service and front desk staff. Poor customer service. Hotel is far south strip. One bedroom suites are very dated. Poor players card system.Poor security, shady characters walking about property.We stayed in a one bedroom suite at this hotel Thanksgiving weekend. I was so excited to get a 1 bedroom as this would be a different experience. As soon as we get to the front desk to check in, the clerk made us wait so she may help a caucasian couple behind us. When she did help us she was very condescending when she spoke to me and my husband. She treated us terribly. Ate at baha Miguel's and the waitress rolled her eyes at us and made an ugly face like she did not want to help us. Then made us wait 20 minutes before she took our order. We ended up canceling our order and walked out. To top it off every time we walked to our room there was a security booth next to the elevator and security kept hassling my husband and making grunting sounds and scratching their throats loudly and asking to see his room key every time we walked to our room as if to say we do not belong there. We did not observe this type of behavior with any other individuals who were not a minority. I have more to say but this review would be too long. I would like to give them another chance but I would recommend staying at another hotel or at least consider other options before choosing this hotel.

reviews.title: Business and pleasure trip
reviews.text: Very comfortable hotel, reasonably priced and $2.00 drinks. It’s about a $15.00 Uber ride to the center of the strip. The staff at the South Point is very friendly and helpful, they have good restaurants there anything from a deli sandwich to top of the line restaurants. Highly recommend the South Point.

reviews.title: Love It!
reviews.text: I travel to Las Vegas for business each quarter. This has become my go to. Great value, friendly staff , comfortable rooms and great restaurants! I have even caught a movie or two. Love the race and sports book and have even won money on the slots each of  three  times I have stayed there. And don't miss the M Town Review-wow, what an amazing show! Looking forward to my next stay in March!

reviews.title: Buffet
reviews.text: We decided to go to a movie and make an afternoon. Lots of choices and always clean. Do we go to a restaurant or buffet?We chose correctly with so many options. Vegan, Vegetarian, halal, paleo and so many varieties.Come on down?

reviews.title: Another nice experience
reviews.text: My 3rd visit to South Point Casino. An amazing place. The Italian restaurant, "Don Vitos" was excellent. Even the buffet didn't disappoint. The staff were all courteous, and there is a lot of security, which I always like to see.

reviews.title: Amazing Casino-You’ll never want to Leave
reviews.text: South Point has EVERYTHING you need! Well lit casino, beautiful entrance. Great slots, they pay out well. You have a movie theater, bowling, bingo, 11 restaurants, bars, tables, shows, etc! Valet parking is free. It is NOT on the strip, nor is it walking distance to the strip. Youndo need to drive, Uber, left or catch a shuttle there. If you want a place away from the noisy hustle & bustle of The Vegas Strip—this is the place to be!

reviews.title: Great Hotel and Casino!
reviews.text: We had stayed here previously and returned for a quick getaway!  The rooms are very nice and large and have hardwood floors throughout.  There are 11 restaurants and the buffets are very good.  The Cafe has a late night menu that is less than $5.00.  Lots of slots and tables in the casino.  The price is great if you're not looking to be on the Strip.  (Uber costs about $16 to get to the Strip.)  Definitely recommend.

reviews.title: A great place to stay with plenty of dining choices.
reviews.text: The room was spacious enough and while the decor was not "modern", it was neat and clean.  I especially like the fact that there was no carpet in the room (I'm one who believes in strange critters living in hotel carpets).Bathroom was spacious.  Separate sink in one room and toilet w/shower & tub in another room (with door, for those who prefer extreme privacy).AC/heater was working properly and not that noisy.  Check in staff was quick and polite.Hotel/casino was close to the airport.  There is also a plethora of dining choices, and if you're into video poker, there are plenty of those.If you want to be close to the Strip, then this is not the place for you.  Otherwise, I have no complaints.  I try to actually stay away from the people and the strip.  Pricing for food and drinks are also substantially lower here too,

reviews.title: A chimney
reviews.text: This place is a Chimney horrible.  A smoker's paradise  and  with food being served  inside a casino do the math.  I just got in town and its  despicable  I will tell everyone  do not come here if you do not  smoke. You will asthma  or bronchitis  after you leave or lung cancer after you leave. 2nd hand smoke is real bell men are pathetic Las Vegas is very overrated

reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.text: We have been staying at South Point Hotel and Casino for 8 years or more and have never been disappointed.  The staff are wonderful, helpful and very friendly.  This is a very clean hotel due to the fact they are constantly cleaning everything, including the slot machines.  We would not think of staying any where else in Las Vegas.  The convenience of the location. Easy to get down town.  We do recommend this facility to anyone.

reviews.title: Ongoing relationship with South Points.
reviews.text: My wife and I have been visiting Las Vegas yearly for over 15 years. We've been everywhere and seen everything that Vegas has to offer. We love South Pointe because it has everything we look for on our visits. Fine accommodations, great restaurants of every variety, a great casino whether you're a high roller or novice, and a friendly helpful staff. It is not directly on the "strip" but we've done the strip and no longer get excited being in lots of foot traffic and the automobile traffic. Bowling, movie theater, spa and pool area as well as entertainment are all there at South Pointe.

reviews.title: Our new go-to Vegas destination!
reviews.text: Loved this place-highly reccommend. Had everything we needed and wanted. We go every year and this year was the first at South Point. For our interests it was perfect. We wont stay anywhere else again.

reviews.title: Don't leave valuables in your car at Southpoint Hotel and Casino
reviews.text: We stayed at your hotel 11-8 thru 11-11 for a baseball tournament my son was playing in.  On Saturday evening we heard an announcement over the casino PA that our car was broken into.  We contacted security and went to where we parked our car in the open lot outside the hotel.  Our back window had been broken out and they stole my sons baseball bag.  Security told us that the event was caught on camera and recorded the people drive up and smash our window and remove the bag.   I am aware of the signs posted all over the place that South Point is not responsible for damage to any vehicle of theft of items left in the car.  The troubling thing to me is that both on Friday and Saturday when we returned to the hotel we witnessed multiple cases of people hanging out in cars and smoking pot while listening to music.  The security guard also told us that this type of theft happens all the time.   If this is the case why does your casino not employ more strict controls for people entering and leaving the parking lot.  Also, why are people allowed to loiter in your parking lot while security patrols the lots regularly.  The theft happened shortly after we parked the car.  It seems that somebody might have been watching us with my son in his baseball uniform leave our car without his baseball bag.  Why else would they randomly break our window out of all the other cars in the lot.  You are not doing enough to prevent this kind of theft.  You easily could put security points at the exits to the lot to prevent people from doing this.  Again, your security guard said this happens all the time yet you are doing nothing to prevent this. The value of the contents of the bag was nearly $1000 not to mention the cost to replace the window which is coming out of our pocket since it is below our deductible. You should make your customer's even more aware of the potential of theft since it seems to happen often.  Yes it is my fault for leaving the bag in the car, but I thought the risk was low since you seem to be  reputable hotel in a seemingly safe area.  This event really put a damper on an otherwise memorable weekend for my son and family. Hopefully you take this problem serious and do more to protect the property of your paying customers.

reviews.title: Beautiful casino
reviews.text: Truly loved our family stay here. It’s very friendly environment. The pool area was beautiful! Loved all the food choices the breakfast buffet with check in coupon is $4.95 it was really good. Steak and shake had 1/2 price milkshakes from 2-5 came to $2.19 for a great mid day snack. The bowling alley and movie theater were great again for a snack in coupon book is a free popcorn don’t have to see a movie to get it. We got to watch a bull riding show in equisetum really big cool place BIG. We took Uber trips to strip there are drivers parked outside never had to wait more then 2-3 mins to get a driver came to $18 RT beats parking fees and driving through the crazies the drivers know short cuts if traffic is bad. It’s right across the street from a McDonald’s and Denny’s but we loved eating at all the choices the hotel had. There is a fridge in room water will cost you $3 a bottle. Big safe and TV in room! I would def recommend this casino it truly has it all.....

reviews.title: A Week of Bulls and Cowboys, The PBR Finals
reviews.text: This is a refreshing change from the insanity of the strip and Fremont Street.  Located away, but not far from the strip and the airport it is an excellent location.  We were at the casino during the Professional Bull Riders Final.  A nice sized arena featured bull riding, miniature bull riding and bull fighting finals.  There was a large expo area that was filled with shopping opportunities for the PBR fans.   The staff and dealers are friendly and efficient and everything is clean. Good selection of machines and tables.  For your food- coffee, ice cream, burgers, sushi, steaks, seafood, deli, bakery and buffet.  Bowling alley, large movie theatre are also available.  Most prices were very reasonable.

reviews.title: Vacation in Las Vegas
reviews.text: I visited South Point an had a wonderful buffet dinner, the service at this hotel is 5 star.I will be their again in December and can't wait.Also the Hotel is so clean.The door man are so polite and friendly, plenty of parking facility, my Grand kids had w wonderful time in the games room, they where their for 2 whole hours.

reviews.title: very entertaining venue
reviews.text: their's so much to do there, we when bowling, then there was a rodeo going on and we went there, saw a movie in the afternoon, plenty of places to eat and then we gambled a little later, plenty of bars, easy to get a drink, had a starbucks if you prefer coffee. a hot dog vender for a little snack when you get hungry

reviews.title: This place is awesome!
reviews.text: This Casino is just off the Strip, and well worth the drive! The casino is huge, the machines are user friendly. The rooms are comfortable and roomy. The price isn’t bad, and the valet parking is free, just tip the attendants. If you’re tired of the crowds on the Strip, this is the place you are looking for!

reviews.title: Not accommodating at all!
reviews.text: This was by far the least accommodating hotel I've ever stayed at. The front desk staff and the front desk manager were not willing to work with me to help me in my situation, not even to come to a halfway point. They were very rude when we were asking what they could do to help. They even suggested that I find someone to go and pack up my stuff in the room. Really?! They were more worried about the next guest checking in than they were about trying to find a way to help me. I will never stay here again. With all the hotels you can choose from in Vegas, do not choose this one.

reviews.title: Great buffet/ bunch.
reviews.text: Good omelets they have everything you want in a good buffet. Good pies to, I took my 87 year old mom and they sat us close to the food, I haven eaten there several times. Will stop again well worth it

reviews.title: An Accidental Discovery
reviews.text: My husband, a friend, and I were sent to South Point by American Airlines when our flight home was delayed for 20 hours (not that American told us the extent of the delay for a LONG time, and they never admitted that the plane had mechanical difficulties).
