We found the casino to be well-lit and clean, with lots of restaurant choices.  Our room was beautiful, far nicer than the rooms we had had at the other two places we had stayed.  (It did smell odd; I think that the flooring was probably newly installed.)  I would consider staying at South Point again, though I would probably play video poker elsewhere.  My only complaint was that when I called to inform the hotel that displaced American passengers were numerous enough to require a second shuttle (as we had already waited 45 minutes for the next one), the woman to whom I spoke refused to send another, so five people had to wait nearly two hours (after already sitting at LAS for 8+ hours) for the next "courtesy" shuttle.  Furthermore, the morning shuttle did not depart early enough to convey us back to McCarran.  (Admittedly, American Airlines should have called the hotel to ask for more frequent shuttle service, but AA's customer service leaves a lot to be desired.)

reviews.title: Great place but very busy
reviews.text: We stayed at the South Point in Mid October while in town for an event. The lobby was clean and well kept, staff very friendly at check in which was pretty quick considering how busy they were. Room was great and pretty big, quiet, bed comfortable and large bathroom area. However; there are no towel racks except over the toilet. We had to hang our hand towel and wash clothes on the door handle. The in-room safe also came with a fee. They gave us two coupon books to use around the resort during our stay and they amounted to a nice savings on food and beverage. Casino was nice, but tons of smokers (I really didn't think that many people still smoked) and super crowded even at 0100 in the morning. The two days we were there we couldn't even get on a table. Open slots were far and few between too. Buffet was very good, tons of choices not just for breakfast but dinner also. Fast friendly service and [limited] free adult beverages. On the first night we ate at the Mexican place inside the hotel, food was good, priced reasonable, but the service was super slow and they were not busy. Hotel is a ways from the strip and Freemont, (cost us $22 for Lyft each way to the strip) but I would stay here again.

reviews.title: Spacious Rooms
reviews.text: Great big room at reasonable price comparable to other hotels in Vegas for a Saturday night.  It could be that it’s a 10-15 minute drive to the strip.  A little away but not far at all.  The room was huge and so was the TV.  A lot of dining options to choose from in this place.  Free parking.  Would not hesitate to stay again.  Had a great time.

reviews.title: Terrible bed!
reviews.text: Overall great place to pay, eat & drink but the beds are always awful! I’ve stayed here several times now and finally learned my lesson this last time. ADA room was roomy enough and clean though. Coffee maker in the restroom definitely was a bad idea by who ever thought that up, I would NEVER trust any in room coffee makers and especially not one in the restroom.

reviews.title: Great venue close to The Strip
reviews.text: Attending 2 day meetings at Southpoint.  Easy access off highway and near airport. About 5 miles south of the Center Strip so not as busy. However very large property that basically is self contained with very good entertainment and food choices.  Plenty of free parking and valet available.  Meeting rooms are comfortable.  Clean property.  Pleasant and friendly staff.

reviews.title: Wonderful place to stay
reviews.text: South Point is a great place to stay if you want to stay in Las Vegas, but don't care for the crowds. This place has everything: Several restaurants, wonderful spa, a multi-screen movie theater, a bowling alley, and more. The casino is one of the best for being clean and not over-crowded. Our room was comfortable and quiet. This was our second time staying here, and we would come here again.

reviews.title: Very clean, easy to get around inside
reviews.text: We've stayed at South Point twice and enjoyed our stays both times. It's a smaller establishment, but that works well for us as it's easy to get around and meet up with friends at the different bars and restaurants. The rooms and the entire hotel/casino are very clean. While they do allow smoking in the casino and some bars, the air is evidently well filtered and I never felt like my clothes smelled like cigarette smoke. The Del Mar deli has great deli sandwiches, breakfast platters, and sweets for a good price.  I think it's a good value for the money in Las Vegas and would happily stay there again.

reviews.title: Nice place to stay off the strip
reviews.text: Stayed there one night and found room and accommodations very nice. Casual dining restaurant was very nice with good food and reasonable unlike many hotel restaurants in Las Vegas. Hotel rates are also reasonable and casino, sports and race book also available.

reviews.title: great hotel
reviews.text: We didn't spend too much time here but the room was newly renovated and it was spacious. The staff was friendly and accomendating. The coupon book that we were given upon arrival was a welcome surprised.

reviews.title: Nice property South of strip
reviews.text: First time at the hotel  i was there on business for a couple days and found the South Point to be a good location.  The hotel is large with many dining options. Staff were all friendly and helpful with a nice pool area and pool bar/cafe.  Not much of a gambler, the casino was not as smokey as most which was a pleasant surprise.  Rooms also spacious and modern.  I would stay here again.

reviews.title: Fabulous Visit
reviews.text: Took my wife to the South Point casino and had a great time.  There was a free horse show in there arena and we visited their many restaurants and they were all excellent . We’d definitely go again!  The service was great and the rates were very good, we even won some money!!

reviews.title: Anniverdary
reviews.text: We stay at the Grandview hotel - next door. South Pointe is right across from there. Full service hotel.Cute shops, good places to eat, clean and friendly.They have a good coffee place, gambling, and not so crowded like the other hotels.

reviews.title: Great Hotel off the Strip
reviews.text: I stayed here for my convention and was glad it was off the strip. I found $5 Black Jack tables and that was a wonderful way to spend my two evenings there.  The people were friendly and fun at the tables.  The food we were served was very good for a convention.  The room was large and clean and very comfortable.

reviews.title: Fantastic value for money
reviews.text: We normally stay on the strip but circumstances meant we had to have one night at southpoint..and we didnt want to leave. What a gem of a find.The best buffet we've had from any strip casino and half the price. Great choice of slots and better payout. Smaller pool than we're used to but SO many sunbeds and room to spread out, whereas at Mandalay Bay you have to hunt for a sunbed and virtually sat on top of each other. Great frozen cocktails from pool bar, again half price of the strip.Cinema, huge choice of restaurants, shows, free parking, really friendly, down to earth staff and a much more laid back atmosphere. Quick and easy to get to car and close to I15 and retail outlets.We will 100% be back but for a longer stay. Maybe it's as we are getting older but the main strip is getting too frantic and expensive for us.This has more of an old vegas feel and service which we loved

reviews.title: A great hotel and friendly staff.
reviews.text: We stayed here in late Sept. 2019 for 5 nights and loved it.  Newly remodeled rooms that are spacious and very clean.  Love the restaurants, Baja Miguel and Coronado Cafe. The Garden Buffet is also good.  We love that this hotel has really cool things like an Equestrian arena, and we saw a Quarter Horse show for free.  Also saw a movie as this hotel has a movie theater in it.  Giant casino and Free Parking which we love.

reviews.title: A Great Stay
reviews.text: This was my first time visiting here. The hotel has easy access from the highway. There’s no traffic like on the main strip. The convention rooms were near the hotel rooms. There’s so many eateries at the hotel. There’s even a movie theater and bowling alley. The staff were friendly. The hotel rooms are huge. And the rooms were clean. I had a great room facing the main strip.

reviews.title: good hotel for transitioning outside of Vegas
reviews.text: This is our second stay, so obviously we were satisfied the first time ! But i would not recommand long stays, just for the smell of the lobby ; the smell of smoke (Vegas style) is pretty strong. But we book this hotel because it is a cheap and CLEAN stay when transitionning out of Vegas. The room is very spacious, clean and beds are confortable. Also near grocery if you need anything (Whole foods).

reviews.title: It's worth the drive to South Point
reviews.text: South Point is a newish hotel and casino at the very south end of the Strip on Las Vegas Boulevard.  After our first brunch which was excellent we returned for two more meals. The Sunday Brunch Buffet was superb.  The PRIME RIB roast which was part of a full complement of various cuisines and breakfast items is one of the best I have had in any restaurant (and this is at a buffet!). All the food is fresh, constantly replenished.  The dining room is large with the tables a generous distance from each other so diners can enjoy privacy, ease of movement and quiet. The lunch buffet a few days later was also excellent and at $15 one of the most reasonable of the large casinos.  We had a late evening meal at the Cafe.  One of the specials was Prime Rib or Porterhouse Steak for $14.95.  Having been so pleased with the Prime Rib at the buffet I opted for the Prime Rib.  I was not disappointed.  The Prime Rib was perfectly done to order, accompanied by a fresh salad, a large bowl of au jus, and a baked potato with all the trimmings. I can't wait to go back and try one of their restaurants name "Prime Rib".  We did not stay at the resort, but it is definitely worth considering (a modern, clean,airy, easy to navigate casino), all the services of a large  casino and yet one that is welcoming, straightforward  (they don't send you through acres of slot machines to get to registration) and has reat service from all staff.

reviews.title: Prime Rib Restaurant inside South Point Casino
reviews.text: South Point Casino is located way south on the Strip...which was nice because it was easy to get to with little traffic...finding a place to park was a different story.  Gaming inside cover all types.  We went mainly for the dining experience in one of several of the Casino's restaurants.  Prime Rib was very good!!  Wait staff was excellent and ensured we never had a dry glass or lacked for anything on the table.  Its worth the trip at least once if you like good prime rib at a reasonable price.

reviews.title: enjoyed the amenities
reviews.text: South Pint is off the strip - part of what it nice - the food prices and serving sizes were very reasonable. The food was quite delish - Asian, The Deli - desserts - The Turkey wraps - the Steak n ShakeIt wasn't too smokeyLARGE conference - convention spaceHorse and Show arenaBowling alley and movie theatre alsoLovely pool

reviews.title: Getaway
reviews.text: Stayed here a few days ago.This is the first time here. The rooms were very spacious and nice.Pretty views. Large casino and nice movie theaters. Looking forward to my next visit.Buffet was really nice with a pretty good selection of entrees.Free parking is an extra perk.

reviews.title: Great variety of food restaurants  !
reviews.text: Good room, good food, rodeo in the hotel, 64 bowling lanes !!! Reasonable prices ! All under  ground shaded valet parking.  Fast service from valet.   Pretty far south on the Vegas strip, but worth the trip if you have a car at your disposal.

reviews.title: Good stay
reviews.text: Stayed at the South Point last week in September, Check in was quick and easy. Room was good, very clean, as was the bathroom and toilet. The room had a pool view which was nice. The most disappointing thing about the hotel was the pool area, it wasn't up to the usual standards we have had in the past. The pool wasn't very clean, lots of dirt and small pieces of concrete which had come from the pool surround. The sleeve over one of the hand rail was tattered and torn, and there was lots of cans and rubbish around the back part of the pool area. I have never seen this in the past, and that is one of the reasons we returned. So come on South Point get your act together.

reviews.title: SIMPLY INCREDIBLE
reviews.text: Wow, what a breath of fresh air this place is!!!From the VERY CORDIAL staff, to REAL DEALERS behind black jack and roulette tables, to an EXTREMELY CLEAN FACILITY and a SUPERB OYSTER  BAR.This place is A MUST VISIT casino in Vegas.The registration staff the casino cashiers staff could NOT GET ANY BETTER....I had a chance to talk to one of the staff members about the owner and she said “he is an incredible and kind man”.My hat of to this gentleman, for an incredible operation and what a compliment from his staff (I have 70 staff, so I can appreciate this comment!This is where I book from now on when I am in Vegas!

reviews.title: Gregg Austin's M Town & More is a great show
reviews.text: This review is about the show at the South Point.  Half-price tickets are generally available.  The casino is 7 miles south of the major hotel area on the strip.  But if you are in the area of the South Point, don't miss this show.This is not just a "Motown" review.  It's a review of popular soul music from the late 1950's through Whitney Houston.  The entire experience was good.  Great seating, a dance floor, energetic wait staff, good bar snacks, good drinks.  Of course the major draw is the Motown and more music.  (The only negative, and this was hardly noticeable, is that the band did not have a horn section, and horns have been a big part of this genre.)  All the musicians and singers were great.  We were particularly impressed with the range and precision of William Jordan.  Go get those half-price tickets!

reviews.title: Always amazing
reviews.text: We have stayed many hotels in Las Vegas. South Point has everything without the problems of the strip. The strip  great for people watching,  shows and glitz. South Point  has great staff, clean spacious rooms, food burgers to anything you might want .  The pool, showroom, arenas, bowling, movies, arcades are all top shelf.  Hope to stay at South Point many more times.

reviews.title: Roll on
reviews.text: South Point this is a very nice place it has everything. The room was very large it was so quiet up on the 17 floor you hear nothing just quietness. When at the Grandview you can use your room key over to get in the pool and so many activities The tv real don't have any god channels watch. This place has so much do check it out.

reviews.title: We're Back
reviews.text: Great complex for a short getaway.  The rooms are spacious and newly refurbished.  The airport shuttle was on  time and easy to reserve.  The staff were very friendly and the various restaurants served good food at reasonable prices. The pool area was very clean and had plenty of towels.Great place for a short stay. We will be back.

reviews.title: Short stay on road trip worst hotel ever
reviews.text: The vents in the room kept putting out dust and other foriegn debris all over the room, bad for your health. They changed my room and the same thing was happening in that room as well.  If you value your health,  I would stay away for the hotel. The manager promised to waive my resort daily fee for use of the facility amenities. But when I checked out I only had one day waived. The health department in Vegas needs to look into the poor practices that this hotel has. I will definitely be reporting this to the BBB. and the health department

reviews.title: John H                      Perfect
reviews.text: I've stayed at many places in Vegas about 15 different ones, there is no place I would rather stay then Southpoint. The place is just set up perfect from the pool area to the casino to the rooms. Parking is free.  The rooms  have a refrigerator which alot of places don't, the toilet and shower are separate from the vanity. The only think I would change is the shampoo and conditioner are in fancy dark tubes which are hard to tell which one is which, they need to have a C or S on the top so  you can tell the difference while in the shower.

reviews.title: Nice Hotel and Staff
reviews.text: Great Service, Casino, Rooms, Resturants. This is a great place to stay. Away from the Strip but close to everything. Steakhose had Great food and was not out of line in price. Buffet had a large selection of food that was very good. Big rooms with almost instant hot water for showers etc. Resort Fee includes WIFI and parking. Casino had friendly staff that would help you if needed any games explained. Bowling Alley, Movie Theater, Equestrian CenterArena and Pavillion. I will stay here again. Friendly Check in/out and everyone else.

reviews.title: Negligence
reviews.text: My father stayed at this hotel. Due to a medical situation he NEEDS a refrigerator. When requesting it from the front desk - I was told, they don’t offer “complimentary” refrigerators. Even after explaining that it was medically necessary  - their response remained the same. They couldn’t/didn’t offer an alternative solution. Seriously, how much would they charge my dad if he needed handicap access? It’s not about the money, it’s about the principle. My father needs to keep his medication refrigerated. But, instead of displaying good customer service - they chose to treat him like a 21 year old that is just trying to keep his beer cold. In my opinion, is absurd! I have never experienced any other hotel that chose not to accommodate someone or anyone. But, especially with medical needs! Are you kidding?It’s unfortunate that in a big city; like Las Vegas, this corporation is unwilling to step up to the competition or have some parallelism in customer service. Particularly with handicap, disabled and/or people with special needs. Absolutely disgraceful- Not that this  means much - but as a family member of someone or anyone that needs “a non-complimentary item” PLEASE, Be Warned- DON’T STAY HERE!

reviews.title: Easy going!
reviews.text: Place is huge with lots of sports fanatics and every big screen with every sport for betting. Great place to sit back and have drinks on the house while watching some sports and poker 3/2 table.Food is good and plenty of cocktail waitresses. Great time.

reviews.title: Very good off the strip casino
reviews.text: On Las Vegas Blvd but South of the airport. Easy parking or valet. Like their Blackjack tables - two deck or shoe, less expensive tables than the “strip” casinos. Friendly vibes. Good collection of restaurants, don’t have to walk a mile.

reviews.title: really nice room!
reviews.text: We really enjoyed our stay.  Very nice.  Other then the lobby/casino getting pretty thick with smoke smell toward the afternoon, the room and amenities were really nice.  I appreciated the new laminate flooring in the room.. Hotel room carpet grosses me out. :/   The floors are CLEAN!  Very clean.

reviews.title: Hate the vinyl floors
reviews.text: I was surprised with the vinyl hardwood look planks on the floor of the room instead of carpet It made the room feels like an office and not very comfortable!I’ve stayed here before and it was very nice and that is why I chose this place!We also tried their brunch buffet and was niceI give the buffet a 3.5 starsBut the room 1 star all because of the floor

reviews.title: Great location south of the strip
reviews.text: Closest Las Vegas resort to LA.  Great atmosphere and best of all.   Morning breakfast like steak and egg under $5 before 6am.Each room have a kurig single cup coffee maker.  Do bring your favourite to have in the morning

reviews.title: Nice place to stay off of the strip
reviews.text: This hotel casino was nice to place to stay away for the hustle and bustle of the strip.  The room was large and comfortable. We ate at the breakfast buffet a couple of times and it's worth the price, lots of choices.

reviews.title: Great Atmosphere, Service, Food and Shows
reviews.text: We stay at the Grandview for a week whenever we go to Vegas, which is right next door to the South Point.  As a result, we spend a lot of time in the South Point casino, enjoying their restaurants and shows.  The food at the Delmar Deli is wonderful and we really enjoy having breakfast every morning the Garden Buffet. The shows in their showroom is always excellent.  We have seen Debbie Reynolds, Frankie Avalon, Crystal Gayle, George Wallace, Bob Anderson, Bee-Gees Tribute and Frankie Moreno there, just to name a few.  We saw Frankie Moreno six times now since he is such a great entertainer.  We enjoy him so much that we are going back to Vegas to see him again on New Year's Eve at the South Point, which should be a great show.

reviews.title: Convenient Location, Great Stay
reviews.text: As a local, we frequent SouthPoint often because it is convenient to access.  Parking is ample, both complimentary and valet.  It offers a great assortment of entertainment activities in addition to the gambling available.   We enjoy the movies, restaurants and showroom.  Love the showroom as it is intimate in that it is small and the entertainers can easily interact with the entire room as often they do by going into the audience.    We have not recently stayed in the hotel, but when we did the room was very nice and comfortable.  Since then they have renovated so I have no doubt it is just as nice, if not better now.

reviews.title: Whoooooooooo!
reviews.text: What a great place to stay OFF the strip which is exactly what my husband and I wanted for his birthday trip to Vegas.  We had a "standard" king size room.  My husband said he just wanted to whole room back home...LOL!  The bed was extremely comfortable, the casino action was awesome and we had plenty of options of eating either in the hotel or we found your routine eating establishments just minutes away (for the budget minded).  The refrigerator in our room was a little small and we wish we ha a microwave in our room.  We valeted our vehicle at every opportunity (no charge) and the bellhops were also EXTREMELY helpful as well.      The ONLY issue we had which we have no control over is the smoking which because it's not contained had a tendency to be super overpowering.  Other than that, we had no complaints and we had a blast!

reviews.title: Great stay!
reviews.text: Won a free night here and was glad I used it! Friendly staff, beautiful clean rooms and casino floor. Was given a voucher for the buffet and it was the best I have ever had. Every thing tasted great, right temperature on foods and friendly staff.  Had a voucher for a free show and it was entertaining enough. Valet service was excellent too. I would definitely recommend staying here when in Vegas or just stop in to play! They go out of thier way to make sure your happy!!

reviews.title: Huge but comfortable
reviews.text: First time to Vegas. This hotel complex is massive, but then everything in Vegas is big and brash.  Room huge (of course) and comfortable, though we had constant thrumming from some machinery. We were on 11th floor. Takes a while to work out where everything is and how to use coupons for free drinks and half price meals. 20 mins from strip but don’t think I’d want to be there anyway, short visits to gawp is enough.  Not into gambling so can’t comment on the casino, apart from to wonder why people do it!

reviews.title: Dated hotel, needs updating
reviews.text: Disappointed in this hotel. It was overpriced. While other hotels seemed to have figured out how to filter out the smoke from the casino area so that you don't notice it; this one hasn't, so if you have allergies, it would be best to look elsewhere for accommodations. The pool area was a nice highlight of the trip, but the bar in the pool area closes early. The rooms are spacious, the beds are comfy, the lighting in them is lacking. This is a great hotel if you have an event to attend in Vegas and won't be hanging out at the hotel or, if you're a gambler  who smokes, this is a great hotel for you. This hotel seems to be an island on it's own, so exploring anything 'close by' isn't an option as it is for hotels on the Strip or Fremont.

reviews.title: Good value for money
reviews.text: Big hotel with Casino at the south entrance to Las Vegas. It is far from The Strip but just for that reason we choose it. Large comfortable room. The hotel tries to keep you inside the hotel casino by providing a coupon booklet, which gives you good value for money dinner, drinks, and breakfast. If Las Vegas is not your final destination, but you are just on your way to one of the national parks, this is a good choice

reviews.title: Great place tostay
reviews.text: One of best hotels in Vegas.  Plenty of activities, movies, bowling and, of course gambling.  Rooms all kept clean and pleasant.  Numerous choices for eating with buffet, Italian, Mexican, steak and cafe all providing tasty food choices.

reviews.title: awesome time,
reviews.text: this was my 1st visit to Vegas... OMG.. I plan on going back at least twice a year from now on.  Beautiful hotel, buffet was crazy delicious.  I didn't get a chance to gamble, because I was there for a basketball tournament. but next visit... going to try some of the fun games !!!

reviews.title: Fun entertainment off the strip.
reviews.text: We were looking for a way to avoid the 110 degree Aug. heat and decided to catch a movie. We chose the theater at South Point because it has those very comfy recliner seats. Score! Not knowing what to expect, I was really impressed with the entire place. The theater was clean and very comfortable, the casino was was nicely laid out (I’m clearly not a casino connoisseur, but I would gamble here) and there were a variety of restaurants and non-gambling activities. I would definitely look into staying here next time i’m In town visiting family. I only gave 4 stars because I can not speak to the hotel part of the casino.

reviews.title: Always worth it
reviews.text: Great amenities with lots of choices. It is truly an entertainment center and not just a casino. Lots of free parking nice food choices. Great location and easy to get to. Have stayed there many times.

reviews.title: South Point Stay
reviews.text: We love staying at South Point every year during the NFR.  We also stay there during the year when we have business in Vegas.  It's off the strip so it's quiet.  The spa is amazing!  Beautiful pool and hot tub and plenty of places to eat and activities on site.

reviews.title: Love this hotel
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel and casino.  Get best price at front desk.  Called their in house reservations and was told only suites available, went to the front desk and recieved a regular room at 1/3 the cost of the suite!! If you go when equine events are taking place it's a very nice set up, vendors too.  Food down there is not great but restaurants in hotel are amazing.  Great casino with slots, poker and table games.  Will definitely stay there again. Oh! You can watch events downstairs on tv in your room too. And the pool is gorgeous!!

reviews.title: Big clean rooms
reviews.text: We recently enjoyed our stay at Southpoint. The rooms were a great size and clean. The air however lacked as it doesn't blow towards the beds, bummer since it's 110 degrees outside. We ate at Coronado Cafe and Steak n Shake, both were great! We didn't have any luck on the slots but enjoyed our stay and will be back!

reviews.title: A stay at the South Point Hotel and Casino
reviews.text: This is a great place to stay in Vegas far enough away from the crazy strip but close enough to enjoy all Vegas has to offer. The hotel is Hugh and the staff is all friendly, good casino games and lots to do for the whole family. The Prime Rib Restaurant is Fabulous, rooms are clean and well supplied. I Give This Place a 10

reviews.title: Nice facility, lousy craps crew
reviews.text: My buddies and I were doing a quick Casino hop the other day. We decided to start with South Point since we had all heard a number of good things about the place. The casino seems nice, clean and well-lit. Drinks service was quick enough. My big knock on the place was the surly craps crew. If you want gamblers to play there, perhaps you should have better dealers. I don't mind if you have to tell me that you want me to change something about the way I'm shooting, but do it in a nice way. No point in being a jerk.Yes, I was tipping, by the way. We weren't going to be there long but my tipping would most certainly have dried up given the behavior of that crew.

reviews.title: Vegas Break!
reviews.text: Have stayed here several times. Everything is here in one resort!  You can easy spend your time here for several days. Several price point restaurants.  Always have had excellent food and service. Beautiful pool. My upgraded room was freshly done and spacious!  If you’re into the highest 4 star hotel this would not be your choice.  You may want to rent a car or be prepared for taxi fees!  I’ve been to Vegas so many times and many hotels!  South Point I keep coming back to! Their promotions are excellent!

reviews.title: Great place
reviews.text: Was visiting from the UK and stayed 6 nights at planet Hollywood, our flight was cancelled and the airline put us at the south point hotel for 24 hours, I have to say it was fantastic, I enjoyed staying here more then the strip, had a real American feel rather then tourist areas of the strip. Swimming pool was great, food was good and also much cheaper. Thank you for making our last 24 hours in Vegas a great time

reviews.title: I could have spent my whole vacation in this place.
reviews.text: If you want a great time in Las Vegas without the hassle of the Strip, South Point is the place. Beautiful hotel and casino.  Room was spacious and very comfortable.  Six restaurants.  From expensive to very reasonable and all the food is about average.  Includes bowling, movie theater, and a full equestrian arena.  Favorite restaurant was the Coronado.  Name entertainment in the showroom.  We will definitely be back.

reviews.title: The good and the bad under one roof !
reviews.text: This venue is teriffic, with amenities for every class. Quiet, many restaurants, good Uber,Lyft and taxi services, shuttle to and from McCarran.HOWEVER, spending $1,300 on a dinner for 8, Michael's will be the last on our list of destinations. Food was absolutely excellent.  To be affronted with the arrogance, bum's rush to vacate, derision by wait staff who cannot speak English,do not know what Vodka or Gin are, let alone labels available in the house, and hurried presentation of courses to bring our event to a close....My advice: go to the Silverado...at least THEY appreciate clients, and at 1/3 the price.Michael oughta try an incognito arrival.  Reservations mean nothing, too. My money is as green as anyone's, and I expect the same respectful accommodation I afforded your house, playing by your rules.Avetque Vale.

reviews.title: great time
reviews.text: My friend and I stayed at South Point for the first time.  When we checked in we were given a room that overlooked a dumpster.  We immediately returned to the front desk and were given another room with a better view. The dinner and breakfast buffets were delicious and varied.  It was a nice touch to get a coupon book at check in for 1/2 price off the buffet along with many other savings.  There were a lot of slot machines that aren't in any other casino.  A special thank you to Randi at the front desk.  We look forward to returning soon.

reviews.title: Fantastic for families
reviews.text: We have just returned to the UK after spending 2 weeks at the south point. Myself, fiancé and 2 boys aged 6 and 13.The hotel room was lovely and spacious, we had a room that has just been renovated on the 7th floor. The pool area was clean and there are plenty of sun loungers available. Entrance is by proof of room key so only hotel guests can use the pool. Towels are provided and there was always plenty. The south point it ideally located if you don’t want to be on the strip and Uber’s we’re always available and not expensive to get to and from the strip, malls and entertainment. Whilst at the south point we enjoyed the cinema, bowling and the Namco amusements for the children. We also ate at a lot of the restaurants, we used the buffet every morning for breakfast and occasionally in the evening. The buffet was fantastic, always a huge selection of fresh hot food so everyone was happy. We also dined at primarily prime rib and the silverado both restaurants were amazing and really reasonably priced. We try to visit Las Vegas every 2 years, this will definitely be the hotel of choice.

reviews.title: South Point
reviews.text: On this trip we used South Point for are finale stop before getting into California.  I like the location of the hotel as I am on the south part of town and traffic not as bad.  We arrived early and got in quick (people who arrived later on this Friday night not so lucky).  Room was clean and I had not issue.  It appears there is a lot of remodeling going on.  I also am a fan of there parking garage.  I do not understand why other business do not use the plan.  The only issue I have is that when you are exiting a floor the sight is somewhat restricted, which could be fixed with a minor adjustment.I also like the room rates, hope the remodeling does not change that.  Sorry to say I didn't win a thing.

reviews.title: Nice and convenient
reviews.text: I stayed at the South Point Hotel and Casino for a training seminar. This hotel has a very nice fitness center that has cardio, some free weights and exercise machines. The pool is nice but pretty shall. There is a bowling alley and theaters upstairs, and they have a $4 movies for people over the age 50. Parking is free. Overall the hotel is great. Beds are comfortable, rooms are quiet, and spacious. The buffet was good at a reasonable price. There is a great early bird breakfast.

reviews.title: Great entertainment.
reviews.text: Went for the evening entertainment and also enjoyed the casino and dining. They have a wide variety of live theater shows one can take in. The location is out a bit but worth the trip! Try it for yourself.

reviews.title: My New Favorite Place to Hangout
reviews.text: How to start , hmm. First off I wish I had memorized all the helpful superior customer service Employees that made me decide to drive 3+ hours 1 way (weekly) to spend time there. I will make sure to get them in my next review. DJ I did happen to remember, My morning started off at the Rio where I had went down to gamble at 10 am. We had to check out at 1 pm and I was hoping to get 2 good hours in before I had to leave. When I got to the tables, they were all closed down except for a scam table to take your money. I asked for them to open up another table and they said no. Not till 12. I was playing with 4k on their tables pretty solid the night before and when I asked for some food they also declined me. I had 8k in my pocket to play with that morning. So grumpy, I drove to south point hoping I could get 1 and a half hours of play before leaving. When I got there, i asked for a max bet limit to be raised and they declined (South Point). I decided to play anyways . After a few hours, somehow I got into a conversation with the dealer and was explaining about being declined for food. DJ overheard and interjected, offering to help with request. He helped me get a comfortable rate for the night and provided outstanding service. The rooms are good size , clean , some have nice views. Ac works well, they have room service. Some of the reasons I love this place are, Its right off the freeway- easy to exit/enter. There's little to 0 traffic in the area. Less likely to get pickpocket as it's not as crowded. There aren't any hookers roaming the floors( sorry for some guys) family safe. No one is peddling sex fliers anywhere near the hotel . They have a awesome juice , icecream smoothie,  crepe place. They also have a nice cafe (Stay away from the filet mignon ewww) breakfast was good and chicken noodle soup. Very reasonably priced (won't be walking crooked leaving this place) there is also a nice spa (massages little over priced but very good) I haven't eaten at the Steakhouse yet, but the fact they have one is awesome. The only thing I could hope for that they don't have is a Smoke Free pai gow room or card room. Imo this is really the best place to stay in Las Vegas. Sincerely Aja Shaw.

reviews.title: Nice place for a stay-cation!
reviews.text: We really enjoyed the South Point.  First, really nice room - it was immaculate and very spacious.  Our room overlooked the pool area.  We appreciated that the bathroom had two rooms to it - one with the toilet and tub/shower, and the other with the sink.  And we could still close the door at the sink area to have some privacy from the room.  It wasn't open like most hotels.  The food was fantastic, the drink service was ok however we thought they catered to the tables (we are slot players).  But overall it was a nice stay.  Very nice property.

reviews.title: Unique Casino with an Equestrian Arena. Show: Gladius.
reviews.text: For the most part we enjoyed the beautifully appointed hotel. The room was spacious and clean (but had a lousy view of a wall). Our initial impression was negatively impacted by the inability to make the airport shuttle hotel connection which was stated to be included in the resort fee. We called on arrival at the airport and were given poor directions to the meeting point. (The shuttle leaves only from terminal 1 and we landed at terminal 3 but this was not clarified until the second call to the hotel.) The next shuttle was not for another hour and a half. Really? Taxi's are not inexpensive in Las Vegas but waiting around the airport for so long was not acceptable.	We went to see a fabulous equestrian acrobatic variety show: Gladius the Show, in their great equestrian arena. There appear to be many  shows in this unique venue. 	The casino was large and not crowded but still was noisy and smoky. Many restaurants at various price points are available. I spent a few minutes in the large freeform, outdoor pool and although the water was cool it was quite refreshing.  I find the practice of charging a large resort fee to be unacceptable  (especially when we were not able to use the included service of the airport shuttle) although this seems to be the norm in Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Pleasantly Surprised
reviews.text: Our original booking for Las Vegas was with a different hotel on the Strip. We decided last minute to go a day early and leave a day later. Our initial hotel couldn’t accommodate us on these extra dates so we decided to book a different hotel for these two days only. We found an exceptional deal for South Point on Hotwire inc resort fees for our first night. We were so impressed with the refurbished bedroom, the child friendly floor with bowling, cinema and arcades on the second floor that we decided to return for our last day in Las Vegas also. Unfortunately, on our last day we checked into a room on the 6th floor that was dated and had a terrible odour. I called front desk to say how disappointed I was as we had only booked to return because of the nice room we had during our first visit on floor 10. Front desk explained that their refurbished rooms are only on floors 9-19 and if I wanted to move I had to pay an extra $10 plus taxes. I explained that I had the same room rate for both bookings so why two different rooms? He said there was nothing he could do even though he said there was lots of availability. I paid the extra money because my family and I couldn’t have spent the night in the room.  We changed to a refurbished room on floor 19 which was great although I could definitely smell smoke on this non-smoking floor.Hotel is very affordable, has a lot for kids to do and the pool is huge!  It is a good 10/15 min drive from the main Strip and be aware of the rooms that aren’t refurbished yet!

reviews.title: Comfortable and clean
reviews.text: This is my yearly solo trip to Las Vegas.  For the last 3 yrs. I stayed downtown at the Golden Nugget and was very disappointed in it last year.  It's gotten really sleazy and dirty down there--I needed a change.  To be honest, I was a little worried that I might feel a little isolated or even bored at South Pointe because it's a distance from the strip.  I did not--I loved it! Nice, clean room (premium room w/view); good food (reasonable) excellent blueberry pancakes; very generous poker machines (VERY GENEROUS)!  Everything was great--one of the  cleanest casinos I've ever been in.  VERY comfortable.  I didn't even get a chance to go to a movie or play bingo, I was doing so well on the machines.  I hope I didn't just jinx myself.  I am looking forward to coming next year, if not sooner.

reviews.title: Nice Rooms, Great Value
reviews.text: This hotel is about 2 miles south of the Strip, but could just as well be on the Strip, in terms of size, massive casino, huge buffet, clean, well appointed rooms and so on.  However, because it is off strip, expect everything from dining to entertainment to be more budget friendly.  All in all this hotel can be great for a business trip of a family vacation.

reviews.title: BEST SPA DEAL IN VEGAS
reviews.text: My friends and I meet up in Vegas several times a year and we always get in a few massages each trip.  I’ve been to all the major Hotel Casino Spas.   I always stay at the Wynn.  This is the second time I’ve been to the South Point Spa and while the hotel is not for me, the spa is in my opinion the best deal in Vegas. This trip we also went to the Four Seasons Spa and so we were able to witness a back to back comparison.   South Point was vastly superior to the Four Seasons. Shockingly the Four Season Spa offers no Safe for your personal valuables, the lockers are just thrown into an open area and the “lounge” is in the middle of a hallway where you are left to stare at a Colin with utility lights and a switch. There is no television and no magazines. And no door. The South Point facility offers a jacuzzi, steam room, large and very inviting lounge with beverages, televisions and magazines and so. I hope more. The clincher was the quality of the massage and mani-pedi. Joanna is an exceptional massage therapist and really knows here stuff. Claudia is equally proficient with her services.  I look forward to returning frequently and will definitely request Joanna and Claudia.

reviews.title: Great place
reviews.text: Fantastic place for reasonable price. Big rooms with Harwood floor, refrigerator and enough room to welcome 4. Clean, great service and only 12 minutes from main strip. If you have rent car don’t waste your money to book hotels on the strip get better deal and service here for affordable $$

reviews.title: Nice place if you’re not dragging bags
reviews.text: Nice rooms. Great staff.   A pool that stays open in the evening.  A book of coupons including half off a buffet.The major drawback is how far you have to drag bags on carpet to get to the rooms.  It is forever from the front desk or parking lot.

reviews.title: Great hotel just off the strip
reviews.text: I went here for a trade show at this hotel but also stayed here and it didn't disappoint. HUGE place, lots of restaurants with real nice food at a low cost (compared to anywhere else in vegas) breakfast was nice and staff are all friendly. An uber into the strip is about $14 so very reasonable. Gambling, good food, friendly staff, & very comfortable spacious rooms. What else is needed. When I'm back at the show next here I will be staying here again!

reviews.title: Great place for smokers
reviews.text: The renovated room was very nice, on a non smoking floor.  Everywhere else, ick.  Have to walk by people smoking playing slots in the halls on the way to restaurants, going up escalator to convention center has smoking area right where you the escalator ends.  Pool wasn't crowded, but the lounge chair covers were either worn and faded or stained from other peoples sweat.  Trade show at same location next year, won't be staying there again.  My throat is all scratchy and feel like crap after 3 days there.

reviews.title: Family Friendly Place
reviews.text: I did not stay at the hotel this time but I wanted to see what this casino had to offer for a possible future visit/stay.  Heard about it through a friend so I wanted to check it out during my most recent stay in Vegas.  First, the front desk clerk allowed me and my companion to view a room.  She summoned a security guard to escort us up to the room to view.  Both, the desk clerk and security guard were friendly and supplied us with lots of valuable information on when would be good times to return and when to avoid.  The room was newly remodeled and very nice!  Nothing on the luxury end but very nice and comfortable looking room.  The room that we viewed actually had hard wood floors!!!  Never saw a hotel room with hard wood floors. That's a plus for those with allergies.  We then had Sunday brunch at the buffet.  The price was very reasonable and they had a huge selection of items for brunch including bottomless mimosa's made fresh (which was complementary with the buffet).  They were very good and I believe I drank 6 of them!!!  The buffet items were very tasty especially the carvery station.  The prime rib was tender/juicy and they would cook very generous portions well done upon request.  I am a huge fan of Seattle's Best Coffee and they had a coffee bar with that brand (Rare Find).  It is a nice change from all of the Starbuck's everywhere.  I do plan to return for Thanksgiving and stay at this property.  Close to the heart of the Strip but far enough away for some quiet.  Shoppers will love that it is only a few blocks from a premium outlet mall!  Minutes from the airport and highway access!

reviews.title: A Pleasant Surprise After a Cancelled Flight
reviews.text: We ended up at the resort due to a cancelled flight. We stayed in a 2 queen bed room that was newly renovated. Very nice view of the mountains. The resort was very big. Lots of restaurants, bowling alley, movie theatre and pool. Can highly recommend the ice cream shop. made and excellent milkshake.

reviews.title: Family friendly
reviews.text: I stopped here with my kids as a half way point on our way to Southern California. I had been wanting to stay here for awhile due to all the amenities offered and how family friendly they are. We just stayed one night but really enjoyed it! The pool was huge and a very nice relief from July temps. The shallow wading pool for younger kids was nice too. We did stay on a Thursday night and is probably why it wasn’t super crowded. Also why I got such a great rate for the room too! The room was huge!! Just your basic hotel room but very comfortable and spacious. The buffet for dinner was great too. Lots of options and a good price! I wish we explored the arcade, bowling, arena space, and movie theater but we were all very tired after swimming and dinner. I would stay here again! We travel through Vegas a lot so this will be on our list to stay and explore more!

reviews.title: Meh...
reviews.text: It is a nice enough hotel/casino, but that's just it. There's nothing that really, "Wows"! That said, if you wanted to, you wouldn't really have to go anywhere else, because this place has everything on the property.Now for the bad part. The room I was assigned was, well let's just cut to it,...bad! It was just barely clean enough for me to say screw it, I'm only sleeping here anyways, but I was not impressed. If I wasn't involved in a tourney at another property and would be gone for the better part of 16+ hours, I would have complained and requested another room. My point is, why should I have to complain about what is supposed to be your best effort anyways, in the hopes of maybe another random room will be better maintained and clean?I think not. Not when there are a dozen or so properties on the strip and a couple downtown that would definitely have you going WOW! for the same price. Just sayin'.Oh, and the pic attached is of the maintenance guy who came by 10 min after I get in the room, to clean the A.C. coils, ...yay!

reviews.title: Great Place, Everthing under 1 roof
reviews.text: Stayed there for the first time this last trip. I have been to Vegas Many times and have stayed at some of the best places on the strip. I will always stay at South Point every time I go going forward. The rooms were great, very clean and spacious. The staff was wonderful and very helpful at all times. From what I understand, there is always a lot going on there. This trip there was 2 bowling tournaments and a beauty contest as well as a western Convention/Show. You don't have to look far to find what you are looking for.

reviews.title: Not a good value
reviews.text: Checked in with a Priceline reservation and are now in a room overlooking their garbage dumpster with a 25 minute wait for our luggage to arrive to our room. Save yourself the hassle and book somewhere else. A call to front desk indicated we can pay more for a better room. Will not come back here or recommend.

reviews.title: Good times roll!
reviews.text: South point is a great casino with many restaurants to chose from. The buffet offers many fish or seafood options. Fresh clean veggies and fruits. The gaming is awesome. Many machines lots of tables. Always attentive staff.

reviews.title: It was fine...
reviews.text: You get what you pay for....What I like about South Point was it was affordable and off the strip.  But...it was very plain.  Nothing blew me away.   We stayed at the Mirage earlier in the week, and I found the Mirage to be cleaner and more upscale.  At the Mirage, we had a room with 2 kings.  At South Point, we can only get 2 queens, and they felt like 2 doubles.  My wife and I basically both had to speed sideways.   I will say, I did like the feature of the South Point room bathrooms, where the toilet area was sperate from the sinks and mirror.   As far as the casino, I found it a little more smokier than most.  The dealers were professional and there was prompt servers.  I also found the in house restaurants to be adequate.   The pool was nothing special.  No slides or fun area, and the pool was ice bucket cold.   Like I said, the South Point was fine...but nothing was great.

reviews.title: South Point Buffet
reviews.text: We have visited this casino many times in the past ten years, usually staying at the Grandview next door.  We visited again last week, meeting several friends for their lunch buffet.  The buffet is huge and offers many choices[, from soup to seafood.  It's clean, well organized and has a pleasant atmosphere.  I will not hesitate to vist here next time in Vegas!

reviews.title: Many photos added.  Excellent stay
reviews.text: My wife and I stayed here for one night.  Large room, nice bathroom, comfy beds, many TV channels, great 24/7 gym, great pool and very friendly staff.  Our room had a great  view of the pool.  Many great restaurants, nice bowling center and movie theaters. Very large casino with low table minimums.  Great Race and Sports Book open 24/7. I will return.  I added many photos of or stay.

reviews.title: South Point 7/1 - 5
reviews.text: Best value in all of Vegas, good eats, plenty of 5.00 tables, great pool and unlike the main strip, you won’t gouged. Movie theater a nice break away from the action along with a bowling alley if that’s your thing. 2nd trip here and will never stay on the strip again.

reviews.title: A nice stay at a pretty nice hotel
reviews.text: My family (6 in total) stayed here from July 4-July 7. We needed a handicapped accessible room for my mother and called the hotel directly to arrange. We told the hotel rep that in the room we needed some type of comfortable chair for my mother to sleep (she's recovering from a broken shoulder and not able to sleep in a bed). The hotel rep assured us that the handicapped room had that.The room itself was very big and had a roll-in shower, grab bars in the shower and next to the toilet, and lower light switches (and even a lower peephole in the door) to accommodate someone who would be in a wheelchair. What it didn't have was a comfortable chair. The chair provided was uncomfortable and not suitable for sitting for long periods of time and the hotel said I must have misunderstood what the hotel rep told me. They were willing to provide a rollaway bed (which wouldn't have really helped us) at an additional cost so we improvised but felt that perhaps our needs had been misinterpreted or misunderstood by the hotel.The positive things were that when we checked in about 4:00 pm on July 4, despite having about 30 people in front of me at the check-in counter, I didn't wait more than 10 minutes to check in. They had a lot of staff available to check guests in and their process was very quick. It would be nice if they also had check-in kiosks like other hotels (the Rio and Harrahs, for example) do for someone who didn't want to stand in line. It's a fairly long walk from the check-in desk to the elevators and it's right through the casino (unlike some other Vegas hotels we've stayed in). Both bell service and valet parking were great and very quick. My mom was using a walker and when she became tired, we called bell services who told us they provided complimentary wheelchairs to guests which was a huge help in getting my mom around the hotel and into restaurants. We've stayed at other hotels that charged up to $25 per day to rent a wheelchair so this is a lovely perk that South Point provides.The pool area, although crowded, was clean with plenty of chairs and lots of room to move around. Another nice touch in South Point is that they have a movie theater with about 8 screens showing movies all day long (although we experienced an aftershock from the LA earthquake while in the movie theater on July 5!) There are plenty of food choices and I particularly enjoyed Steak and Shake, which is not available when I live. Delicious burgers at reasonable prices.There's also a great ice cream shop and a breakfast/coffee bar close to the entrance of the hotel at pretty reasonable prices.Although not on the strip itself, South Point is a fairly short drive to the strip. It was reasonable priced and they treated us very well. When we needed extra towels or to have our room serviced by the cleaning staff later in the day than normal, they were very accommodating.We'd definitely head back there again if we were able to get a slightly better price than we did for this long weekend.

reviews.title: Las Vegas Nationals
reviews.text: Having the arena attached to the hotel makes the stay SOOOO convenient!...we have a 16 month old baby and if she gets tired or crabby my wife can easily take her up to the room. Also having the event on the TV’s in the room let’s you know where you’re at so you know when your next to go race...and the Southpoint is a very new place and is very nice. This is our 5th time staying at the Southpoint, we like it very much. Although one thing that bothers me is that I am refused the room rate at which others have been given. My fiend was given a room for $88, I have to pay $146, and the person at the person at the front check in desk was very much a smartass about it saying I “wasn’t enough of a high roller” to to be given that rate...

reviews.title: Yes but actually ... no
reviews.text: Pros: Several things to do: spa, movies, "restaurants", outdoor pool (closed in February)Big casino Fast check in/outCons: Room: Old rooms smelling old carpet. No balcony and it was impossible to open the window. I paid an extra fee for the "mountain view" and all I got was parking view. The worst: Far away from the strip. A shuttle bus is available, but it's not free (9 US per person), that means: 36 US for 2 people to go and come back from the strip. Since last bus leaves by 1 am, forget the party in the strip. There's nothing interesting around the hotel, we wanted to go for a walk, but we were back 15 minutes after. I was not looking for a fancy hotel, but this old carpet and cigarette smell was disgusting. Lesson learned.

reviews.title: Loved this place
reviews.text: My parents, my husband and I stayed here for a bowling tournament. This place did not disappoint! They have everything you could possibly want and give you service with a smile.We utilized the airport shuttle transfer and had no problems with that at all. They tell you where to be and you can’t miss the big blue shuttle. Check-in was super easy and the hotel held our luggage until our room was ready. We were actually able to go to our room before the check-in time so that was a big plus. We stayed in the spacious 2BR 2BA suite. Nice layout with a living room/kitchenette separating the two bedrooms. Kitchenette has a small sink and small refrigerator but enough room for what we needed. The refrigerator was stocked daily with complimentary sodas, juice, and water. The living room area had a comfortable couch and chairs as well as a large dining table. Each bedroom and bathroom, living room and kitchenette had its own TV for a total of 6 TVs in all. One bedroom had a king bed. The other had two queen beds. Beds were very comfortable. The bathrooms were huge and beautifully designed. The windows were huge and provided beautiful views from the top floor.Plenty of good food choices, though the prices are on the higher side. We tried each restaurant at least once (except for the oyster bar because we don’t like oysters.) All of them were great and gave us plenty of food. We were so stuffed that we usually ate 1 or 2 meals a day and just had snacks the rest of the time. We also prefer Pepsi products and had no problem finding the best drink ever, Diet Mtn Dew, lol.Gift shop was nice and had t-shirts, souvenirs, and plenty of candy, snacks, and beverages.My father had his shoes shined. The guy did a great job and someone regularly staffed the lobby to provide this service.We walked around the equestrian area, the fitness center, salon, and pool even though we didn’t utilize them. My husband and I saw a movie at the on-site theater. Plenty of typical movie theater food, comfortable seating, and lots of options for current movies offered at various times. There are two bowling areas. One for amateurs that has a snack bar. The other is for the tournament which is where we spent most of our time. The seats were very comfortable, nice layout, and venues for t-shirts, bowling supplies, and snacks. Bring a jacket if you’re cold-natured like me.We are not gamblers, but had some fun watching those that did. The casino is in the center of everything but we had no problem getting around it or through it to get to where we needed to be. I am very sensitive to the smell of cigarette smoke, but this casino does a great job of filtering the air. Unless you are right next to someone who is smoking, you probably won’t even notice.There are also plenty of escalators, elevators, stairs, and bathrooms. Occasionally, the elevators were full or we had to wait, but most of the time this was not an issue.I really can’t say enough good about this place. I describe it as a cruise ship without the ocean - they have everything you need to have a safe, fun trip without ever having to leave the hotel. We did leave to do some sightseeing, but the majority of our time was at the hotel. We will definitely be back!

reviews.title: Amazing complex
reviews.text: This casino has gone to another level if you enjoy equestrian events and bowling for fun and bowling in Tournaments. Obviously there are aspects such as great rooms amazing places to eat and gambling.  The bowling plaza is host to the National Bowling tournament and many other Pro and Amateur Events. Reno was the first to house a complex (satin) for bowling quite an amazing facility and now South has that same type complex exclusively for tournaments. Not to be left out if you wish to bowl recreationally the casino also offers bowling in a complex for fun. The buffet, Coronado restaurant , and two more exclusive eateries r amazing. I was a Video Poker lover and did well on 5 machines which offered triple Double and they took them away.  They offer a variety of slots.

reviews.title: A Great Casino in the Tradition of Old Vegas
reviews.text: We saw this place on our way back from the Grand Canyon yesterday and their sign outside caught my attention when it claimed 99 percent payback on slots. We visited South Point Casino today and loved it! The casino was clean, paid out a few bucks,  and has a great buffet. The food was hot and tasty without exception.  And it didn't cost an arm and a leg like strip casinos do. I wish we has stayed here this week instead of the lousy strip pyramid (take a guess) we stayed at, with no evidence of anyone winning anything on ANY slot. Finding out the hard way that SP had breakfast for a only few dollars was a revelation to me, after paying $33 for coffee and a pastry at the place that Sphinx (take a guess). Great Job, South Point! I wish we had found you sooner!

reviews.title: A hidden Gem in plain sight
reviews.text: Went for the USBC Bowling Tournament held at South Point. Have been to Vegas many times and have never heard of this place, boy wish we would of heard of it earlier. It's going to be a stop everytime we are in Vegas. Spacious, very clean and all the staff were very helpful and happy to do it. Very large facility that holds many events all year long. Rooms were at a nice price and very roomy and clean. The restaurants which were many inside, were all great and some being fantastic. Glad we found this hidden gem and will return next visit.

reviews.title: Renovated Rooms with new EV Chargers
reviews.text: Full disclosure, I spent 2 nights comped based on my wife's slot play (she was with me).  We have been a few times before but this was the first stay in the renovated rooms.  I do like the new flooring.  The rooms will stay and smell so much cleaner now with floors that can be deep cleaned and will dry so fast.  The rooms were as usual uncannily quiet even for a weekend.  I slept great.  The bathroom was fine but I did not use it because I was in the Spa the whole time.  My last review I wished they put in EV chargers and they did.  3rd floor now has nice big clearly marked 4 spots of EV charging.  It appears to be complimentary.  It is a fantastic touch and now makes South Point a "go to" hotel in Vegas if only because I can wake up to a charged EV for the day (my work).  We also had great service as usual from the staff.  I had a great stay and will be returning.

reviews.title: Great place
reviews.text: Our stay was great!  Affordable, clean and friendly people (specially housekeeping) I asked for some extra sheets and towels and they were very helpful, in other hotels most of the time housekeepers are rude and they always seem to be overwhelmed but, here they are actually nice. The food is delicious with many different options. We also loved the discounted movie tickets on Tuesday.Thank you so much

reviews.title: Everything you need in one place!
reviews.text: Stayed at the South Point for the National Bowling Tournament.  The room was great, we ate at 5 different restaurants and the food was good at every one (there were more but we didn't get to them), and the slots eventually paid off well. The shuttle to and from the airport was pleasant, but I thought it could have run more frequently for such a big hotel.  The weekend brunch at the buffet included mimosas and they were delicious.  The only real drawback is the location - being so far away from the strip and downtown made it hard to leave (which probably was the intent) but I think providing a shuttle to and from a few times a day would give guests an option that would increase the overall rating for the facility.

reviews.title: Lots of things to do inside this hotel
reviews.text: The room was very nice, and the view was great looking at the mountains. There is bingo, movie theaters, bowling alley, various restaurants and of course slot machines and poker! The staff is very helpful and friendly.

reviews.title: Don’t play the slots
reviews.text: The table games were okay. No bonus bet on craps. The slots were so tight could have turned coal into diamonds. You win $20-25 and loss $50 right after before winning a couple cents. Didn’t stay in the rooms. Our club card failed most the time so I’m sure we didn’t get very many points.  Very disappointing.

reviews.title: Quick Getaway
reviews.text: Enjoyed our clean & quiet room, free slippers & dining options.  They were even able to check us in early since we had an early arrival! We didn't gamble much since we were in town for a memorial. Close to the freeway. Lots of activities on site(movies, bingo, events, etc). I'd definitely stay here again if I wanted something off the strip.

reviews.title: Top notch!
reviews.text: First rate casino, restaurants, bars, and hotel. Rooms were real nice, all the staff we encountered were friendly and helpful, the food was good, everything clean and well maintained. I can’t wait to go back again.

reviews.title: Stopover after cancelled flight.
reviews.text: Stopped here because we were put up here after our flight was cancelled.If it was for this fact we would have probably enjoyed the hotel.It is a big hotel with many places to eat but we didn't get to try any of them. The casino is large with many games but we didn't get chance to play any.The room though, was huge and very nicely finished. The bed was comfortable and everything was very clean. The room was far bigger than the standard rooms in the Vegas strip.In other circumstances we may have enjoyed the hotel but we only had enough time for a nap and a freshen up.

reviews.title: Large rooms and excellent convention facilities
reviews.text: The good:  large rooms, nice pool area, many restaurants to choose from. The okay:  Five miles+ from Mandalay Bay and the Strip The bad:  Housekeeping was not at their best for this trip.  When I arrived at my room, there was a small box filled with empty alcohol bottles outside my room.  My room was cleaned late each day (even with the please clean room tag inserted one day).  Today I was out of my room from 7 am to 3 pm and the room was not cleaned.  The person who knocks on all the doors in the afternoon (for some reason), knocked on mine and I told her my room had not been touched.  Although she had her clipboard with her, she seemed surprised.  I asked for just a couple f towels and if the trash could be emptied.  Tonight I realized that I was out of Kleenex.  I called housekeeping and was told a box would be brought up.  After an hour I called again and I finally received a box, from an individual who was rude  to me.  I hope that Housekeeping gets back to where it once was here, as this experience dampened my overall stay.

reviews.title: Intimidation of a Child & Discrimination
reviews.text: I feel that it is imperative that you are aware of the harassment and inappropriate treatment your lifeguard and security staff are giving to your PAYING GUESTS!!We decided to give your hotel a try and bring my family here for my daughters 21st birthday celebration. While the front desk staff was mediocre, the rooms were actually very nice. Unfortunately this review is NOT to compliment ANY of the staff at your hotel / casino. Not only were we HARASSED AND INTIMIDATED by your security staff who was brought on by your “lifeguard” who felt she was above all rules and regulations posted at the jacuzzi.  They were so abrasive that my child became EXTREMELY upset and terrified.  There are CLEAR SIGNS posted AT the jacuzzi that children under the age of 12 must be accompanied BY AN ADULT. BOTH MY HUSBAND AND MYSELF were IN the jacuzzi WITH my son. THEN the lifeguard went over to interrogate my 10 YEAR OLD who was sitting in a chair OUT OF THE AREA!!The security staff (5 in total) went on to get in my husbands face and terrify my son DEMANDING that we shown them my sons ID!!!  No one under the age of 18 HAS a valid California Identification Card unless they travel. WHICH MY KIDS DONT!!The lifeguard placed herself IN MY WALKING PATH which made it difficult to get away from the security guard who was pushing his shoulder into my body as I was trying to leave with my children!!!This will NOT be the last of my communications on this matter and it WILL be posted to every social media site, travel site AND hotel review avenue that I can possibly locate!!Never have I EVER been so insulted, discriminated or over all ABUsed in my life!!SOUTH POINT IS NOT A FAMILY FRIENY HOTEL AND IT IS DEFINITELY NOT ANYWHERE ANYOME SHOULD STAY OF THEY PLAN TO ENJOY THEIR TIME ON LAS VEGAS!!!

reviews.title: Great hotel etc
reviews.text: This place has so much to offer.  Nice hotel, spa, bowling facilities, movie theater, many restaurants even ice cream and great coffee. I had a very nice pedicure. The Mexican restaurant is good too. Buffet is not bad. Only downside is it’s not right on the strip but not a big deal for us.

reviews.title: Will stay again
reviews.text: We usually stay on or near Strip but this trip we were heading south to Palm Springs. Just wanted an overnight southbound. Easy access from McCarren car rental building. Also easy access on/off I15. Large self parking facilities but we used valet. Quick check in. No surprises. Very generous coupon book at check in. Third floor room was spacious and clean , no view but that’s not a big deal for an overnight. Lots of elevators. LOTS of food choices, we had Mexican. Very good, friendly service. Waitress encouraged us to sign up for players card, said they are generous with perks. Slot machines were a little tight but lots of them. Clean casino floor not too smoky. Three or four large bar/seating areas. Nice sports book. Movie theaters, bowling, equestrian venue, bingo room. The advertised entertainment looked great, wide variety coming up. We didn’t use pool or fitness room but they both looked very comfortable, guest friendly. We plan on returning some time!

reviews.title: Good Vegas Experience
reviews.text: Stayed for 2 nights with family and friends. Occupied 3 rooms. Rooms are rather large. Can actually accommodate a family. Check in and check out is easy. Facilities are ok esp for the casino. Food is the usual buffet. Prime Ribbis very filling and great. They have this midnight promo for steak and eggs pegged at $5.95! You see people lining up just to eat! Didn’t really go around to check the facilities but they have a lot to offer: bowling, shows, pool, etc. Dont forget to ask for more coupons to get discounts!

reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: Friendly staff. Easy and fast check-in and check-out. Clean and fresh room. Comfortable room. Enjoyed the buffet with plenty of choices. This is a smoking casino so everywhere I went there were smokers which I did not enjoy and causes coughing spells for me. Registration desk. waking to the elevators from the parking garage to the hotel elevators, gift shop, and restaurants require you to walk in the casino witg exposure to smoke. Wish there was a smoking and non-smoking area and even better having this a nonsmoking facility. Other than the smoking issue, I enjoyed my stay.

reviews.title: Suite with a huge tub
reviews.text: We are locals and wanted a quick stay-cation in town that had a nice room, soaking tub but also had things to do other than gamble, they have a bowling ally, quite a few restaurants and a movie theater. great stay! and the tubs in the suites are HUGE!

reviews.title: Awesome Buffet n Everything Else
reviews.text: This buffet was awesome! First off I had the breakfast meal and the variety was fantastic! Everything was laid out in an orderly and neat fashion. Several were in my party and all had great things to say about the taste and the freshness. You get your moneys worth here! This place is fantastic. I only wish we would have stayed here. The location is excellent, there are two bowling alleys, a movie theater, restaurant, pools, casino, n fabulous gift shop! I will be staying here from now on! Thank you for an awesome experience!

reviews.title: nice hotel
reviews.text: Nice rooms and good pool. also appreciated the free slippers in the room. Just wasn't happy that I used the iron for a dress but the iron was dusty so it burned the dust into my dress, not close to the strip costs about $15 to 20 to get to the strip by lyft.

reviews.title: Clean, Spacious, Great Restaurants, while Affordable.
reviews.text: Great experience, room was excellent, quiet, spacious and comfortable. Casino was not too smoke filled.  Restaurants (11) offer great choices in eating, from delicatessen to top tier gourmet. Even has a spacious bowling alley and numerous movie theaters. Like a fun city under one roof.

reviews.title: Went to participate in the National Bowling Tournament being held at this Casino
reviews.text: There is a lot to say about how comfortable this Hotel is, we were stayed for 5 days and found that the staff is very friendly and hrlpful. there are plenty of places to eat and a nice pool area with plenty of seating and a place to grab a drink or snack right there. there is a movie theater and bowling alley, also an arena where they hold differant functions.

reviews.title: Fantastic
reviews.text: I stayed at southpoint for years still great quality , large remodeled rooms.Great buffet , and during Memorial day free buffet for veterans. This is a great jester. Large rooms less exspensive food . And a free trip to and from the airport .Prices of the rooms are great .

reviews.title: Very Surprised
reviews.text: I lived in Vegas for 10 years yet had never came to this Casino/Hotel, I flew back for a visit last week and stayed here due to the location of the event I was attending. I was extremely happy. Service was great, room was recently remodeled and clean and I tried the buffet for lunch and was great. You do get a coupon book when you check in and it has a half price buffet. Great buffet for less then $7.00 with the coupon. Only bad thing was I didn't win anything at the tables...:)

reviews.title: Best way to go off-Strip
reviews.text: This hotel is the best place to be off-strip.  The room we had was recently refurbished and just beautiful! Very comfortable for a week's stay. The casino is great (and we even won a little!). Easy to navigate. Lots of great restaurants for every budget.  It has a large convention space and there is always something going on - we were there for the Bowling Nationals. I found the whole place to be clean and the employees to mostly all be very friendly and helpful. Just a very comfortable place to be.  Did not find the smoke to be overwhelming at all - except when someone would sit down next to me and light up a cigar.  Ugh.  Free parking and lots of it.  The pool is great - just wish they had cabanas to rent so you could spend the whole day out there. Poolside bar and grill was good and not too pricey. All-in-all, will definitely be back!!

reviews.title: Bowling Tournament Participant
reviews.text: The rooms have been renovated. There are plenty places to eat. Room service can be ordered by using your remote control. Two bowling alleys, a movie theatre, spa services, etc. I visited the location three years ago for a tournament. Less than 15 mins from the airport. Even shorter distance to the “main strip”. GO TO THE DELI AND GET DESSERT 😍😍😍😍😍😍😍

reviews.title: Rob Schneider was excellent
reviews.text: We have stayed at the Southpoint Casino before we found a home to purchase.  The room was clean and comfortable.  The choices of Resturants are excellent.  The Garden Buffet is AWESOME.  Tonight we went to the casino to see Rob Schneider. The show was fantastic. He is such a down to earth person and for 1 1/2 hours, you find yourself laughing and having so much fun.  We also see the Frankie Scinca show,it is fantastic.  Southpoint really knows how to provide quality rooms, great food and  quality entertainment.  WE LOVE IT HERE.

reviews.title: Just not......
reviews.text: So it was another one of these off the main strip large, smokey and endless hotels in Vegas.  We wanted something less expensive as we were only staying one night.  After parking and registering, it was a forever walk to the elevators through a smoke-filled casino.  We were annoyed about a $21 dollar a day resort fee, but their coupon book had discounts for a rather plentiful and tasty breakfast.  The room was a long corridor away from the elevators but was comfortable and quiet.  It showed signs of wear and tear.  If you're looking for a true Vegas vibe, go big time.

reviews.title: I love this place
reviews.text: South Point is the only place I want to stay in Vegas.  Not on the strip, but ride share can get you there easily. There is so much to do here like movies, bowling, bingo and the casino, so I usually don't bother leaving.  The restaurants are extremely affordable and a great value.  Best part is the staff.  They are very friendly and helpful.  I can't wait to go back.

reviews.title: Frequent visits
reviews.text: We have stayed at the South Point numerous times since it first opened, but more recently our visits have focused on dining, drinking, gambling and entertainment.  My wife spent 2-3 hours daily playing video poker during our vacation in order to take advantage of the good pay schedules offered plus the current Spin to Win prizes promotion.  Another ongoing promotion that we were able to use was senior Mondays when 1/2 points are charged for meals.  Our filet mignon meal at the Silverado Steakhouse proved to excellent while the seafood pan roast at Big Sur Oyster bar disappointed. We also attended the Thursday afternoon Dennis Bono show, complimentary for slot club members, twice on this trip.  Each show features a number of local and visiting artists, but be aware that the show is very popular so picking up tickets at the box office on the preceding Wednesday is highly recommended.  Lastly we enjoyed a couple of adult beverages there including a pair of $1 bloody Marys available before noon at any of the bars plus happy hours at Miguel's Tequila Bar and Zenshin.

reviews.title: We highly recommend the South Point Hotel & Casino
reviews.text: We had a plane to catch in four hours and did not want to stay at the airport.  Thus before we took back the car rental ....we went to South Ponit Hotel & Casino. The place is very nice.  Very clean and the employees very helpful.   I was not a big winner at the slots but my husband was quite pleased with his winnings at the blackjack tables.  We opted to eat lunch before we left and stopped by the Coronado Cafe (inside the casino)...Our waitres Maricel was very courteous.   I got the Chicken Fingers and they were quite good.  My husband opted to get the Meatloaf and he managed to woof it down in record time.   Yes....We would like to return to the South Point Hotel & Casino next time we are in the area.   We highly recommend it.

reviews.title: Fantastic Hotel
