reviews.text: Our stay at South Point was amazing. From the minute we drove up we received prompt and friendly service.   The line for check-in was a little long, but moved along very quickly. The bell hop was very helpful and brought our luggage to our room quickly. Our room, a king premium was very nice!  I liked our room with no carpet....they also provided complimentary slippers! There are so many restaurants, however, we only went to the Coronado, Steak-n- Shake and the buffet, all 3 good. The casino is your typical casino, but very friendly and always offering drinks.  We found out that my husband bowled earlier in the day which made it possible for us to leave a day earlier than planned and the front desk was so helpful and kind advising us that if we checked out before noon, we wouldn't be charged for the room for that night.  Everything about South Point was amazing, however, the most amazing thing was that I left my 2 Kindle tablets in our room and discovered it at 10 pm the night we left.  I immediately called the hotel and housekeeping knew exactly about it . I completed the claim form on-line and talked with a gentleman the next day, who was so helpful and understanding of the situation. They sent my tablets via USPS to me. I still can't believe that I left them behind, but I am SO THANKFUL for the honest and caring staff at South Point. I would stay at South Point anytime over the hectic craziness of the strip hotels.   THANK YOU SOUTH POINT!!!

reviews.title: Disappointing From All Views
reviews.text: This property has one of the worst ventilation systems I've seen yet in Las Vegas. Upon walking in the main entry you are overcome with the smell of smoke. I will admit being from Washington state we are no longer exposed to smokers when we go out to eat or to the bar so yes a bit more sensitive. That said the majority of the casinos have excellent ventilation systems and/or a non-smoking section within the main floor. This is not the case at South Point. Even the rooms you can tell at one point were smoking even though we were on a non-smoking floor. The food is simply okay, there is nothing to write home about. Sadly I'd tell you the SBC was likely the best thing we had all weekend.  We tried to go to the one 'nice' restaurant, Michael's, and the host was so rude about my husband wearing shorts. We did not realize there was a dress code and gladly would have changed but he essentially told us they were booked when my husband walked in. I made a reservation on Open Table (very easily which should have been my first clue) and when we walked in to be seated the same host was rude and said my husband was not welcome due to his attire. What a shame as we were with a group of six and would have gladly changed but this guy definitely did not want us there. The pool is nice. They did a nice job curving the pool so that a large number of guests can sit pool side. The gym is decent, although the bikes are not intended to actually be used beyond a lackluster workout. We did not try the spa or salon. The rooms are very plain, the linens extremely cheap. One extra role of toilet paper, no extra towels of any sort. Everything in the room seemed as though a) they were just giving you enough to get by and b) really didn't anticipate you being in the room that often.  This is fine and typical Vegas but at the same time I came to relax, I did not have my kids with and I'd like to have a dry towel to take a shower after a work out as well as after I come up from the pool.  Also the fuse blew in our bathroom twice and half the outlets in the room did not work. It wasn't awful it was simply nothing to write home about and feel they could have done quite a bit more to make this hotel really stand out.

reviews.title: Excellent 2nd Stay at South Point
reviews.text: This is a great, clean, friendly property away from the busy sections on the strip yet conveniently located to shopping, good restaurants, and all access roads.Our room on the 24th floor had a nice view of the pool and was serviced daily and nicely by the housekeeping staff. Any requests for supplies, etc were handled promptly and courteously. The hotel offers several good dining options, a nice movie theater, and friendly slots!Highly recommend.

reviews.title: Great place
reviews.text: Came out here for the US bowling Congress open tournament. The people here are friendly, staff is courteous, very accommodating. The casino is huge and the hotel is even bigger, it's clean and the rooms are huge. I would definitely recommend it.

reviews.title: Casino and Buffet review
reviews.text: We stayed next door at Grandview next door so I can't comment on the rooms at the South Point Hotel. Grandview was easy to get around, rooms a good size, clean. Elevators fast. However there was not a balcony to sit on; all our other timeshare places have it so we really missed that. No ceiling fans but windows did open a bit. Casino is roomy. They don't squeeze machines and chairs in every space so you had room to go up and down. Didn't smell smoke either. They don't allow cigars in certain places like the sports book which is great. A nice variety of machines unlike some of the casinos what have mostly Keno and Poker. We had the buffet breakfast several days.  With the card it was only $10. And... they have fresh donuts !  No watermelon though.  Nice variety for breakfast. We had dinner there one night - the Prime Rib night. It was just okay but they have a nice variety. They have a theatre and bowling alley but they also have a professional bowling alley with tournaments.  We didn't know the second alley was there. They don't have much recreation things at the hotel though but I guess they think you want the casino. Place was clean, neat, big, and roomy. Was nice to be away from the Strip. However, if driving to the strip, many places you have to pay to park. We found Trop doesn't charge and Planet Hollywood did not the last time. We parked at Tropicana and bought the 24 hour bus pass to go up and down the strip. We like the Trop for the casino so it was an easy choice. Yes casinos charge for more than 1 hour - can be as high as $15 for the day. South Point did not charge that I could see. Again, we really liked the Casino because of the roominess and no cigarette smell.  They have a Steak N Shake inside !

reviews.title: Pleasant surprise
reviews.text: I want to start this review by saying my husband and i have stayed at every high end property on the strip. The Wynn is my favorite. Since we received a free offer at Southpoint we decided to give it a tryIts not a five star property but we were pleasantly surprised at how much we enjoyed our stay there.PROPERTY: easy check in and check out Free shuttle to and from the airport. The only stops were at the airlines people on the shuttle were using. The property has several restaurants in varying price ranges. We ate at the deli, Primarily Prime Rib and Don Vitos. All we good. The property also has a bowling alley and a movie theater. You can purchase pop corn there without seeing a movie.  There is also a great hot dog cart by the sports book with hot dogs for $1.25!I have always complained how the strip casinos gouge you for water. Not Southpoint. $2.79 for a large bottle. ROOM:  i noticed someone complained about laminate flooring. I was happy to see it because its easier to keep clean. Our room was spotless. No, it didn’t have 5 star furnishings but what they did have was clean and comfortable. The bed was comfortable and the pillows were better than adequate. I hate cheap wimpy pillows and thin towels. Not a problem here. BATHROOM: the tub had a safety bar which is a must for me. The towels were nice and fairly thick. My only complaint here was the toilet paper! It was like tissue paper. I could forgive that because of all the positivesCASINO:  we found the casino great for our needs. Plenty of slots with different variety. The casino area was clean and slots gave me lots of play. We also found the staff at the club desk very polite and helpful. Other people may have different experiences but for us it was a very nice stay with only a toilet paper complaint!! LolWe look forward to staying there again. Thank you Southpoint

reviews.title: Eh
reviews.text: It’ll do but nothing special, not really worth the rate. Rooms were really hot and mattresses not that great. Housekeeping entered the room in the morning without even knocking while everyone was still in bed, huge no no in the hotel room

reviews.title: Second time was as good as the first
reviews.text: This was our second time staying at southpoint and we would stay again if ever in Vegas, our room was large and spotless clean and very quiet which is saying something with all the people in the hotel and casino we were there for a bowling tournament so this hotel had to be full, I also like its off the strip only thing I didn’t like was the resort fee with all the money you spend in Las Vegas no hotel should charge a resort fee.

reviews.title: Easy to stay in one place
reviews.text: We stayed here as we were participating in the USBC bowling tournament and could minimize hauling bowling balls around. They also offer a discount if you book through the bowling tournament website. Our rooms were spacious and fairly clean. Also, parking is free, even in the deck. There are multiple onsite restaurants and they offer a coupon book to help keep you on-site. The downside is getting from the parking deck to your hotel room. It would be nice if we didn't have to go through the casino. Due to our busy schedule, we didn't get to make use of the pool but the area is beautiful and spacious. We did use the hot tub and it was pretty nice. Not sure I would stay here again as I like to have a refrigerator and microwave in my room for extended stays (5 nights) and a refrigerator was only available for an extra fee. I did hear one guest say they are doing renovations and adding refrigerators, so may reconsider staying here.

reviews.title: Dirty Room
reviews.text: I was reluctant to stay at South Point because it is so far off the Vegas strip. But because I had been invited to speak at a convention and due to the fact many of my clients were there I decided to stay. I wasn’t expecting too much, but even at that I was sorely disappointed.  This morning I had scheduled an appointment with a client to get a coffee at a coffee shop in the lobby called “Seattle’s Best” but unfortunately due to a flood in there back room they turned us away.  They directed us to their Deli around the corner but the line was very long.  Had to reschedule the meeting. After my meeting I joined my wife at the pool and had plans for dinner with another client around 6:00.  When we arrived back at our room at 5:15 we were disappointed to find that our room hadn’t been cleaned and all our towels were dirty.  I called the front desk spoke to Gregg.  I told him I had an appointment and we needed to get ready.  He assured me that someone would be to the room within 15 minutes.  I told my wife to hold off on getting ready for dinner until the towels arrived.  15 minutes came and went.  After 30 minutes I decided to go to the Front desk.  On the way to elevator I ran into the house keeper and asked her if she was on the way to my room.  She was very nice, but showed me a list of approximately 15 rooms that needed to be cleaned. I was nowhere near the top.  I continued to the desk, and the young lady at the desk and she called housekeeping and told them to prioritize our room, but explained there was still a couple rooms in front of me. I asked to speak to the front office manager Jillian Catillo. That I had to cancel my appointment with a client and that my wife was forced to dry-off with dirty towels.  Her response was “well they are your dirty towels- right”. I was applauded at that response.  In the end she was willing to take $47.00 off my bill for purchases I had made.  Needless to say I missed dinner with my client.  My room finally got cleaned at 6:45. The house maid explained that they only had 11 housecleaning staff on for the entire facility.  I would not recommend this place for any sort of business.

reviews.title: Clean, large rooms, beautiful pool area.
reviews.text: Off the main strip, but really has everything you need right there!   Great pool area, we enjoyed the back adult section, and good food options.   Keep in mind you need to haul luggage thru the casino to get to the hotel section - not a big deal unless you are only staying one night and have 10 days worth of luggage (like me).  Easy parking, easy check-in.  Excellent breakfast buffet for about $15.

reviews.title: Friendly and convenient
reviews.text: Stayed for 3 days on way home from a busy trip to the states. Just wanted to chill out and get some sun and laze by the pool. It was great. Free shuttle from airport. The room was massive almost a suite. The pool area was clean.  Lots of sun beds and a jacuzzi and pool side bar. The only downside was the food. I only really enjoyed the salad bar which was fresh and lots of variety. The rest of the food was so so. But you got a book of vouchers for a couple of free drinks and offers for the restaurants so it was pretty generous with the quantity if not the quality. If you want somewhere off the strip I would recommend it.

reviews.title: I'm staying there again
reviews.text: This is one place you must visit and stay if your in Las Vegas. It has lot of attractions and it is located close to the strip. The people working there are very kind, wonderful, courteous, and very helpful. Dining facilities, gaming, and the rooms are nicely cleaned and easy to find.

reviews.title: Nice property for work stay
reviews.text: A very well kept, up to date property, at the far bottom end of the Strip.  Front desk staff was nice, efficent and upbeat.Room was very spacious, clean, and well amenitied.Eat dinner at the Coronado Cafe.  Horrible cold fries.  Pastrami sandwich described as "piled high on rye bread"; was no more than a thin sandwich you would expect to find at a gas station.  Disappointing

reviews.title: Cowboy Place
reviews.text: Nice stay. Hydraulics to improve. Efficient workers. Several options for meals. Fantastic bowling. Hats and horses. It's Vegas, but more quiet. Could explain lots of senior guests. To people that know what matters.

reviews.title: Out of the way
reviews.text: South Point is not on the main strip or Fremont Street, but we really enjoyed our stay here. It is a large hotel/casino that contains 2 bowling alleys, an arena where they hold horde shows and numerous other conference areas. While we were there for the national bowling tournament, the World Cup Arabian horse show was going on as well as a gymnastics tournaments. The outdoor pool was beautiful and well kept with a bar & snack bar. The casino was nice, well kept & I think there were 5 bars on the casino floor. There were also 7 restaurants at this facility to meet everyone’s tastes. This was our second stay at South Point and we will stay here the next time the tournament is in Las Vegas.

reviews.title: So much better than the strip
reviews.text: We go to Vegas about twice per year.Spend about $2-3000 per trip..For the 5 years before finding South point. we went to the Strip (different hotels each time ) and were treated like dirt.. Rooms not ready. Lied to about rewards, and much more. Outrageous prices and horrible  service. Nickel and dimed for everything imaginable.Finally went off strip to Southpoint. Great room, great service, good prices. Finally treated like a human being..If you want to go to the Strip, take an Uber.  Will not cost more than the outlandish parking fees now demanded by all strip hotels

reviews.title: A ton to do there!
reviews.text: I was impressed that parking was super easy and open.  They also have underground parking.  There is a great theatre inside with $5 movie nights on Tuesday.  A nice buffet, Shake Shack, and rodeos going all the time.  I never stayed there (because I live in Vegas) but we go almost every Tuesday for $5 movie and snack night.  Not overly crowded either which is great.

reviews.title: Loved the Spa
reviews.text: I was rather impressed with the Spa area of this casino.  Granted the air quality wasn’t as desired but it’s a casino where smoking is allowed.  But the Spa massage, jacuzzi area was amazing.  I can’t recall who I was with but he definitely was worth every moment.

reviews.title: All in one
reviews.text: We visited Southpoint to watch the wrestling championship. It has a lot of restaurants, gaming and other activities. They have a bowling alley, movie theater and a lot of events. They have specials when you use your club card on certain days. We earned free meals and the food was great.

reviews.title: Low-End, Smoke-Filled, Old-Feeling dive of a hotel.
reviews.text: We knew the minute we walked in that we had made a mistake. They promoted themselves 180 degrees from what they are. Filled with local-types - all smokers - who come for the free self-parking and lower table stakes. Room was tacky, poorly-appointed (still with the low wattage flourescent light bulbs) crooked lampshades, dingy thin towels. We just needed a one-nighter for a close-by meeting so thought we'd give this a try. Never again.

reviews.title: Horrific Experience.
reviews.text: This hotel is dated, gross and the staff in literally insane The staff will not help, or do anything to go out of their way. They actually act like you are working at the hotel and not them. They are also liars and tell lies about guests. Completely disgusting experience

reviews.title: Big and nice regional casino
reviews.text: Easy access off the 15 freeway. Lots of free parking.  Huge casino with many restaurants and features including movies!   Clean and well kept.  A bit Smokey.  Several good restaurants to pick from.  Big stop on the rodeo tour as well.

reviews.title: Big plave
reviews.text: We got stranded here after our airline oversold the flight home. It’s a big enough place that one can be entertained well without leaving the property. Great spot for people watching... lots of restaurants. Bed was hard but room was quiet. Excellent staff.

reviews.title: Stay there just don't eat there.
reviews.text: Great Room for the price. Very disappointed with the food. The buffet was pretty standard. Baja Miguels was just bad. The regular salsa was bland, The hot salsa was fiery hot but no flavor. Carne Asada was bland. Service was good.

reviews.title: South Point At the Top of My List
reviews.text: This review is the subjective opinion of an individual traveller and not of Tripadvisor LLC nor of its partners. Tripadvisor performs checks on reviews as part of our industry-leading trust & safety standards. Read our transparency report to learn more.

reviews.title: Great place to stay for a national bowling tournament
reviews.text: Stay here for five days recently with five guys bowling in the national bowling tournament. Great homebase as all the activities for bowling are in the same facility. Very convenient and no love in your balls in and out of taxis. Rooms are nicely updated with large bathrooms and good showers. Water pressure was great and air-conditioning worked well. Cleaning staff to the next one job and the beds are fairly decent for a hotel. Pillows are foam Which is nice. Would stay here again the next time the tournament comes to town.

reviews.title: Away from the strip
reviews.text: Excellent casino hotel away from the strip in nice part of Las Vegas. Close to airport, restaurants, pharmacy, grocery stores and much more.  South Point is large but not overwhelming.  Plenty of gambling opportunities.  11 restaurants that include fast food and upscale dining in addition to great buffet. There is also bowling and cinema within South Point.   Location is great to visit other activities in Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: Stayed here April 6-12. This was my tenth stay at SP and enjoyed my stay. Check in staff was very friendly and accommodating. Was a lot going on while the hotel was sold out and with good reason. Bowling tournament team roping was fun to watch. Coffee shop Baja Miguel’s and the buffet was very good and well priced.

reviews.title: Saving money.
reviews.text: We stayed at South Point because of the price point, but there are certainly nicer hotels and resorts on the strip. While the resort offers much for families, including movie theater and full bowling alley, there’s really no shopping or other excitement that compares to, for example, the Bellagio or Venetian. It’s also very costly to take a cab, Uber or Lyft to the strip. Stay here if you “don’t” want to be near Vegas.

reviews.title: Nice Economical Vegas Hotel Casino
reviews.text: I've stayed here 6 times now for an annual convention and This time was better as the hotel has recently undertaken a remodel on rooms. Now they have removed the carpet in the rooms and installed a laminate floor. Its a bit noisy but is so much cleaner than old carpet. Rooms are large and bathrooms are huge although it doesn't appear these were updated. Never a problem with hot water either. I enjoy staying here as there is plenty to do and is away from the action on the strip. The casino is large and the slots pay well *most* of the time. The on site restaurants are very good especially Silverado Steakhouse and Don Vitos. The only thing thats  not to my liking is the need to flash your key in the evening to get to the elevators. No key means you're not getting past security. It also means visitors need to be met in the casino. There is a nice gift shop and I love that I can buy a bottle of Dom Perignon for a very good price. I'll be back again next year and will enjoy it again.

reviews.title: Bowling Tournament
reviews.text: Great place to stay! Rooms are spotless, food is very good! Casino is nice! Not a lot of smoke! They must suck the smoke up in the ceiling! We loved it! Everyone who works there is pleasant! Would definitely go again!

reviews.title: A Great Remodel & Buffet
reviews.text: The buffet was remodel a few months ago. It looks great, but the food is really great after the remodel. They have a whole extra salad/soup bar that is great. We really like the improvements. Plus the gamling at South Point is gret.

reviews.title: Fun Time
reviews.text: South Point is a fun place to stay.  Lots to do even if you don't gamble.  I enjoyed movies, bowling and excellent food while the men were playing golf.  I enjoyed sitting by the pool and sipping cold drinks.  South Point has something for everyone!

reviews.title: Business
reviews.text: Great Place to stay.No Casino has a better Sports Book.  They are the best of the best in a Business that is very competitive.  For example they actually have Pens to write with.  The Westgate is cheap and leaves out pencils.  I’m just saying that it’s the little things they do to take care of the clients who go the Book to place Wagers.

reviews.title: One night stay
reviews.text: We had a offer for 2 free nights but only could stay 1' The check in was good real fast. The room was big,clean and updated. The people at check in were pleasant and friendly. We met friends at bingo and had a good time. I would stay there again the next time we are in Vegas.

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: The people are very friendly and helpful. I was very impressed with the spa. The restaurants are very good and a large assortment. I plan to stay here again. Everything was very beautiful and well kept.

reviews.title: Management is the only issue
reviews.text: The rooms are nice and roomy, just wish they left more towels instead of having to ask all the time. They have plenty of things to do in the hotel.  I do wish they had a dedicated desk person to help existing guests as it could take a long time in line to ask for something as easy as another room key.  I had an issue with shipping some items to the hotel and the hotel would not budge in trying to assist me.  I was basically called a liar and when they asked me for my room number, did they not think I knew why they asked?  I know if I was a guest who stayed there a lot and paid full price, then they might consider helping me, but knowing I wasn't, they basically blamed the booking site, which had nothing to do with my issue, as it was not booking related.  Just so coldly handled.  Please do not ship anything to them.  Just ship it to the local UPS store as they don't charge for that.

reviews.title: Off the busy strip
reviews.text: We stayed here for our 20th anniversary quick get away.  It has lots of amenities that you can find at all the other casinos in Vegas at a fraction of the price.  Great customer service.  The bed was awesome!  I even emailed to find out what brand, type to get us one.

reviews.title: Great as always
reviews.text: We stay at the South Point every year for 5 nights.  We stayed in a remodeled room this year and it was very nice.  The hotel is very smokey but the $1.00 Mimosas and Bloody Mary's made up for it! Service was good as always.  Elevators are always a problem for The Vegas Shoot.

reviews.title: Great find off the Strip!
reviews.text: We go to Vegas about 6 times a year, staying a week or so each time.  We usually stay on the Strip. Our friends recommended this hotel, and because we always get a rental car it was no big deal to stay off the strip. We love this place!  It sure beats the busy Strip.  It sort of feels like home, nice relaxing atmosphere.  The prices are great. Asides from gambling there is bowling and a huge movie theatre, an arcade for kids. Also they host a lot of equestrian events in their arena which really appeals to me ( free to watch).  When we checked in they gave us a free coupon book, which helped for discounts at restaurants there etc.  The buffet was fantastic and so cheap! (Especially with the coupons!!). We met with a Casino Host who can potentially comp us rooms etc based on our gambling. I love the poker room there, it’s huge and they have tournaments every day including different games like PLO etc. A great find. We are forsure coming back. I’m also going to take my dad here this year for a weekend as our annual Vegas trip.  PS: Nice to not have to pay for parking!!

reviews.title: Always stay at South Point
reviews.text: I have been visiting Las Vegas once a year for many years. I stayed at 3 other properties before discovering South Point Hotel Casino and Spa, and have stayed here ever since. This hotel is comfortable, clean, and fun. The restaurants are great and the recently updated Garden Buffet is better than ever and still a good deal. I love the omelet station at breakfast and the chefs worked hard to keep the line moving. The Coronado Cafe is a staple 24/7 restaurant that is always open and always delicious. The steak special and graveyard specials are especially good. I have always loved the large clean hotel rooms, but I really enjoyed the new Premium room I booked. The wood floors and new furniture were beautiful. I loved having a refrigerator in the room, and the hi-speed internet worked like a charm. South Point has an amazing showroom with reasonably priced events such as The Letterman. Free tickets to The Dennis Bono show are a must if you are staying on a Thursday, as it is one of the best shows in Vegas. South Point also has a fitness room with a wide variety of equipment and a large pool and jacuzzi for relaxing. There are newer slots and the Sports and Racebook are comfortable. The only critique I have is that the casino is crowded on the weekends ( because it is so good) and internet access is weak in the casino. You will enjoy your stay at South Point.

reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.text: This  is our second time to stay at Southpoint hotel casino and spa. I can’t say good enough things about this hotel. Everything you need is right here. The rooms are nice and clean, comfortable beds, the buffet is pretty good, they have a really nice pool even though I didn’t use it because it’s a little cold today for my liking. The staff has been very pleasant.   If you want to go downtown or to the strip it’s easy to just hook up an Uber driver. This will definitely be where we stay every time we come to Vegas

reviews.title: Very good hotel
reviews.text: Nice hotel with clean, new and well decorated rooms of decent size. Abundance of good restaurants on site. Very good for conferences and meetings. Quite remote from the city though, circa 15 drive to Strip.

reviews.title: Basketball MAC Tournament
reviews.text: Everything I needed, variety of foods,games, movie theater,etc.They accommodated us (UNM) FOR PEP RALLIES.   WE used our courtsey cards to get discounts at buffet and discount at theater on designated days.The room was as ordered, in the middle of Galway and not far from my friends!

reviews.title: No Hype
reviews.text: Quick and easy check in by pleasant staff.  Very comfortable, clean room & nice hot shower ( a real shower , not a watering can!). The casino has something for everyone. Everyone having a good time. Good restaurants & sports bar as well as an oyster bar. If you want the glitz & glitter of the strip, this is not for you. this is not a "touristy" extravaganza ....just a great hotel to somewhat get away from it all but still have some fun. It is however easy to get to the strip if you must go there. If the casino is not your attraction, then enjoy the pool, the movie theater, the bowling, entertainment and sports book or race book and also the spa. They have it all.

reviews.title: Hotel has everything that you need in Las Vegas
reviews.text: W back in 4 monthse had the Casino; Bowling; Movies theaters; spamany restaurants.Casino has the best Slot machines in Vegasthey do pay.the person next to me won switrh $2.00 $10,000.00my wife and I we played an average of $100,00 a day after 7 daysof many hours playing we only lost $200.00great place we will be back in 4n months

reviews.title: Great hotel for the price
reviews.text: The room was very clean and spacious.  A good selection of restaurants in hotel.  Located south of the strip so rental car necessary to visit the strip area but motel offered free parking. Front desk personnel very helpful when my party had to stay an extra night due to flight change.  The only negative is having to pass through casino to get to room area....smoking allowed so we had to smell/ breathe the odor.

reviews.title: Unified Bowling Special Olympic tournament
reviews.text: I wasn't impressed with the Garden Buffet, but the Coronado Café served a variety of meals and they were good.  Baja Miguel's was very good. The Casino was all right.  I wasn't impressed with the smokiness of it though.  Also, they did not offer shuttle service to the Strip.  You had to take an Uber.

reviews.title: Friends getaway
reviews.text: Great hotel and casino. Restaurants were good.Had a great time.Went to some shows at southpoint.The spa and gym were excellent. Will definitely come back.We stayed there the whole time. WE had fun at the bars .

reviews.title: Unexpectedly wonderful!!!
reviews.text: We stayed for four days with my daughter and 2 grandkids.  Amazing stay.  OMG It has a cineplex theater with 14 theaters, a huge bowling alley, restaurants for all ages and so much more.  The kids enjoyed it.  We enjoyed it.  We never had to leave the hotel.  Highly recommend it.  Will likely always stay here when in Vegas from now on.

reviews.title: Best Off the strip Hotel Casino & Spa
reviews.text: This is our all time favourites off the strip hotel. I think it has the best spa/swimming pool area that i have seen so far.Plenty of free parking on site. Shuttle service is available for the airport. There is also a shuttle service (chargeable) to the strip (stand is next to the front entrance)If you can go for the upgraded rooms. They will have a coffee maker, Refrigerator and a Safe. The floor has been upgraded from carpets to wooden laminated wooden type floor.It can get very busy, so book early. I have always found the staff to be very friendly and helpful.This casino has everything i.e. bawling, Cinema, spa, pools, restaurants, theatres, buffet dining and a gym etc etc.This casino is off the strip. You will either need a rental car or take the shuttle or take a cab to the strip.There is nothing near the casino that you can walk to, apart from MacDonald's, Danny's  and few other restaurants.I would rate this hotel casino 10/10 and we will always stay here in the future.

reviews.title: LOVE this resort!!!
reviews.text: This has to be my favorite resort in Vegas...bar none.  The atmosphere, space, quality of the restaurants and bingo room..and the rest of the countless amenities are all superb.  It's a little out of the way if you're looking for someplace close to everything to stay or play..but worth the trip.  If I had to make one minor quibble, it would be that the rates are sometimes a little high to stay there.  The rooms are nice...but not spectacular.  Nevertheless, this is a minor quibble..and overall I LOVE this resort.

reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.text: We have always stay at Mandlay bay and cosmopolitan but south point came under the recommendation of a friend, now we will always stay here..Service here is 5 star, room was so nice and the hotel is close to many things..We had dinners in all the restaurants but Micheals and the service and food was really great.There was a great variety of resturants..Thank you South Point..We will be back..

reviews.title: Excellent Hotel/Casino in Las Vegas
reviews.text: Have stayed at South point Hotel/Casino on several occasions. Far enough from the strip if looking for less excitement and overall volume of people and traffic, yet close enough to be a part of it.   Many Amenities offered including shuttle bus, plenty of variety of restaurants for all tastes and price ranges, Variety of gambling options, entertainment etc. Most importantly, the staff is superb at all levels. Very attentive to your needs, informative. ALWAYS willing to do whatever it takes to make your experience there a pleasant one.   Rooms are great, Always neat and clean and very reasonable. Cannot say enough good things about them

reviews.title: If you like the smell of smoke and awful food stay here.
reviews.text: Flight was cancelled and the airline put us up at the South Point Casio.The place was awful, all restaurants and our hotel room smelled like smoke.  Nothing is near by and I felt like I entered a redneck convention.  The airline gave us vouchers for meals at the casino. We are at the Mexican restaurant and the margaritas were so sweet that they were not edible and the food was equally as bad.Biggest mistake was not getting into a cab and checking into a different hotel.  I would have been better off paying for a better place to stay instead of taking the free room from the airline.

reviews.title: Awesome Horse Show Facility
reviews.text: They have just upgraded the rooms, and they are very nice! Everything you could dream of as a horse show facility. Good food, good gambling, nice movie theaters. Awesome stalls, arenas, wash racks, vet, shower, all indoors.

reviews.title: Business Conference
reviews.text: Well done South Point.Nice surprise.  Flew into Las Vegas and it was snowing, go figure.  Took cab from airport to south point hotel and spa. It’s about 8 miles south of strip on Las Vegas blvd.Check-in was quick. Got to room and was pleased.  Very clean, spacious, and did not smell of cigarettes.  Bed was comfortable.Conference set up was phenomenal. Close to hotel elevators are the conference rooms and presentation areas. This is the exact opposite of every conference I have attended at strip hotels, where hiking boots are required for the trek.Food was exceptional. Buffet was quite nice. Gaming floor was well run. Open tables were always just enough to accommodate players. Not so happy with reduced craps odds (2,2-1/2,3x) but dealers were friendly.Restaurants were great but I do not recommend the deli.  Bottom line is that South Point did such a great job that we never let the property for the entire 3 days of the conference.  Kudos

reviews.title: Really great place to stay and gamble
reviews.text: This is a long way from the strip or downtown and we found it best to stay within the hotel. There are plenty of things to do other than gamble but most of our time was at the tables. The rooms were great and we really felt at home here.

reviews.title: Nice
reviews.text: Gave it a try. Was nicer than expected. No parking fees, comfy quiet rooms. Casino is easy to get to and from. Plenty of options for food. Beds were comfortable and nice bath towels, large tv to watch for local news. Would stay here again.

reviews.title: South point has everything
reviews.text: South Point as the names implies is South of the airport and out of the "Strip".  That has its good points and bad.  First the good.  Off the beaten track which means less hassle and bussle.  Many restaurant to please all.  There is even a Steak & Shake for the budget minded Gambler.  Meal range from the $4.00 Steak & Shake to $60.00 q plate French Restaurant.  They have the ever popular Buffey and a good everyday restaurant like a Bob Evens or Dennys.  Many, many slots and all the good table games.Now the bad.  Off the the dtrip means you will miss all the excitment, the shows and the stores.  Of course you can get a cab down for an evening but the cab will cost you about the same as a car rental which is not a bad idea.  That way you can take a drive to Red Rock Cannon or down to Hover Dam for a tour of this most impressive sight.This was not my first time at the South Point but my 5th.  But with that said, I was there for meetings and saved time for sight seeing.

reviews.title: Cigarette Smoke Everywhere
reviews.text: It's like stepping back in time. The whole place reeks of cigarettes. There are no laundry facilities. They do not sell Febreze in the gift shops. All they offer is expensive dry cleaning which takes a full day. You can't get to the room elevators without going through the casino. The hallway carpets emanate Eau de Ashtray. The only refuge was my room, which had laminate floors.The hotel does have a full Cinemark movie theater which was nice and a bowling alley. The restaurants were not worth bothering with, considering how many awesome places there are to eat in Vegas.

reviews.title: Better than it was 2 years ago
reviews.text: Room was clean and in good shape.  Beds were comfortable. Food in the restaurants was ok but too expensive. Staff was helpful and friendly. Bowling alley was clean and in good shape. The things that were not good:  that horse arena just stinks and the hotel has chosen to pipe in a perfume smell to cover the arena stink.  It is not working!One night we had prime rib,  the color of prime rib was orange, not edible!The Deli was excellent. The  ice cream shop was good. Coffee shop was good. The bars were excellent.  Although lines to get into get food was were all long.The hot tub still has awful raised grates on the bottom.  You can't help but stub your toes multiple times.  I went to the pool one time and there were no clean towels.I would stay at this hotel again. The staff makes it a really family friendly place.I have to give a shout out to the housekeeping staff.  Many hotels do not clean the bath tubs because they think no one takes baths just showers.  This hotel cleans its tubs and I was able to enjoy a bath.

reviews.title: Its ok
reviews.text: We go yearly for a work trip. Have been going since 2012.  They've done some room Reno's on the past year.  It's a decent hotel. Has a bowling alley, large arena, lots and lots of slots, decent restaurants, a movie theatre.  It's off the main strip though just as a warningThe pool is nice with fake grass! I go because I have to but there are worse places to be at!

reviews.title: Great Stay and Resort
reviews.text: Great location, resort, staff, rooms, AND the BEST, Quickest, sportsbook around 24/7.All restaurants are top notch. Casino staff are very friendly.The rooms are clean. The pool is good.All amenities including movie theater, bowling, spa. horse arena help make this place an amazing resort that you do not need to leave

reviews.title: SuperBowl weekend festivities
reviews.text: This facility has everything any person or family could want to have near during this "Humongous" happening.  Tremendous food, music even a movie theatre to pass the time before THE GAME.  Four days made me feel like I wanted to move to Nevada just to be closer to the fun.

reviews.title: World Championship Archery Hotel
reviews.text: There is plenty to do in the casino/hotel. Slots, movies, betting, poker, and bowling is available. Most of the different kinds of food. Actually over a 4-5 day stay, I rarely leave the property. Food is a little pricey, but normal for Las Vegas today. I recommend getting a player's card and noting the special offers and times for the buffets.

reviews.title: Food Allergy friendly resort
reviews.text: I have a child with a plethora of food allergies.  Before coming to stay at South Point, I followed the website’s request and emailed them the allergies.  This put me in touch with one of their chefs who communicated back and forth, notified all their restaurants and gave us information on which restaurants were able to handle allergies and which weren’t.  He even followed up with us during our stay.  The result, my son has never eaten so well while at restaurants.  He was taken such good care of.  If we go back to Vegas, this will be our first choice of places to stay. The rest of our stay was delightful too.

reviews.title: A nice hotel off the strip
reviews.text: My husband had a work trip there for a week in January and I joined for three nights and enjoyed the property .  We had one of the larger renovated rooms they were very nice and we’re glad to see coffee maker in the room  We had dinner at the Italian restaurant and the steakhouse and lunch in the sushi and buffet we enjoyed all of our meals .  The Italian being our favorite .We used a coupon book they gave us a check in and enjoyed complimentary wine in both the Italian restaurant and the and steak restaurant .I was fortunate the weather was very nice for January at almost 70° and was able to sit and wait by the pool . I used their fitness room which was very nice with lots of equipment I was one of only a few people  each time there was plenty of towels and water . They also had a complementary shuttle to and from the airport we Ubered there but I shuttled back. If they have their meeting there again next year I will be back .

reviews.title: Hotel was nice but not family friendly
reviews.text: We stayed at the South Point because my son was shooting in the Vegas shoot. We were reluctant to go to Vegas but this was a wonderful opportunity for my son. The website states it is family friendly. However, we got there around 10 a.m. and there were half naked women/waitresses in the casino area. The Casino area is in the middle of the hotel and reaks of smoke. You had to go through that area as you enter the hotel to get to the restaurants. I get people think these half naked women are appealing, but why have them out during the day???? Its sad these women feel the need to dress like this to get attention and South Point obviously is an advocate of this trashy behavior. I would have expected this at any other hotel in Vegas but because South Point advertises that they are family friendly.....this is what disappoints me. Also walking through the Casino area to get to the bowling, we stopped to watch someone on the slot machines and a worker told us the kids couldnt be in the gaming area????? You have to go by the gaming area to get to the bowling area??? Why put these machines there next to the kids area if you dont want kids watching????? And lastly, the hotel room smelled of smoke. I'm sure due to all of the smokers in the Casino. This is my fault, I didnt research to see if this was a smoke free Casino. I just assumed. But the half naked women and the slots next to bowling/arcade is ridiculous. Children have to go right by them to get to the "family friendly" events the hotel advertises. The hotel was clean and really nice outside of the concerns stated above. The resturants were a bit spendy. We went to Steak and Shake, Coranodo, and Dennys across the street (which was our favorite and kids eat dinner free). All of these were family friendly and on a family friendly budget. The Garden Buffet looked nice but they wouldn't discount our kids so we didnt eat there. There was NO way our kids would eat $13 of food. For dinner the buffet was $35 per person. Shew! We plan to go back to Vegas to watch my son shoot the Vegas shoot next year, but we will be staying next door. South Point just isnt as family friendly as it advertised. It's sad we trusted their website only to find this wasnt the case.

reviews.title: UPDATED room, VERY nice, loved our stay.
reviews.text: First let me clarify, we stayed in a newly renovated room...so that's what my review is going off of. We haven't every stayed here previously. But our room was SPOTLESS and very nice. It was roomy, had a fantastic view, nice furnishings. The staff was friendly enough, valet service staff were VERY friendly. The restaurants in this hotel are great. The pool area was very impressive to us, it was clean and well-kept and looked beautiful. We loved our stay here and would return!

reviews.title: Disgustingly dirty and super tight slots
reviews.text: We're locals but had never been to this place until last night. We went just to check it out and gamble. All I can say is that I will never go back. The gaming area was jam packed and dirty. I used the ladies room and there were feces smeared all over the floor! The slots are the tightest that I have ever seen. I have played at nearly every major casino in the city and I can honestly say this was the worst. We didn't stay overnight. Maybe the rooms are nice. If they are you wouldn't know it judging by the casino floor.

reviews.title: family vacation
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel.  staff is always willing to assist Beautiful rooms!   Great pool area and great place for adults and kids to enjoy. Highly recommend The South Point Hotel to anyone wanting a quality staying experience!

reviews.title: Same terrific advantages while in Vegas, but getting old...
reviews.text: We have stayed here before because of the great attributes it has:  Far from the Madding Crowd of the Central Strip area which is now swamped with Chinese tourists so you can regroup and rest up for your next foray into the shows and venues, but close enough and simple enough to drive in.  Parking is FREE, on the strip they are charging extortion rates to park--$30 for evening Valet Parking????  Used to be free!  Not here though.  Safe, clean, with good activities and always some special event going on.  On the other hand, the prices are bouncing up, there is an insane "Resort Fee" all the hotels charge for essentially delivering Nothing, $21 here, up to $25 in other resorts.  You spend your money in the hotel and they charge you to do it!  The carpet need replace, the walls could use a wash.  The place is still fun and worth it.

reviews.title: Mecam Motorcycle auction visit
reviews.text: Had a great stay here, check in was seamless, friendly staff, room was clean and spacious,all you would need, great coffee machine. Good shower and nice bathroom products. pleasant of restaurants to chose from, bars were good with friendly staff, overall we really enjoyed the stay, typical American casino hotel. Excellent and not too far from the strip for a visit, Taxi rides are reasonable, but to be honest, there is more going on at the tables as the hotel is a little isolated, so why leave? Will stay here again.

reviews.title: Super Bowl Weekend at South Point
reviews.text: We stayed at the South Point for Super Bowl weekend. Room is nice, could use an update, but all in all a decent room for the price. Gambling was fun, actually won money and took some home. Would definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: Rooms are good enough
reviews.text: I just spent 4 days at the South Point for a convention being held at the hotel. I decided to stay here vs the strip because the hotel itself is one of the 2 hotels farthest from the strip and I didn't want to commute back and forth every day. Cabs and ubers tend to be more expensive here and I didn't want to rent a car. The hotel is HUGE. I'm a pretty fit person but at the end of the day walking around everywhere my legs were feeling it. As for the hotel itself it's pretty much what I expected from photos - no surprises anywhere. The rooms are good enough - big but clean and bed comfy enough. Really nothing special. There are many restaurants in the hotel so you never even have to leave. I was too busy to visit the pool or spa areas and heard that there's even a bowling alley somewhere... so if your in town for business and need a moderately priced hotel just to rest your head it's not a bad place. If your looking for a more "las vegas" feel and have a bigger budget I'd recommend you look elsewhere on the strip.

reviews.title: Off the Strip but has it All
reviews.text: Stayed at this property for a recent business event.  First timer.  Staff was excellent from start to finish.  There is a lot to do at South Point and everything was clean and well organized. There are 11 restaurants and everyone we went to was very good.  I highly recommend the Steak House. Rooms were nice, clean and spacious.  If you decide to stay here you should not be dissapointed!

reviews.title: Recently refurbished rooms
reviews.text: This is my fourth stay at South pointe,  I stay here for several reasons mainly due to bingo and being out of the craziness of the strip.   Rooms have been recently refurbished and well appointed.   Love the non smoking floors.  Casino area is spacious and feels less smoky than many others that we have visited, which we really appreciate.   Also Uber drivers are able to pick up and drop off under the canary at the main door instead of in parking garages like the strip hotels.

reviews.title: overnight stay
reviews.text: we enjoyed our 1 night stay. the room is huge,  very beautiful , very clean and everything is perfect.we hoped we could have stayed  a little longer.  we will recommend   our friends and other family if they will be here in LAS VEGAS. thank you so much for the wonderful  opportunity.

reviews.title: Family fun with a twist
reviews.text: A great getaway for all ages! What a wonderful hotel with something for everyone! There is plenty to do for all ages from movies in the theaters to bowling! The kids loved that! The arcade kept them entertained for hours. The 11 different restaurants were delicious and each offered us something different! There was a spa which offered us much needed treatments and the workout room was always accessible! The staff catered to our needs and made our trip one we will be continuing annually!

reviews.title: Great Experience
reviews.text: We had a great time at South Point!  There for a bowling tournament and had a great time.  Excellent room, good food at the Coranado cafe and great food at the Silverado Steah house!  Can’t wait to go back in June!

reviews.title: Clean and comfortable Hotel with all the amenities
reviews.text: Never have to go too far to find a good restaurant, entertainment or casino play. Very courteous and helpful staff. Sports book is large and has plenty of variety, horses to soccer. Clean and comfortable rooms at a reasonable price.

reviews.title: Stopped in for a night
reviews.text: Nice place w/ excellent service.Check in was quick and courteous , very professional.Nice clean room, quiet all night.Casino floor was busy which usually means it’s a popular spot to go.Plenty of parking and a variety of food venues.They always have some kind of show going on .

reviews.title: One night stay
reviews.text: Rooms are big, clean and comfortable. Casino is huge but filled with all old machines, Disappointed they didn't have all the new VP games like the other casinos. Prices a little high. Overall we liked the Bingo and the food selections.

reviews.title: Pleasantly surprised!
reviews.text: Our family of four, along with two other couples stayed at South Point for four nights this past weekend and really enjoyed it! The newly renovated rooms are nice and clean. I would suggest better bedding as I found it to be rough and scratchy, but otherwise the room was great! All staff were very nice and helpful. We only dined at a few of the restaurants on-site and they were okay. We didn’t love the restaurant options, although the kids loved the ice cream shop! I’d love a restaurant with some healthy meal options. We also enjoyed the bowling lanes, although had to wait 2 hours on Sat night to get a lane, which was frustrating. Kids enjoyed the pool even though it was freezing! Would possibly stay here again for a family friendly hotel off the strip.

reviews.title: Security was great and appreciated!  Front Desk was friendly and helpful!  Bed extremely comfortable.
reviews.text: Security was great and appreciated!  Front Desk was friendly and helpful!  Bed extremely comfortable.

reviews.title: Dirty comforter
reviews.text: We were Getting ready to go to bed and discover dry blood on our blanket. Then it takes them 25 minutes to bring clean one. I was never contacted by management  For an apology or to follow up. So gross

reviews.title: Hotel
reviews.text: Really Like this Place. Rooms are simple but Great . They have plenty of Black Tables. Decent poker room with tournaments Daily . Free Parking and Free Valet . Real Friendly Staff.. Movie Theater and Bowling Alley On Premises and Plenty Of Places to Eat . They have a Steak and Shake on Premises . Highly Recommend

reviews.title: Great Stay!
reviews.text: Enjoyed my stay here. Everything is close together making it easy to walk around. Many restaurants to choose from to eat dinner. The salon did a great job doing my hair and makeup. Parking was free! Rare find in Vegas now.

reviews.title: A great place to stop for the night if you want to avoid the STRIP
reviews.text: I've stayed here twice for a Convention and it has a lot of the appointments of hotels further up the STRIP. A spa, pool, internet, restaurants and a Casino. Take note though, if you like LIVE KENO games, they don't have it.

reviews.title: Very nice property
reviews.text: Rooms are spacious and clean with comfy beds. Several restaurants serving different cuisine. Johnny Rockets is really good along with a buffet offering different foods. Spacious clean gaming area. I really like the open room feel. It has free parking and the resort fee is reasonable. Show room offers pretty good entertainment too! My husband and I enjoy our stays here.

reviews.title: Too many kids running around, but if you like that.......
reviews.text: Too many kids running around, mediocre food, overpriced mediocre buffet. The rooms were adequate, the place was clean, I think my favorite thing was the hot dogs for $1.25 right outside the sports book. I won't return.

reviews.title: WHY I WOULD NEVER RETURN TO SOUTH POINT - AND WHY YOU MIGHT CONSIDER ALTERNATIVES AS WELL
reviews.text: This review is the subjective opinion of an individual traveller and not of Tripadvisor LLC nor of its partners. Tripadvisor performs checks on reviews as part of our industry-leading trust & safety standards. Read our transparency report to learn more.

reviews.title: My one night stay
reviews.text: Stayed at this hotel for one night on Jan-01 after our flight was delayed for 24 hours for technical issues. The cost was 320 $ per night !!!! despite the fact we checked at 03:00am in the morning of Jan-01. The receptionist did not want to reduce the price and was not very polite. There was no internet connection at the reception, and this was shocking for such high rated hotel. I was disappointed. I would not recommend this hotel.

reviews.title: new year bash
reviews.text: Flew in on eve to be with friends for new year. They had ushered in 2018 and recommended highly, excuse enough to join them for this year's party. Had a package deal for dinner and party with the Spazmatics. Good time had by all, good band and open bar. Stayed two nights, rooms updated from our last stay. Comfortable stay, quiet room and clean. Enjoyed casino and movie theater, Sunday buffet was very good.

reviews.title: Great  place with more ammenities than the big guys!
reviews.text: We stayed at Southpoint because it was one of the only places we could find that had vacancies for 10 days at Christmas through January 4th. But boy were we pleasantly surprised! The room was very spacious and clean, and the rest was also excellent!With at least 12 eating establishments (that we counted), the movie theater ( we saw 5 movies during our stay), the spa and the casino we were very happy.  We weren’t sure about it because of the distance to the strip, but it proved not to be a problem. We ate at the Café (HUGE Cobb salad), Seattle’s best (great croissants) , Oyster bar , Mexican, Primarily prime rib, and all were great!  Primarily prime rib even served us when they were only 10 minutes from closing and we were the last two people there.  They never rushed us and were very gracious along with having fantastic food!We are not spa people but decided to do the couple’s spa day. We were there for 4 hours!  Going from Jacuzzi to steam and relaxing in the quiet environment.We enjoy playing the bar-top slots while we watch a game at the bar.  All of the bartenders were so friendly and nice and even remembered our names and drinks! And by the way…you can still get a free drink at their bar even if you don’t bet the maximum on each roll.

reviews.title: Great Vale and It’s Got It All
reviews.text: South Pointe Hotel Casino is located on the south end of the Strip - way south.  If you want a place to stay that has everything in one place, South Pointe is the place. Gambling, restaurants, Shops, Movie Theatre and Bowling Alley - they are all here.  Never have to leave the complex.Parking is free, rooms are big and reasonably priced, and they are clean.South Pointe is a great value!

reviews.title: Came on Business and had such a nice stay came again on Personal Trip.
reviews.text: This was the first time I stayed at the South Point.   I came on Business to see how it was.   They are very friendly and it has many dinning options.   The rooms are very roomy and views are good if on upper floors.   I had such a nice experience that I came back again on a personal trip.

reviews.title: Very nice
reviews.text: We are locals and this place has everything you could want from bowling to theatres and about 8 different restaurants.. even when we gamble here we are somewhat lucky. What ever kind of restaurant you want they have here.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: We booked a 5 day get-a-way and I’d read a few positive reviews about updates etc- well we sure didn’t experience  updates. We’ve been to Vegas many times and I thought SP looked good. We stayed on the 12th floor of tower 2 in a King suite which was tidy but very dated. The king bed was like sleeping on plywood and the sheets were rough. The resort fee is high 21 per day and not worth any of the things it is supposed to cover- coffee isn’t even available in real cups. The buffet is always good and we did enjoy the hotel coupons for a New Year’s Day brunch. Staff was friendly but the ventilation system in the casino must really need an upgrade as it was SO SMOKEY that it was impossible to escape- not just over New Years but the whole time we were here. Bowling alley is good and would be a hit with teens I think. A big DISAPPOINTMENT was the one not cold day we had,  we wanted to sit outside in the pool courtyard to enjoy some smoke-free air and  that was closed 😡 when I booked nothing was said about that or pool maintenance and my rate was certainly not lowered. Rooms are a good size but I would not choose to stay here again. Stay elsewhere.

reviews.title: Review was approved and removed after 5 min by Expedia upon 3/5 rating (was that upon the hotel's request?)
reviews.text: Review was approved and removed after 5 min by Expedia upon 3/5 rating (was that upon the hotel's request?)

reviews.title: Disappointing Experience
reviews.text: We were sent over to the South Point after our flight was delayed. The hotel and rooms are dated looking but the beds were comfy and we just wanted the sleep. The next morning when we were trying to ask for information and assistance about the airport shuttle the staff were not only not helpful but the “supervisor” Desiree was extremely rude and told me they don’t help airport stranded passengers as a general rule. I was so upset by her comments and the experience I felt the need to leave this review. If you are looking for a cheap place to stay this hotel is not bad. If you are looking for any sort of customer service look elsewhere.

reviews.title: Outstanding !
reviews.text: Extensive travel.  Hotel Rooms gigantic, remodeled, very clean.  Great slot play!  Lots of winning!  Outstanding spa!   All day spa complimentary with massage.  Food fair price and good.  Quality restaurants with great specials for holidays!  Totally happy!   Negative:  Uber or bus to strip.  Good news Catch bus 5 minute walk on Las Vegas blvd at Del Taco.  ( not south point bus stop because that is long way around to bus station first.). Best to take Uber to hotel at night.

reviews.title: Very busy
reviews.text: It's been awhile since I've visited Southpointe. After almost being run over by a non observant driver whilst I crossed we within a crosswalk,  I entered a very busy casino. Dozens mulling around the entrance and I would guess sports teams. Casino is fairly large but smokey.

reviews.title: Er, no free WiFi?
reviews.text: I feel like any respectable hotel in Vegas should have free wifi available to everyone. I'm a local with family in town, and it's quite surprising to realize this. WiFi generally keeps people around longer, especially those who aren't as inclined to gamble as much or at all, and is almost an expectation of anyone visiting a major casino in Vegas.

reviews.title: WHAT a PLACE!
reviews.text: AMAZING property.  There are so many restaurants to choose from.  The casino is big and pretty clean.  We went out there to watch World Series Team Roping during NFR. There was also a nice "Cowboy Christmas".  If you don't want to stay on the strip I am sure this property would be a good OUT OF THE WAY place to stay.  We were very impressed.  Spoke to people who were staying there and they said they loved it.

reviews.title: The Place to Be During Pro Rodeo Finals
reviews.text: This Hotel has it all! The Women's Pro Rodeo Luncheon is an absolute must.  Then they have an onsite rodeo bazaar and live team roping.  Off the main strip but the hotel provides a free shuttle nightly to the rodeo and a couple big screen rooms to watch the finals live if you can't afford to go to the actual event every night..  One is for family viewing and the other for adults only since liquor is served

reviews.title: Great for a fun trip OR the family (weird, huh?)
reviews.text: When I think of Vegas, I don't normally think "HEY! I'll bring my children" However, this truly is a great place to bring the kids if you are just wanting to get away with the fam for a while. The pool is great! They have bowling upstairs and a movie theater, as well as a great arcade for all ages. The restaurants are also great (we are partial to Steak N Shake)Adult side: Awesome sports book! and the casino feels a lot cleaner than most.

reviews.title: I loved it. The place has everything and prices are great.
reviews.text: This place was amazing. Poker room was awesome with great promos and fun staff. Tons of $5 blackjack and $5 craps, 100 play video poker, cheap roulette too and fun slots. Drink prices are low, even mixed drinks. There's a Steak and Shake, a bowling alley and a movie theater. There's even a hot dog stand with $1.25 hot dogs. I stayed there a week for a convention on the strip and the drive was simple, 7 minutes door to door. Covered parking is free and plentiful.

reviews.title: Always a pleasure to stay at!
reviews.text: Everything from the room to dining was very good.  The room was clean and comfortable, especially glad for the recent upgrades.  The buffet is always a excellent choice for dining along with the coffee shop. And playing video poker is the best in Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Clean large rooms
reviews.text: We recently stayed 3 nights at the hotel. Room was roomy and beds comfortable. Have stayed many times before.  Thought rooms were a bit pricey and 20 extra per person per night a little much. Prices used to be better and don't remember having that extra charge for an additional person. Most likely would stay again of just the 2 of us but not if 3rd person was going.

reviews.title: First 2 Day Stay to Try the Hotel
reviews.text: Given a special rate room at the long end of a deserted hall on the 3rd floor. Never heard or saw another person. We thought we were in the movie "The Shining". Very poor room service, we did receive a new towel. Never saw security on that floor. Someone tried to open the door late at night when we were asleep. .Very scary. Door locked from inside and the door was ajar about an inch in the morning. Never heard a knock.The room was old and not remodeled but clean. . Very disappointed. We did not feel welcome here. They reply I received when I completed their survey was cool and calculating and not personal at all. Told what they are told to say in rote form. I guess the resort fee is for no service.

reviews.title: Always Excellent Service
reviews.text: We have been using South Point as our destination of choice for many years. Got tired of the crowds and mess of the strip and do not even go down there anymore.The services provided by the hotel are exemplary and the food is varied and great at all of the many restaurants.We look foreword to many more trips to South Point.

reviews.title: My first choice.
reviews.text: It is always a pleasure to stay ion the South Point.  The rooms have been upgraded, the restaurants are plenty with good food, free entertainment, movies, slots, and a quick easy access off from the freeway after a long drive from Los Angeles.  They have some of the prettiest cocktail waitresses around. In all of my dozens, and dozens, of trips to Vegas I have never used the bell staff  with me preferring to carry my bags myself.  Not any more!  Bell staff is a real pleasure and convenience.

reviews.title: Excellent Hotel
reviews.text: This was the second year I’ve stayed at the hotel for the NFR.  The check in line seemed long when I arrived, however, they are so efficient when checking in that I didn’t wait more than 5 minutes.  Very quick and easy check in.  Each visit I’ve been on the 22nd floor, this is a great view of the city and the strip at night.  The room is so spacious, the bathroom is updated and is nice.  The main room is updated, has a desk and updated fixtures.  The buffet is very affordable, the value for the price you pay.  They give coupon books for each guest and it has a 50% off coupon, so when applied the weekday buffet was only 4 bucks. Very good food and an excellent selection of food.The staff is so very kind, I had one unpleasant encounter which was the gal in the buffet who seats everyone, however, I never said anything as it wasn’t ruining my vacation or fun so it didn’t matter to me.  If you want a hotel that’s off the strip, this is the hotel for you.  It’s just a short Uber ride to the strip if you want to go.  My Uber trip from south point to the Linq was only 15 dollars including a tip.

reviews.title: Excellent off strip property
reviews.text: Been to Vegas quite a few times and the thrill of the strip is long gone. I'm more interested in getting value for the dollar. That is exactly what you will find at South Point. Inexpensive rooms that are sometimes comped, along with inexpensive food and better gambling odds will keep me coming back. And just because it doesn't cost as much doesn't mean it's not as nice as some of the strip properties.

reviews.title: Stephen &  Alma Gray
reviews.text: Excellent stay!  Great customer service!  Our first choice for stays in Las Vegas.  I play Poker, Alma plays Bingo.  She is very pleased with the courtesy and friendly staff in the Bingo room.  I am very satisfied with the same from the staff and dealers in the Poker room.

reviews.title: TI'MS BIRTHDAY
reviews.text: Casino is well lite. Yo can park right outside the front door and walk in or you can park in the covered parking lot and it's all free.  The restaurants are all excellent. The rooms are spacious and clean.

reviews.title: Meeting Family and Friends
reviews.text: The South Point Hotel and Casino is an excellent place to meet family and friends.  There are lots of restaurants.  There is ample shopping and quite places to visit.  The motel rates are great.  The facility is clean and has fairly loose slots.  The parking is free!

reviews.title: Quick Weekender
reviews.text: Took a quick weekend trip and enjoyed the hotel. It was clean and comfortable. The cafe was good with good service and food. The casino was pretty tight and seemed to suck the money right out of our  pockets. That’s Vegas.

reviews.title: NFR 2018
reviews.text: Had a great stay this year.  Made a buck. Saw drunken cowboys. Hoards of people. Redecorated rooms were good. Food at Oyster Bar my favorite  but Steak and Shake a close 2nd. Will return for Nascar race in March and NFR 2019.

reviews.title: GARY PUCKET AND THE UNION GAP IN THE SHOW ROOM
reviews.text: The venue has seating for several hundred people at tables, booths or small tables. If you have trouble with mobility just ask for a table of booth set aside for you. The stage has great visibility from all vantage points in the show room. Drinks and popcorn can be purchased before and during the show. Your ticket allows you a complimentary drink at one of the bars after the show. There are two monitors for additional video feeds but you can see the entertainers easily from all over the room. Acoustics were great and not so loud that you ear drums feel like they'll break. I've been to many shows in this casino and have never had a bad time. Entertainers always meet and greet after the show.

reviews.title: It's got everything the strip offers and free parking to boot
reviews.text: I agree that the hotel casino and rooms are showing their age but it's still a heck of a place for both families and singles. You don't need to leave the grounds for anything if you don't want to. The freebies and discounts are great and if you are a veteran or active service person, you've got to go there on Veteran's Day. The buffet is free and has just about anything you would want to eat. If you are football fan and like your beer, go there on a Sunday and cozy up to any bar for your $1 beers from 10 AM to 4 PM. Fortunately for me, I was both a veteran and a beer lover and stayed at South Point on Veteran's Day. Needless to say, I was quite happy with my choice of a place to stay in Vegas.

reviews.title: Spa Day
reviews.text: I had the pleasure of spending several hours at the spa. It was a great experience. Once you pay for a service you have the use of the facilities for the entire day. They have a stream room, sauna, cool pool, hot tub and a room you can relax in. I recommend this to anyone. The staff was very pleasant and the prices were very fair.

reviews.title: Buffet Under Renovation
reviews.text: One of our favorites for convenience and reasonable pricing.  Recently the buffet area has been under renovation, but despite it the food selections have been adequate.  Service is always been consistent with quick and efficient attention.  Salad bar is usually stocked with many choices, but this visit it was limited.  When the area is fully finished with the renovation, it no doubt will be back to par.  Because of the renovation, 'renovation' prices were available.

reviews.title: Rooms still nice, but starting to show some age.
reviews.text: We spent 4 nights at South Point as we favor local properties and like the mix of gaming and non-gaming amenities.  It has been about 5 years since our last stay, and while the rooms are still large and in relatively good shape the bathroom and furnishings were starting to show a little age.  Just feels like they could use a little paint and some new linens.Our room on the 4th floor overlooked the pool and was very quiet.  Very rarely heard any noise out in the hallway, and the weekend we were there the hotel was nearly full for the rodeo.  Beds were comfortable and it was nice to have pillows with some loft.  Plenty of closet and drawer storage for clothes and incidentals.  Good shower pressure, liked that the shower warmed up quickly.  We did miss having a refrigerator in the room, and will get an upgraded room with one when we return in the spring.  Hubby does not gamble all that much, so it is nice to have the big pool area and fitness center and movie theater to keep him amused.  We also like the choice of restaurants, a lot of variety depending on what you are in the mood for.  Just wish service was a little quicker at the Del Mar deli.Overall a good stay, still our favorite locals property.  Will be back in early May for a quick stay after visiting some family on the mainland.

reviews.title: Glad we discovered South Point
reviews.text: We have not stayed at this hotel (yet) so this is just a review of the casino. For years we have been loyal to Boyd properties during our Vegas trips 2-3 times a year. But Boyd has made drastic changes to their players club. We are looking for a place that welcomes all customers not just the high rollers. The first thing we noticed was how spic and span clean the property was. The second thing was how friendly the dealers were (Sunny and Mary) and the bar staff, especially Jessie. We were trying to sneak a peek at the Equestrian Center which was closed. The security guard was kind enough to give us a guided tour! The buffet was reasonable and delicious.The resort fee is steep but I guess that is everywhere now in Vegas. We hope to return soon!

reviews.title: Our Destination-Go to Hotel in Vegas
reviews.text: When in Vegas we always look forward to our stay at Southpoint.  This time visited the Oyster Bar for perhaps the 7th time, had to order Oysters Rockefeller again,  and had Jambalaya for first time (as good as New Orleans), loaded with various large chucks of fish, shrimp, healthy amount of well-spiced tomato base sauce.  Sue had lobster roll. Large, a good portion of lobster and tasty. Went to see Chubby Checker perform all of his hits from 60’s. Sue got to do “The Twist” with the master.  Did a “meet & greet” with the star and purchased one of his CD’s.  Saw “The Green Book” at the Century theater complex within the hotel (highly recommended)Experienced Another meal at the Italian Restaurant.  Best veal Scallopini I’ve had in years.  Same comment for the gnocchi (shared as an appetizer)and eggplant parm (Sue’s main course).A short two day fun packed get away.  Will return soon.

reviews.title: Unexpected stay
reviews.text: We got put up in this hotel by the airline because our flight waa delayed until the next day. This hotel was very nice. The room was very clean and roomy. The staff was very welcoming and friendly. There is lots of activities to do besides gambling. They hve a movie theater and bowling alley right on site which is wonderful.

reviews.title: Just Average
reviews.text: This hotel is just before you get to the strip. Easy to get to, right off the freeway. Kid friendly. The rooms were nice, clean and spacious. The Casino wasn't much of anything. Needs a bit of updating, and a more powerful ventilation system. I know they can't do anything about smoking customers, but if the ventilation system was strong enough, it would remove much of the smell. The restaurants were pretty average as well. Since the hotel was so far from the strip, we didn't have much of a choice for dining, but they weren't horrible.

reviews.title: Nice casino with friendly staff and not too smoky
reviews.text: We hadn't been to South Point in years, but a friend convinced us to return.  We're glad we did.  It has improved greatly.  There were more tables, and the staff was great.  We had fun playing there for a couple of hours. We would have stayed longer if we hadn't needed to return our rental car.  They need to have have shuttles running to the strip since we only keep our car for 1 day.  I didn't check the bus routes. We would like to return.

reviews.title: Perfect place to be
reviews.text: We stayed here because it is the best hotel with the most restaurants. We enjoy the size of the room, plus all the extras to be used. We love the poker room and bingo hall. Its all to be available and enjoyed.

reviews.title: Lovely hotel and grounds
reviews.text: The hotel is huge has a lot to offer.  I was there with my daughter and granddaughters.  The facility has a movie theater, bowling alley and lots of restaurants to satisfy everyone.  The rooms and hallways are well lit and maintained.  It is far from the strip and shopping, so be prepared to rent a car or uber it.

reviews.title: Real people at South Point.
reviews.text: Spent half a day st SP. Sports book for NFL Sunday was very prepared and did not disappoint. Go to the Mexican restaurant for lunch. $9.95 including a drink. Server was outstanding during our lunch.would I recommend and return? Heck ya

reviews.title: Huge rooms
reviews.text: Great huge rooms although no view.2 queen size beds.2 tables.long full length mirror.huge bathroom with double doors.iron & board provided.no fridge.good size closet.Good food in the Garden Buffet.Quite a smoky hotel though.Shuttle provided to airport.

reviews.title: Nice Casino Hotel if you don't need to be in the action on the Strip
reviews.text: I stayed in this hotel for 4 nights for a conference.  It's fairly far south on Las Vegas Blvd so you need to drive or take a taxi/Lyft if you want to go to the Strip.  But the rooms are big and clean, wifi was fast, and parking is free.  I didn't eat that many meals at the hotel, but I will say the banquet lunches I had there may have been the best banquet lunches that I've ever had.  I also had a sandwich at the NY-style deli in the casino which was very good. The fitness center was large and well equipped.   I would stay here again.

reviews.title: improving
reviews.text: we own next door at the Grandview Resort where we go twice a year, we have gone to South Point many times this year was the best yet, the food was very good, there are renovating the buffet but the food was the best ever, they always put on the Canucks games for us, just really like the place, look forward to going back in the spring.

reviews.title: If you like the smell of cigarettes and horses...
reviews.text: Had to stay here for a convention.  Can't stress enough how important it is to avoid this place unless you're into rodeos.  Place smelled like smoke, thin towels, and way off the strip.  Rooms desperately need updating.

reviews.title: Great hotel
