reviews.text: South Point  is a great location away from the crowds on the strip.  There is plenty to do there with arena, movie theaters, bowling alley and excellent variety of restaurants.  The casino has many different slots and gaming tables.

reviews.title: So much to do
reviews.text: This 25 floor hotel is  off the strip. It is clean and the staff is so friendly. The slots are below average but the spa, bingo, bowling, movie theatre, is superior. This week they have  world class Horse jumping championship . There are many places to eat. I do t really care for the quality of food but I am a hard critic. The rooms on the upper floors are all redone and are clean. The bed is too hard, I mean way too hard for me and because of that I will never stay here again . I had a wonderful facial this morning and had access to a beautiful spa and showers. There is a shuttle to and from the airport. If you take a taxi it will cost about $40.

reviews.title: Love this hotel/casino
reviews.text: South Point is an excellent choice if you are OK with being off the strip. They do have a shuttle that willTake you to the strip- so that works out fine!  They have great choices for restaurants and offer some great entertainment options. They have many equestrian and rodeo events which I love. Try it- you’ll like it!! Another positive- NO CHARGE for parking!!

reviews.title: Beautiful hotel/casino and movie theatre too
reviews.text: We visited here for dinner, hang in the casino and took in a movie. Really nice place away from the main strip area. We highly recommend the area for easy access to the northern amenities. Makes for cheap Uber from here to all the exhibits and events.

reviews.title: Wonderful Resort
reviews.text: This resort is amazing. It has everything you can possibly think of. It has a very nice movie theater, bingo hall, bowling alley, fitness center, hair salon, barber shop, pool, ice cream shop, gift shop, and of course GAMBLING. You can self park or valet park for FREE. The staff is quick when bringing your car, just don’t forget to tip. We stayed in regular room which was cool. It was clean and the bed slept good. Downside is we did not have a refrigerator but you can upgrade to the newer rooms that have a refrigerator in it.This resort also is big for it’s Equestrian stable which draws a lot of older people but overall it’s a great place to be.It has several restaurants from a burger joint to finer dining. It is approx. 10 minutes from the strip and a popular strip mall.The casino fee is most like the cheapest you will find at just $21/night.Overall we had a great time, just wish I could have explored more of the resort. We were so busy with pre planned things we only got a chance to go to the movie theater but hopefully when we go back we can check out the other things this resort has to offer. If you book here you will not regret it....Trust Me!!!!!

reviews.title: Wonderful experience -- I am a pool person - and their pool was delightful - outdoors - in perfect condition .
reviews.text: Wonderful experience -- I am a pool person - and their pool was delightful - outdoors - in perfect condition .

reviews.title: I wont stay any other place in Vegas from now on!
reviews.text: This Hotel Casino Arena is South of the strip taxis & shuttles available if you want to go to the strip or old town.Staff is awesome, rooms a cut above, small enough to have the old Vegas feel!Attended ABBI event (American Bucking Bull Inc)Bulls were housed on the property nice arena...I just can't say enough about this location....it is Fantastic!!!

reviews.title: Not expensive good time, but smoking everywhere
reviews.text: Room is nice, big clean.Slat machines let you enjoy playing. The new plasma-tv let people enjoy even other people’s winnings.The all-eat buffet is cheap and extremely good. You feel like on some all-inclusive resort.The down-site is smoking in the casino is more than you can see in the other places. Casino should improve the fan system – in the morning it is OK, but in the evening this secondary smock is way too much.

reviews.title: Great place: have excellent restaurants; large bowling alley; theaters.
reviews.text: A family friendly place.  Great food at the restaurants and great service.  A lot of activities for families.  The parking is easy; can park outside or on a ramp.  We go here anytime we have visitors at our house.

reviews.title: Sema 2018
reviews.text: Another SEMA Show week in Las Vegas and South Point shined as usual! I recommend SP to all my friends heading to Vegas! Now newly remodeled rooms with refrigerator included was very clean. My only negative was The Garden Buffet food could be much better as could Wait staff. I recommend any other restaurant in SP.

reviews.title: Reasonable Getaway
reviews.text: Provides good quality entrainment and food at very reasonable prices.  Good gambling facilities.  Varied show programs, ample free parking and good customer relation.  Rodeo and bull riding in arena provided good entertainment value.  You are off the Strip but have reasonable access to it by public transportation, taxis and Uber.

reviews.title: It was OK
reviews.text: We did not get one of the newly renovated rooms during our stay. The room was decent enough, clean and the beds were semi comfy. The bathroom was a bit rough with peeling wallpaper, a hole in the wall from where the door handle went through and the shower drain needed some serious shaking (you would in ankle deep water by the end of your shower). The price was right and wasn't too far from the strip which is where I spend most of my time. I would probably stay again but this time get an renovated room.

reviews.title: Great Place but has some security issues
reviews.text: Twice in 5 days someone entered my room with a key. 6 am one morning and 2 days later at 3 pm when 2 men took out my Do Not Disturb key and opened my door. I was in my room to keep them out. All front desk staff said was sorry. This is a big issue; something seriously could have happened; theft or worse.

reviews.title: Clean rooms!
reviews.text: We opted for the non-renovated rooms as they were a little cheaper and our room was completely clean and looked new to us!  This is a massive hotel with 11 restaurants and a huge, smoky casino. It is on the edge of downtown which makes it nice too to stay a little out of the craziness.

reviews.title: Great spot
reviews.text: We stayed here a week , it’s a very nice hotel . We stayed on the newely remodeled side they called it an out room is very large, clean . The staff with the exception of the deli was very good. The movie theatre was nice and I use the gym daily - it’s small but newer equipment and clean . Our room had sink issues they said they fixed it but it clogged again the next day and the water pressure in the shower isn’t great . For make up wearers the lighting in the bathroom is aweful for true look at your make up . The biggest down side is the buffet , we aren’t buffet people but my husband does them for breakfast at the hotels we stay at , the day made no difference nor did the time - he always waited in very long lines with very long wait times in the food area and he was disappointed with that . The deli is horrible, the Asian place was awesome. The steak house is very good as well . The valet is efficient and friendly.  We prefer to stay off the strip a bit as it seems less crowded . Last time we were ln the thick of it an there were upsides to that but over all the crowds get to me to fast in that situation.

reviews.title: Honeymoon
reviews.text: Thank.you for making our honeymoon so nice here. It was quiet and plenty to offer with games movies and bowling. The food was great as well and we loved the buffet.  The room was cleaned everyday.My only suggestion would be more plugs for cell phones and ipads in. Also more areas of non smoking for people who.want to play.  It made it hard to play at times with everyone smoking around me and i have asthma.  Even one section would be nice. Other than that thank you again

reviews.title: Can Handle a Trailer
reviews.text: I usually visit Las Vegas on a camping excursion to the Southwest.  Almost no Hotel on the strip can handle a trailer if you want to stay in the hotel. South Point was recommended to us.  South Point is technically  on the strip but is located a few miles south of the airport.It is a typical casino hotel.  A large casino with a few dining options scattered around. It does have a livestock arena which is one reason it has a separate parking area for trailers.The rooms are nice, spacious, working desk, comfortable bed, quiet, pricey for the location.A few caveats - The web site mentions shuttle service to the strip.  It is NOT offered. when we inquired were given a well rehearsed summary of the city bus an Uber.  The free shuttle service to the airport is nice, but does NOT run early enough for the early flights.

reviews.title: Bowling trip
reviews.text: Stayed at South Point for just over 2 weeks. Nice and quiet hotel, away from the strip, with friendly staff and spacious rooms.If staying during Thanksgiving, make sure you book a table in advance.Will be back.

reviews.title: One night stop
reviews.text: We stay only one night passing through Will try to book again tomorrow if I can . We like it nice and clean good and easy to park your truck and trailer great breakfast restaurant and had good supper too !!

reviews.title: Golf trip and more.
reviews.text: We, (sixteen) guys stayed here for a golf outing to Las Vegas. The National Indian Rodeo competition was also happening and the facility was very busy. All of the staff seemed very accommodating. The bellstaff handled our golf bags each of the four days, the casino crew was quite friendly, restaurants were all good and we all had a great visit to Vegas and South Point. Only gripe was the large hot tub was over-chlorinated....

reviews.title: Very Good Casino Hotel with Amenities
reviews.text: First time staying at South Point (Weekday), even though I’ve been going to Las Vegas since the late 80’s, it was an enjoyable stay. Upon arrival, we drove from California, the Resort signage is clearly marked and the Valet is very expansive. Registration was very quick and the clerk gave us room location choice.  There was a Rodeo Event going on, but there was still plenty of options.  A quick stroll through the casino on the way to the elevators, the layout is pretty well thought out. Stores, Eateries and entertainment are on the outer perimeter while the tables and slots makeup the interior.Our double-queen room was spacious and clean. The Wi-Fi was good and the in-room Coffee machine worked well.  We didn’t need to use the safe even though one was provided.Back down in the Casino, there are plenty of Slots and Table Games, but since we didn’t win, I’ll say they were “tight”, lol.We ate at the Garden Buffet for Dinner and for the price, it was a good deal with above average food items and choices. The best deal is in the coupon book you receive at Check-In. There’s a 50% discount on the Buffet for Breakfast, Brunch, or Lunch. Since we were leaving before Noon, we had breakfast, which cost less than $4 per person with Coffee, Tea, juice and a wide variety of food items. They do have an on-site Bowling Alley and Movie Theater, so the Resort is pretty self-contained.  If your looking for that “Strip” experience then stay elsewhere,  it if your looking for a good deal and be close to The Strip then South Point is a good value.

reviews.title: Refreshing change from The Strip
reviews.text: We've been visiting this hotel/casino since it was the South Coast way back in 2005 and it has kept well. Our recent stay was in a newly refurbished room: wood floors, new furnishings, little slippers, big screen TV, nicely appointed bathroom. Everything is nice and clean. The casino is spacious though I find it difficult to stay there very long due to the smoke (by Las Vegas standards, it is not oppressive but I am allergic). My husband is O.K. as long as someone doesn't light up beside him. The Garden Buffet was being worked on, so I'll be interested to see the result. The cafe, as always, was excellent. Parking is free and plentiful. The equestrian center is world class. There is also a movie theatre and bowling alley.

reviews.title: Very reasonable Las Vegas stay
reviews.text: We spent 3 nights at South Point and enjoyed every minute of it.  The room rate was very reasonable - $79 / night with a resort fee of $18.  There are promotions that reduce that rate even further.  Despite the rate, the room was large and very clean.  All the typical Las Vegas amenities are available including free wifi, a good gym (access to the lockers and spa is an additional fee - typical of most Vegas hotels).  It has a good sized pool with lots of seating.  Probably the nicest surprise was the quality of the food.  The Italian and seafood restaurants were  especially good and prices are, once again, reasonable.  The gaming is good; I love poker and their poker room was busy and well run, although there aren't many big money games (which is fine with me).  All in all, we had a very relaxing and pleasant time.  Will definitely go back.

reviews.title: VERY NICE CLEAN HOTEL
reviews.text: The hotel is quite large and has plenty of restaurants, a bowling alley, bingo hall, movie theaters and much more. The employees are nice and friendly.  It's clean and reasonably priced.  The rooms are large and comfortable including the beds and pillows. Housekeeping provided extra towels when needed. The casino is large and has plenty of everything to choose from when it comes to gambling. They do not charge for parking which is a big plus.

reviews.title: I hope to be back!
reviews.text: This is a reasonably priced hotel with spacious, clean and quiet room.Staff were friendly (at reception, restaurant, housekeeping) and when we informed Reception that the safe in our room was not working, someone arrived within ten minutes to fix it.Complimentary wifi with strong signals for unlimited number of devices.In addition to several restaurants, there was a bowling plaza, a large Bingo hall and a cinemaplex so you're almost certain to find something to do.

reviews.title: 2nd stay cant wait for 3rd
reviews.text: This was our 2nd stay and so glad we chose South Point again.  We split all our Uber costs with another couple which makes this a no-brainer place to stay for us.  When we want to strip or downtown we spend the money to Uber then come back to the quiet of our room.  There's plenty to do here too.  On Sunday the guys watched football while I took in a movie.  We were in an upgraded room..loved it.  Beds comfy with nice crisp sheets.

reviews.title: John Anthony Olszowy
reviews.text: I had my hair cut and a facial done on my birthday at the South Point Casino on October 8th 2018.The South Point Casino Barber Salon in the South Point Casino.Hair Stylist John Taddio did an outstanding job on my hair.Thanks for the Flat Top John.Love it, Love it, Love it.I give John Taddio Five Stars (*****).Thanks Again.Internationally Known Ombudsman (Ombudsmen) John Anthony Olszowy (Allsway).

reviews.title: “Never again, unqualified personnel, no accountability!”
reviews.text: Extra charges when checking out that are still not clear for me today. 1st night was under 100 USD, second night over 150 USD plus an extra charge of 78 USD, still unexplained at check out - Telephone had no ringtone when I tried to use it the next morning so I couldn't order breakfast and had to go down to tell the front desk. They called engineering who didn't show up for the next 3 hours that I was up in the room to watch the Ryder Cup. When I had to leave for the day, around midday, I went back down to the front desk to tell the problem is still not solved and they said that they contacted engeneering and will check again! When I came back in the evening the front desk said they had no message from engineering so it should be fixed. So I said this is not a good customer service because if it still doesn't work I would again have to come back down etc... Fortunately it worked when I was back in the room. It's sad that there was no communication and excuses!

reviews.title: South Point Hotel
reviews.text: Room was very inviting, very clean, very comfortable. Hotel dining choices were many. We did not use the pool while there but it looked nice. This hotel was right near a freeway entrance & exit which was extremely convenient. Our visit was short & spent with family away from the hotel. We would stay there again if needed.

reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel with great service
reviews.text: I stayed at this hotel only for one night but would consider that for my next trip to Nevada for sure. I'm not a gambler and that was not the purpose of my trip to that state but I enjoyed my stay. The only thing that I would consider for the next time (and you should too if it'd possible) is to get a room at the north side of the hotel and one of the last floors.

reviews.title: Concert visit
reviews.text: I haven't stayed here but myself and my husband were at a concert and my son visited the casino.  We had a lovely evening, even although the concert was very short but that is not down to the hotel, that was down to the star in concert.

reviews.title: The whole package
reviews.text: Moved here because we tried another hotel on the strip and wasn’t impressed with the quality of room and staff of the other place. Got a room no prob. Fast check in. Rooms are nice, I’ve stayed here during the rodeo several times. Pool is salt water pool and there’s a bar and deli right there with poolside service. Big sur oyster bar. Friendly, great portion of crab legs. Oysters were delicious. Goes good with oysters shot. ZenshinI cannot remember the names of the rolls we had but they were better than I thought they’d be. Pork belly was also very good. Try the mussels. You won’t be disappointed. Coronado cafeBig variety of foods. We ate here everyday and enjoyed each meal. Lots of home cooked meal classics. Bowling alley was also very fun.

reviews.title: Great slots
reviews.text: Stopped again this trip. We so enjoyed casino and buffet four years prior, so why not.On the boulevard but very removed southerly from center strip. Worth the drive if you have a car.Great slot selection and one of few casinos in town with penny Cashman, my wife's favorite. Many other good selections we enjoyed. They have a great buffet we very much enjoyed and happened to be there on a Saturday. The brunch featured bottomless mimosas, too. Great cocktail service which is very lax these days in many of the casinos in town. Their ladies were very attentive and were among the most attractive in town. Parking is ample, too.Highly recommend when in town and look forward to returning next trip to town. Also, many dining choices in addition to their great buffet.

reviews.title: It is not a Vegas Strip Hotel, But it was perfect for us.
reviews.text: Room was clean and very comfortable. Water was hot, bed was perfect for both of us, and the Keurig worked great. Nothing fancy. No comforter on the bed but we called and that was fixed in 5 minutes. All people from Valet to Hostess to checkout were kind and professional. The sports book was comfortable. The food was much better than expected. We loved the hot tub at the pool area as well as the theater and bowling alley. The airport had 18 dollar a day cars and was very close to South Point. We were 12 minutes from the Vegas Strip when we wanted to go. Really a best bang for the buck kind of place.

reviews.title: Allergy Friendly -- Awesome!
reviews.text: I was at South Point to cover the Andalusian World Cup 2018 for my podcast, Because of Horses. I figured the horse facilities would be great but, although I had seen nice photos online of the rooms and amenities, I didn't really expect much. I'm very happy to say the "human" facilities were really nice -- very clean, fresh, nicely decorated, and comfortable. I loved my room (a king with tons of space, a huge bathroom, and everything I could need for the week I was there). And I was right -- the horse facilities were top of the line and right there, all under one roof and easily accessible.But what made the trip great for me was how incredibly helpful the restaurants and room service were in working with me and my ridiculous food allergies. I travel a good deal and this is not at all my experience -- at the "good" end of the spectrum, the waitstaff makes a note (olive oil and salt only in preparing the food)... and at the other end, they'll be impatient, rude, and even challenging. But the South Point staff was phenomenal -- so friendly, helpful, understanding, patient, and meticulous in making sure that I could not only eat while I was there, but that I could relax and really enjoy my meal. I'm actually tearing up as I write this, because... you just have no idea how huge this is, if you don't have potentially life-threatening allergies. Usually, I just fill my hotel room fridge with food that I Uber to Whole Foods or Sprouts or Trader Joe's to buy, then eat cold throughout the stay.So -- to the staff at South Point and to your managers -- you have my very sincere appreciation! (Especially room service and Primarily Prime Restaurant) Thank you so much!

reviews.title: Cheap bets in a large casino
reviews.text: Have not stayed. Impressed with South Points Casino.  $5 minimum bets and lots of choice in tables and slots. Worth a trek out if your looking to learn how to gamble.  Also close to the airport we visited on the way home.

reviews.title: Conference
reviews.text: I went for a conference that was being held here. The hotel was really nice. I stayed there for easy access to the conference, and the discount we got for booking there. The restaurants were really good. My favorite was the Japanese restaurant, we went during happy hour, and they had good specials. I would recommend this property to anyone. It wasn't near the Strip, but the Lyft ride wasn't long to get to the strip.

reviews.title: Excellent!!!
reviews.text: I was pleasantly surprised 😮 Great value for your money!!! The spa is my go to every time I visit Las Vegas. The gambling is even reasonable Lololol. Good area for cheapy souvenirs. Staff was welcoming informative and friendly!!!

reviews.title: A True Vegas Gem
reviews.text: Went to the South Point for a meeting and the Frankie Avalon Show.  I have been to LAs Vegas over 25 times in the last 20 years and this is my first trip to the South Point and I wish I had discovered it earlier.  Hotel room had been refurbished and was excellent.  The staff were all very friendly and helpful.   Also, the prices for water, beer, etc in the gift shops are ridiculously low.  Bottles of wine / alcohol were cheaper than my last trip to a liquor store.  The price for a diet Pepsi was less than 1/2 of what I paid at any other hotel on the strip.Highly recommend.

reviews.title: Nice place. It has everything you want!
reviews.text: We stayed here on the final night of a Denver to Vegas (via the Grand Canyon) road trip. I wanted to be near the airport for the flight home and thought one night in a poker room in a casino would be fun. And they were running a special.Our room was great. (We use ADA rooms. This one was fit the bill nicely.)They have it all. Slots, table games. A nice and busy poker room.  A variety of places to eat.  Free and plentiful convenient parking. A huge pool.The poker room had a variety of tables and plenty of low stakes options. We were seated within a few minutes.  The players were friendly---lots of them seemed to be regulars but certainly willing to take my money :o)  Dealers were friendly. Servers made the rounds regularly.  It was a Thursday night and still plenty of action. I really wanted to stay an extra night.  They do allow smoking in certain areas (not the poker area) and I HATE SMOKING, but it really was well managed. Didn't bother me. I'd definitely recommend. I'll definitely go back.

reviews.title: Couple vacation
reviews.text: Had a great time staff was very nice helpful and friendly loved the total experience 😀food choices were great bingo loved it loved betting on sporting events horse racing. Will definitely come back again 😀😁😁

reviews.title: Incredible Place.
reviews.text: First, we must advise that we did not stay at the hotel: we were actually booked at the resort, next door, that highly promotes the facilities at South Point. Like many casino/hotels, there are several cuisine opportunities - too many for a week's stay. For the gamblers, there is a nice casino area, obviously, but for those, like me, who do not gamble, there are other activities: a bowling alley, cinemas and a humongous exhibition area that was large enough to house three hockey rinks complete with huge staging and common areas: these host several rodeo events and horse shows, The site is extremely easy to find and is located at an interchange on I15 South

reviews.title: Buffet at South Point
reviews.text: Went to the newly renowed South Point breakfast buffet.  The price is really reasonable and the food was good.  The service was good and so was the new buffet room.  I see why a lot of locals go there.  You won't be disappointed at this breakfast buffet.

reviews.title: More than just a Casino
reviews.text: This time we had one of the newly renovated rooms with laminate flooring and king bed, lots of space, the Margaritas at the Bar were Fantastic, been in the Arena and saw some nice Horses, we had a great Time!

reviews.title: Pleasantly supersized
reviews.text: Was put up here for 1 night after a cancelled flight and I was pleasantly surprised after my initial doubts.Gaming tables offer low to high limits and table supervisors look after you if you playing to a level.Big Sur Oyster Bar food was very good, had a crab lobster prawn combo thing with butter sauce which was very very nice. Highly recommend for dinner.Breakfast was i the Cafe, cant remember the proper name but food was ok.Pool area in very nice with a spa tub at the back & towels are plentfulMassive Bingo hall & Bowling place upstairs

reviews.title: Surprise off the Crowded Strip
reviews.text: This place is actually on the strip but at the very end out past the airport.  I was pleasantly surprised and didn't even leave for the 3 days I was there!  Plenty of gaming and food.  The bakery was excellent with huge desserts and breakfast sandwiches as well as lunch and dinner.  The room was large and newly renovated.  I stayed at the end of the hall so it was quiet.  They gave me 2 bottles of liquor when I signed up for their players card and didn't even play very much.  Only thing I did not like and this was WEIRD, was that some of the restaurants won't let you place a take out order.  I have no idea what that is about but I wanted Mexican food to take up to my room and they would not let me do it!  The buffet was good and only $7 for lunch with players card with bottomless Mimosas.  I might stay here again but really don't know because I don't like the restaurant policy of no takeout.

reviews.title: Vacation and Spa experience
reviews.text: The hotel room was very spacious and clean. The staff was so nice and helpful to my request for services. The price was very reasonable for the last minute booking on a holiday weekend.I wasn't really happy about the parking lot as someone keyed my vehicle one and someone else scratched the other side the next day. The parking lot are full with small parking spaces.

reviews.title: A wonderful, underrated resort
reviews.text: Recently stayed at the South Point for a 2nd time.  The atmosphere and customer service is top notch. We stayed in the new rooms with refrigerator, wood floor and updated furniture. The $10/night extra is worth it. Money stretches further gambling here: slot payout seems fair, blackjack pays 3:2, sportsbook has the best value in vegas (minimal vig and generous with drink tickets).The hotel room is spotless and deep cleaned, the resort fee is about 50% of other hotels, valet is free, checkout is at noon, Coronado cafe after midnight is the best deal in Vegas, steak/eggs for $6.  If you choose SP as your place to stay, it's best to have a rental car.  Even beter value is to take SP shuttle from airport to SP.   Rent a car from the  Enterprise mthat is a few miles away(they pick you up from SP to Enterprise for rental).  Then you avoid the extra $15/day fees from renting at the airport.

reviews.title: Loose penny slots
reviews.text: Had a great time playing the slots and the service while playing was great.  Can’t wait to come back.  Had the seafood buffet and was let down.  It was while they were remodeling so some food was cold and that may have been why.  The Tequila bar upstairs was awesome. Much to do like bowling and they have a movie theater as well!  Nice to be away from the congestion of the strip and felt safe walking around from the Grandview to South Point.  Had a blast!

reviews.title: 2 weeks in vegas
reviews.text: south point casino ,this place is great big rooms ,great pool ,bowling ,movie theater,bingo ,great food at coronado cafe ,buffet was great and cheap.sports book is very good can watch cleveland indians ,alabama football ,and bet the ponys all in same place ,a hidden gem is the hot dogs by sports book for $1.25 great ,,while we were there in the arena there was a horse show free ,and oh yea SOUTH POINT sponsered the NASCAR race and car hawler were in the parking lot in fact many teams stayed in hotel and had them next to us at breakfast ,wow this place is so somfortable didnt want to leave.

reviews.title: Clean but dated
reviews.text: Flight got cancelled so we were bussed to the South Point Hotel for an overnight stay. The hotel is massive and although it proclaims to be just off the strip it’s actually a good 9km+ from the main area. The room I was given was big and had a view of Vegas and surrounding hills. It was clean and bed comfortable. However the decor is incredibly dated. I can’t remember when I last stayed in a room that was so deep magnolia. It’s a step right out of the 80’s. Maybe that’s this hotels theme-nostalgia - I’m not entirely but it does need an upgrade in the colour scheme. The bathroom, big as it is also needs a rocket into the new century. It’s all totally functional but just needs upgrading. The staff were extremely professional, courteous and friendly. The hotel has masses going for it - just needs a decor upgrade - and fast.

reviews.title: Horrible experience
reviews.text: This place is not worth the money, they’re obviously on a huge budget because the customer is definitely not taken care of. A party of eight people were dining at their steakhouse where the waiter forgot to give us our salads prior to our meal which we paid for. Although the waiter was very nice and apologized it just ruined the overall experience.  When we first checked in we ordered two  wine glasses they informed me this would be a dollar per glass, once we receive the check it ended up being $4.50 for service charges and gratuity for two wine glasses!! When I called the front desk to dispute it and only pay the two dollars like I was informed on the phone Desirae was extremely rude and could care less about the satisfaction of the guest. She refused to let me talk to a manager on duty informed me there was no managers on the entire property in her department!  This is a lie. And if it’s not a lie it’s completely idiotic for not to have an MOD on property with all these guests in house. I guess this is why the hotel is run extremely poorly. I will never stay here again I should’ve stayed on the strip like I usually do. I have been in the hotel industry for over 25 years this is probably one of the worst hotels I’ve ever stayed at.

reviews.title: Best Hotel As You Enter Las Vegas
reviews.text: I wanted to take a moment to encourage all families, solo visitors, and couples to visit South Point Hotel Casino and Spa.  If you are driving on the 15fwy north, South Point Hotel is the second Casino you will see on your right side. It’s is a beautiful golden colored building and you can’t miss it, you will see it right as you exit.What I love about this hotel?  They have so many cowboy events, gun shows, racing events, and various competitions.The rooms are HUGE!!!!  You can fit three double beds in those accommodations.  Nice!!!  And smokers, the 18th floor accommodations are the same.  Nothing less or mistreatment here.For your safety at night, the security guard ask to see your room keys as you approach the elevators.  I appreciate safety.The casino action is great.  All the newest machines and if you go mid week in which I prefer now, the winning is hot!  Friday’s I’m lucky as well but you can win at this casino and I highly recommend you to play.  The rewards are good too.  I been going for the past six years and every three months I get invited to come for two nights comp, $15 free play, with free WiFi and use of amenities....Sunday thru Thursday.  But...the past two months I visited requesting an extra comp night and I stayed free weds-Friday with $100 deposit.  The key with this hotel is to find yourself a good machine, play consistently for about 4 hours in the day and two hours at night, and you watch your mail box for hotel comp stays!This hotel has an excellent choice of restaurants and the front desk provides a booklet for special discounts.  I love the free Crown Royal drink.This hotel has a movie theatre and Wednesday’s movies are $5 all day.  Monday’s is senior days so you take advantage if applicable.This hotel has a bowling action with many group tournaments happening.This hotel have headliner shows.The spa is excellent.You don’t have to leave and if you catch football nights with the locals it’s fun!!!

reviews.title: Great place to stay in Las Vegas
reviews.text: We got a great room & had a wonderful time during our stay at South Point.  Playing on the slot club card was easy and got us some "comps".  The restaurant has a good prime rib dinner special.  My son said to try the cheesecake in the bowling snack bar.

reviews.title: Clean, quiet hotel, off the strip
reviews.text: My husband and I booked a last minute trip for Labor Day weekend. We weren’t looking for a party hotel, we’re not big gamblers, and the price was only $80 a night. 👍 We arrived at the at 9am. Surprisingly, we were able to get a room right away. We had a remodeled room which was nice, decent sized & clean. During the day, we were out by the pool. Great pool with drink/food service. I’m not sure if they always have pool side service or if it was because it was Labor Day, but the girls were busy but also attentive. It was just my husband and I but this is a great family resort. It had a 16 screen movie theater, a bowling alley, and an arcade. There were so many different food options. The coupon book you’re given at check-in is pretty good. We didn’t try the buffet until our last day because the line was always too long for breakfast. We ate at the Coronado Cafe, which was good, but after eating at the buffet, we realized why the line for it was so long. It was about half the price, and the food wasn’t that different. For dinner, we ate at Don Vito’s Italian Restaurant. It was above average... not spectacular but not bad. We also ate at Silverado Steakhouse. We have been to some amazing steakhouses & this is pretty comparable to those. Service at both restaurants were outstanding. The only reason I didn’t give South Point 5 stars, is due to the smell from the equestrian center. It wasn’t overwhelming, and it probably only bothered us a handful of times, but I wanted to mention it. I read the reviews that the hotel included an equestrian center, but didn’t think about the “smell” factor. I’m sure it didn’t bother 95% of the other guests, but my “City Nose” noticed it. Lol. But even having said that, we would definitely come back! ***One last note... if you’re looking to buy alcohol for your room, etc.. the gift shop has some great prices! My husband bought a handle of Svedka Vodka at a liquor store (which was off the strip) and it was $40?!?! The gift shop in the hotel had the same bottle for $19.99. ***

reviews.title: Nice fresh room
reviews.text: Our room was on the newly remodeled 12th floor. It was spacious and unbelievably clean and comfortable.  Beside a king bed in the room had two nice leather chairs for sitting and reading.  One of the few hotels still offering coffee in In the room and free Wi-Fi included with the resort fee.

reviews.title: Loved it here! I will be baaaack!
reviews.text: I loved it here. i was able to email the reservations area with my special requests for a nice view and high floor and they gave me exactly what i wanted! the staff were extremely friendly.  You get awesome coupon books. Pay the few extra dollars to stay in the upgraded rooms. There was alot to do at the hotel but we didnt have the time. There is an equestrain area, bowling alley and a movie theatre! Amazing. However, I recommend having a car or using uber or shuttle to get around.

reviews.title: Lovely hotel, off the strip
reviews.text: Really like this hotel.  We are getting boring now and go there every visit.  We have stayed on a lot of strip hotels but return to South Point, for the comfortable rooms, he friendly service and the roomy casino.  The staff are happy, so excellent,  and willing to go the extra mile.  Always a nice greeting from every member of staff.   Food is great, especially in the Silverado.  The buffet is being revamped and they are doing so well to try to keep things up to standard and provide a good service in the midst of it all.  Top marks!

reviews.title: comfort hotel casino
reviews.text: take a double queen room from 15th floor and up & face east - have a big viewing window with morning sun - - restaurants are most reasonable & discount vouchers lower costs - parking no problem - many slots and tables for whatever takes your fancy - 10 km south of the strip so no traffic issues - staff friendly

reviews.title: Affordable, lots of options, killer service
reviews.text: This place was recommended by a family member, and I’m glad we went. It is not on the strip, but there’s a shuttle that can have you there in fifteen minutes. Meanwhile, the Souh Point has everything you probably came for: casino, nice selection of restaurants, good rooms, pools, etc. And the price was unbeatable. Their staff are also great. Friendly, professional, and helpful. We only had a night in Vegas but this place made it totally worthwhile.

reviews.title: Awesome away from the strip
reviews.text: This place is amazing no hastle we checked in with no problem and no waiting in a long line like the strip hotels.Super clean food is great casino is clean staff is amazingThis place doesn't charge for parking

reviews.title: It's a long way from the Strip, but...
reviews.text: I've stayed at South Point 3 times, and I'm a fan.  Yes, it's a long way from the Strip, but it has so many positives:  1) Lots of good, and inexpensive, restaurants, 2) cheap drinks, 3) a coupon book that makes some of the cheap drinks free!, 4) a movie theater, 5) a huge bowling alley,  6) nice, large, clean rooms,   7) an enormous sports book, and 8) a free 80s show on Saturday nights that will get you on the dance floor!SP isn't for everyone.  If you want the glitter of the Strip, you're going to be disappointed.  But if you want a nice hotel at a reasonable price, where there's lots to do without going anywhere, I highly recommend it..

reviews.title: Prett great!
reviews.text: The room was clean and really big. They don't have cards to put out to tell the maid service if you want service, so the maids knock on your door when you're still in bed, so, kind of frustrating 😕. The pool area is awesome, which is why we chose this hotel. It was 100 degrees out and they keep the pool a nice cool temperature. It was really crowded since it was labor day weekend... But can't do anything about that I guess. South point has lots of things to do, movies, shows, bowling and gambling. It quite a ways off the strip, but parking is free.

reviews.title: Great food
reviews.text: We went to the south point and had a great time. played some slots and really enjoyed the buffet and late night breakfast after midnight. The best in quality and service at both restaurants in the South Point. The servers were most friendly and helpful.

reviews.title: Budget friendly
reviews.text: Booked a room on 9/2 to see a chow in Vegas. Large hotel, south of the strip a few miles. Room was on the 15tj floor. Double queen. Large room. Lots of space. Clean. Nice to have laminate floors rather than carpet. Plenty of restaurants on site. Bowling alley, pool, spa. Stayed here for the $75 room rate.

reviews.title: Another 5 star stay !
reviews.text: We stayed 3 days at South Point. This is the 3rd or 4th time we have stayed there. We keep coming back because we just have a good time. There is always so much to do. the rooms are very clean and quiet. Service is great. I think price is a bargain. Its a few miles from the "strip" but we like that. It's just a short drive if you want to visit. We just like the atmosphere at south point. Can't wait for our next trip.

reviews.title: Good
reviews.text: This place is nice very large bed room great bed but Has no fridge. Only reason I gave it only 3 stars and not a 4 or 5 star is because of its location 12 kms from Las Vegas strip.  We used Uber which was easy cost $16 US dollar each way.  If you have a car then staying here is easy as it has lots of free parking.

reviews.title: Great Place
reviews.text: I was very impressed with the South Point. I stayed in a premium room with a view. The view was to the east and the sunrises each morning were pretty. The entire staff that I dealt with from waiters to house keeping to front desk to casino floor folks were all very pleasant, very professional, and seemed to enjoy their jobs. The poker room staff was great and I enjoyed playing there even though most everyone knew each other at the tables. Far more locals than tourists.The restaurants were excellent. The property was clean and well maintained. I'm looking forward to a future visit and would recommend it to anyone. This is what Vegas used to be like 30-40 years ago. Affordable, accommodating, and fun to be around. It's so nice to stay in an upscale property that is away from the trash that the strip has become.

reviews.title: Everything for the Visitor
reviews.text: We did not stay in the hotel as we stayed across the street.  I did see a relative's room and was very impressed with the room.  We spent most of the time using the resort's facilities.  The gaming is as one would expect from a large facility; good sportsbook, many gaming tables and a huge selection of slots.  The buffet is very good and the movie theater is quite nice with first-run features.  On our last visit, there was an archery tournament with free admission.  Wonderful!  I particularly liked the youth competitions.  There is a Steak and Shake restaurant in addition to all the other food venues.  We really like this resort.

reviews.title: Very Nice
reviews.text: I was here for a trip away from the busy strip and the hotel was very nice good location and good g. Nice places to eat inside.If you want reasonable prices and a break from the high priced Strip come over here.

reviews.title: A Hotel for a More Laid Back Sort of Crowd
reviews.text: This hotel is located on the far south end of the strip. The hotel includes several amenities, like a movie theater and bowling for the non gamblers in the group. The slot variety is decent, but payouts are minimal due to tight machines. There are a variety of inhouse restaurants to choose from, with a buffet reminiscent of the old Las Vegas days gone by. The room was standard, but nicely kept and maintained. The views are lackluster, so don't expect much there. The staff were professional, but average in terms of friendliness.  Definitely take full advantage of the coupon booklet provided, there are some great meal discounts available.

reviews.title: South Point Hotel & Casino
reviews.text: If you do not mind being a bit off of the main part of the STRIP, this is a good place to stay.  Their rooms and casino are very good, and free parking is available.  Restaurants are located on site and bar specials may be offered at certain times.

reviews.title: Nice
reviews.text: First visit to Las Vegas and if you stay here you really need a car as it is several miles from the strip although they do provide a shuttle service. Shuttle for the airport has limited hours so be aware of this.Rooms are very large and bright, beds are not the best but ok and housekeeping seem to do a good job. For some reason you have to log in to the wifi everyday which is tedious but the biggest downside is that they make you walk through the smoke filled casino to get to your room.

reviews.title: A relaxed place that has a lot to offer.
reviews.text: We come down to visit family, start with a few days on Fremont Street and finish with 3 or 4 days here. The atmosphere is more relaxed, we've been coming here since 2008, and have yet to be disappointed. Check in was quick and friendly, and they give you a coupon book with nice deals. Our room was a mid-level King the bed was very comfortable and the room is spacious with a view of the pool. The pool is great the spa is nice but could be a degree or two warmer. You have many dinning options here, the buffet is being upgraded but it's still ok. The Del Mar Deli has a good pastrami, and some great dessert wife loves the cheese cake. The Coronado Café is very good and has a Chinese menu, also it one of the few 24hr Cafes that has a great midnight menu a must if you like steak and eggs. Their are several more restaurants so much to eat so little time. For things to do they have a bowling alley, a movie theaters. The casino has Bingo, and all the other games BJ, craps, roulette and a few others and of course VP and slots. (afraid to give to much info on games my reviews don't seem to get posted) Now your a ways off from the strip so going there will involve some travel the up side no parking fees and I believe South Points staff is friendlier. If you come here I hope you enjoy your stay as much as we do.

reviews.title: Loved by the Locals
reviews.text: A bit out of the way South of the famous Las Vegas Strip but worth the trip. The casino is nice as is the Buffet and priced fair with many different foods to choose from.The staff is very friendly and rarely will ones drinks go empty.The Buffet is also very clean The casino in itself pretty much has it all from a coffee shop to ice cream stand to restaurants.

reviews.title: MICHAEL'S
reviews.text: when I get to las Vegas. I always stop at Michael's. at the south point hotel  it is the last of the continental RESTAUTANT in las Vegas. this is a place most woman would prefer to go to. it is in the middle of the casino. and yet it is very quiet .they  have large velvet  wing back chairs where you can carry on a conversation and no one can hear you. the food is excellent . when you go there  you will tell all your friends of you experience. have fun, and you will go back.

reviews.title: End of summer getaway
reviews.text: A great place to spend time when visiting during hot days in Las Vegas. Nice show room, great movie theaters and wonderful restaurants. Casino is spacious and lots of  gambling options. Easy access on Las Vegas Blvd and plenty of free parking.

reviews.title: Fun
reviews.text: This hotel by far is worth the money, clean, good prices and really nice rooms, The Buffet is delicious and really cheap, really good deals on everything in the resort....free airport Shuttle, uber to the strip between 18 to 25 Dolars

reviews.title: Fantastic weekend
reviews.text: Very clean rooms and friendly staff. First time here since I usually stay at Venetian or bellagio or Ceasar’s , not as upscale but nice to be away from all the crowds. Food was excellent at the restaurants as well and the bar was amazing upstairs by the prime rib restaurant. Will definitely make a return trip!

reviews.title: Solid, suburban Las Vegas option
reviews.text: South Point is solid on all counts.  They're not exceptional but prices are very good, facilities are clean and well maintained and they've got all the modern conveniences.  They're quite a way down the strip (out past the airport) so you're not in the midst of all the hubbub (both a plus and a minus), have a massive parking garage they don't charge for (the latest bane of the Strip) and have friendly, helpful staff.  There's a nice variety of restaurants, ranging from casual to upscale, a ton of recreation facilities (including bowling and an arcade) plus several entertainment options including a good sized showroom and a small lounge.  Talent in the showroom is classic Las Vegas with a lean towards classic rock and pop performers.  Gaming floor is smallish and the layout of the this substantial facility is pretty generic and a bit convoluted at times.  Give yourself time to figure everything out.

reviews.title: good for the price
reviews.text: Low cost but it was nice enough for the price.  Customer service was not the best. Bartenders and waiters seems to not really care to talk to you, only amongst themselves. But a good place for the price

reviews.title: EHHHHH
reviews.text: Nice resort ..... EXCEPT! the beds are hard as a rock!  You may as well sleep on the floor.  And that alarm clock that went off nightly at midnight no matter what setting it was put on!  Finally unplugged it.  Would be nice to have had more detailed schedules of on site events.

reviews.title: Check Out Their Cafe
reviews.text: There are about 10 restaurants in this hotel.  Skip the buffet: take it from a native - it's one of the worst in town.  The restaurants however are very good.  Silverado Steak House is outstanding and not as pricey as on the strip.  Don Vito's Italian is also very good.  But what is surprising is the café in this hotel.  It is reasonably priced, with good service and generous portions.  The menu is large and the specials are very nice.  I had a 14 oz. porterhouse steak that came with soup or salad, baked potato and onion rings.  The chicken noodle soup was particularly a surprise - it had fresh vegetables and lots of chicken.  The price for all of this: $14.99  Also, if you not given a second menu (Chinese) ask for it.  They do Chinese food very, very well (try the walnut shrimp- wonderful.

reviews.title: nice hotel
reviews.text: This was a nice hotel, plenty to do, bowling, movies, watch events in the arena...there was barrel racing going on while we were there & they had vendors. We enjoyed watching the barrel racing & shopping.  Rooms could maybe use a little updating, but overall was great. $2 bloddy Mary;s were good & there were a few other drink specials. We had a great time

reviews.title: A few days away
reviews.text: The rooms are great! VERY CLEAN! The prices are reasonable for everything . Food choices are buffet to Asian to Mexican to Steakhouse. The coupon book on check in gives you better deals in the meal choices. Slots seem to be looser than downtown. We loved it!!

reviews.title: Our Favorite Vegas Hotel
reviews.text: My family and I recently spent five nights at the South Point. We have stayed here several times in the past and this visit did not disappointed. We stayed in the premium view room with two queen beds. Our room was comfortable. The A/C kept us cool. We had a view of the highway and mountains.  Even though construction was occurring at the time, the buffet was still great and well stocked. On different days we had breakfast, lunch,and dinner and left satisfied each time. We didn't bowl this time around, but the bowling lanes are great and reasonably price, especially after midnight. We caught three movies at the Cinemark theater. The theater chairs were comfortable and the concession prices were reasonably priced. The Del Mar Deli and Coronado Cafe were pretty good. Overall we enjoyed our stay and will stay here again the next time we visit Las Vegas.

reviews.title: South Point Rocks
reviews.text: I have stayed at SP several times and absolutely love it.  The place has a great choice of gaming, dining, and also has movie theater and bowling alley.  What else do you need?  The staff also is very nice.  This is a great place to play and relax!  Try it I believe you will love it

reviews.title: Great except for the plumbing
reviews.text: Loved the place when we first got there.  Room was very nice and modernly updated. Casino was clean. Check in was quick. Pool area looked very nice however we were only there for a few hours of the night so we didn't get to enjoy that. Only issue was the plumbing in our room. A 4 minute rinse off in the shower resulted in about 2" of standing water in the bottom of the tub. Our thought was "if the cleaning person cleaned the tub, wouldn't they have noticed that?" Regardless, we tried to clean out the drain so that when morning came and it was time for showers that we wouldn't be standing in a pool of water. When came time to brush our teeth, the sink filled up and was slow to drain. Informed staff upon checkout. Other than that, the visit was quite enjoyable and would most likely return.

reviews.title: Everything you could want
reviews.text: South Point casino has become our main home base for Vegas over the last 5 years.  We have stayed at SP 10-12 times over that span and been happy with our stay every time.   The rooms are large and well appointed.  They are very clean and well maintained by the housekeeping staff.  The bathrooms are large with a separate small “room” for the toilet and shower. The main section of the bathroom has a long counter with a coffee maker and other amenities.  We do like the fact that someone can be in the shower/toilet area and close the door to the sink area. Keeps the humidity down.  I should mention that the water pressure is outstanding.The coffee maker is a single cup slide operation.  They usually provide you with 2 regular and one decaf coffee slides.  They also provide you with several tea bags and cream/sugar packets.  The rooms, as I said were large, you walk in and there is a side alcove for your luggage followed by a large closet with a safe in it.  The room them opens up to the beds, large dresser, table and chairs.   Plenty of room.  The wifi in the room works pretty well.  We don’t stream anything so we just went with the standard wifi include in the resort fee.     They have a large pool area with plenty of chairs for any crowd.  They have a main pool and a kiddie pool.  They also have a large hot tub area in the back.  No one under 14 or 16 is allowed.  I forget exactly what the cut off was, since I cleared that hurdle long ago.  There is also a pool bar on the side.  The doors to the pool/spa area are a short walk from the room elevators.  There is no need to walk through the casino.  If you continue past the pool doors they have an extensive fitness center area with lots of machines and then the entrance to the spa.  The spa is not included in the resort fee and costs $30 for a single day pass.  We usually get the 5 day pass for $90.  Well worth it.  Great place with great staff.  If you book a massage or treatment, access to the spa is included.  They have a sauna, steam room, hot tub, cool pool and a water drop massage.  There is also a lounge area to relax.  Before talking about the casino I wanted to mention that they have a huge movie theater in the casino.  The seating and screens are outstanding with discount days for seniors on Monday and Wednesday and everyone on Tuesday.  They also have a bowling alley beside the movie theater with a snack bar.  The food is pretty good for a quick bit.  The casino is bright and airy, not dark like the old time casinos.  There are LOTS of VP machines with decent payouts (I play 8-5 bonus poker).  They have a large pit area with all the table games running down the middle of the casino floor.   They have a huge sportsbook with a great slightly elevated bar just outside where you can side and watch all the games on the numerous TVs and wall screens.  The poker room is huge with lots of tournaments going on throughout the day.  You can almost always find a NL or a 2-4 limit game going on.  The staff there is friendly and very helpful.   They also have bonus specials going on.  They vary from month to month.On the opposite side of the casino (near the parking garage) is the equestrian/bowling/event center.  They have numerous shows and events going on most of the time.  When we were there they had a Royal Horse show and a Ms. Vietnam pageant of some kind.  They also have a showroom located in another section of the casino with headliners.The restaurants we have tried are excellent.  We love the Mexican and the steakhouse.  The buffet is also usually good, though during this stay in early August they had a large section of it closed off for renovation so the choices were more limited than usual.  For a smaller meal they have the Steak and Shake and a Deli that will meet your needs as well as a hot dog stand during the afternoons.  The one thing that people need to know is that the place gets really crowded on the weekends (as all of Vegas does) especially with families with kids.  The rooms however are pretty sound proof with good heavy doors so you don’t hear any noise from other rooms or the hallway.The place is great and we look forward to our upcoming visit in a few months.

reviews.title: Well done Michael
reviews.text: I have been coming here since it's inception.  Always have had a great experience. Cant wait to see what the new room decor is like, the old stuff was getting old...like me I guess!South Point is a destination all on it's own!  Great restaurants, Michael's is as good as you'll find in Las Vegas!  The pool area is huge and has great service.  The dealers treat everyone like family and the Pit Bosses are phenomenal...not much turnover of personnel!Can't miss with the South Point

reviews.title: Nice quiet off the strip budget friendly option!
reviews.text: South Point Hotel is an off-the strip hotel, and because of that it has a more relaxed feel, and smaller casino floor (all types of games are available it's just not as chaotic). The parking and getting in and out are much easier because it's off the strip. The hotel itself is nice but a bit dated. This is not a five star hotel, and although it is called a four star, that probably has more to do with their vast amount of bars, restaurants, and amenities, not the quality of the hotel per se. Westins are usually rated at 4 stars and I would say this was below the Westin standard.The rooms are nice, the beds are comfortable, and the staff was very friendly. That being said, the bathrooms were tiled with a less expensive tile than I would expect out of a four star hotel, the towels, which were clean and pure white, felt like they'd been through way too many washes, and there was a lack of freshness to the hotel. Would I stay here again? Absolutely. It was well priced and it is a pleasure to be away from the chaos of the strip. I had no problems with my stay, and if you want the kind of luxury that addresses my petty grievances, you're going to have to pay a lot more than I paid for it....

reviews.title: Vegas vacation
reviews.text: Only did the casino. Packed during Saturday and Sunday. Not bad on Monday. The girls running the drinks were not so helpful. They didn’t come around often and  not helpful. I was thirsty!!!Area looked clean and restrooms too.

reviews.title: Stop in when in LasVegas
reviews.text: We travel to Las Vegas at least once a year. We like the South Point because it's away from all the crowds further up the strip, Nice well lite, clean Casino with plenty gaming choices, restaurants, movie theater, bowling alley, live entertainment, bingo pallor for the ladies, arena for rodeo, bull riding events, decent room rates and more. In fact we're planing a visit between Christmas and New Year.

reviews.title: FUN TIMES!
reviews.text: We own a timeshare at the Grandview but we go often to the South Point. It has a good movie theatre and has discount days. The restaurants are good. We like Del Mar Deli- great desserts!! Coronado is great also. We just tried Steak & Shake- we aren't really hamburger people but the chicken fingers were good. The shakes looked delicious but we were good. They also have a  place to bowl and an equestrian arena- it is used more in the fall! It is a little smokey- what can you do? I gambled but never seem to stop at winning, haha.

reviews.title: What an amazing place to stay
reviews.text: We stayed at South Point as a part of a convention in July.  We arrived en mass, but the check in was efficient.  The rooms were clean and good sized.  The only disappointment was we did not have a refrigerator because we were in a convention, lower rate room.  Great pool.  Many restaurants.  Try the buffet  Bowling and multiplex theater.  This is at the South end of the strip, so it is a bit out of the way.  We used Uber to get around.  The staff was friendly.  Free parking in a garage if you have a vehicle.  Comfortable bed.We would stay again.

reviews.title: Perfect getaway from the Strip
reviews.text: Went to visit family in Las Vegas and decided to stay at Southpoint and was very very pleased with the  property and all it had to offer.  It is very family oriented, rather than other properties in LV.  This would be a great stay for those with children and you may never have to leave the property.It is very clean, which is my number 1 priority. All team members were very helpful and did a great job to make sure our stay was a good one.  Check in was quick and easy.  There is good security presence in the hotel so we felt safe.  They pride themselves on everything being in tip top condition and clean.I used their spa facilities and it even surpassed some of the spas I've used on cruise ships!  It had all the amenities that someone would want and more. Spa staff was excellent and very kind.Our room was spacious and all amenities were refreshed everyday.  They have 11 restaurants, a bowling alley, movie theater with reduced prices, and free valet parking!  That in itself is unheard of especially in LV, they also have an event arena and you can visit those for free.  They were having rodeos while we were there.One of the restaurants was the Del Mar Deli which was outstanding!  Everything is prepared fresh and had the most awesome bakery and pastry items.  The pastrami sandwich on rye was as good as I got in New York!The air conditioning was very good and it kept the smoke [what little there was] away.They also have shuttle service to and from the airport.  Even though we were there during lightening and thunder storms we could not hear any of it in our room.  They are very well insulated both from outside noise but also room noise from neighboring rooms.  Wil definitely stay there again.

reviews.title: Hotel used by airlines when flights delayed
reviews.text: My flight git delayed so they sent me to this hotel. Checkin was easy and fast, room was decent, a bit on the old side, but clean and big.Plenty of food choices in the lobby, casino was also pretty ok. This hotel / casino is not on the strip, but it was a decent overall experience!

reviews.title: Great place, off the Strip
reviews.text: South Point always delivers.  All the amenities that one could ask for and the friendliest, most helpful staff in greater Las Vegas.  Only gets better each, and every, time we visit.  Great selection of restaurants, catering to every taste and pocketbook.  The parking valets are particularly capable and provide superb service with a smile.

reviews.title: Fine Lodging
reviews.text: Located about 8 miles from the strip this is very nice place to stay.  Parking is free and prices for food very reasonable.  The rooms are spacious and very clean.  The staff was very good and security was excellent. A car is needed if you are going anywhere but traffic was not bad.

reviews.title: Five Stars for MY experience
reviews.text: Although we’ve been to Vegas many many times throughout the years, we never heard of this place. Found it while searching on my phone as we were approaching Las Vegas on a road trip. Price for two nights was close to what we usually spent for one night at The Venetian or Wynn- the two places we usually choose to stay. Scanned a few of the reviews to learn about cleanliness & decided it would be good enough for two nights.The South Point Resort FAR exceeded my expectations. Our room 1619 was obviously remodeled, King bed. The flooring is gorgeous quality synthetic wood- no carpet at all which I Love. Two-toned paint, ceiling in a pale mocha and the walls in a darker shade with wide, white crown molding in between the two. Nice sitting area with two wing backed chairs with a table, a larger table with two quality chairs, and a desk area with a mirror and two sconces above it. Beautiful dark furniture, a hidden fridge, large closet with a safe, among other amenities. A full length mirror right by the door. Large bath with tile floors and granite countertop. Toilet and shower/tub in a separate room. Nice blow dryer, I did miss my shower cap but LOVED having the lighted mag mirror pull away from the wall. A floor to ceiling full wall length window covered with two layers of curtains. Clean clean clean , everything like brand new. I write all the detail because you’d be hard pressed to find a room of THIS comfort & quality on the strip for anywhere near the price I paid for the TWO nights, around $320 which included the resort fee. That being said, it sits about 8-9 miles south of “The Strip”, so consider this if it’s your first trip to Las Vegas.  If it’s not your first trip, this place offers everything you could ever want or need for the Vegas experience without all the chaos & people. We ate at 5 of the 11 restaurants and didn’t have a bad meal. At check-in we were given a “Fun Book” with discount off and freebies for various restaurants, bars and attractions at the resort. We used many. There is a state of the art 60+ lane bowling center and a Century multiplex movie theatre, and an equestrian center. Casino is nice with good ventilation keeping smoke levels at bay. We just stick to the few slots we enjoy playing. I put $100 in a .25 cent slot, played for an hour and walked away with $80 in my pocket. That was fun for me. (Would’ve been more fun if I would’ve stopped when I was up a bit more :) Gift shop is well stocked with Anything you could ever need or want and the alcohol is priced very well in comparison with other resort gift shops. And there’s an ice cream shop & coffee shop right near the main doors! See their web site for more details on shows, entertainment and amenities, like the pool and spa, which we used both.  If you want a break from the strip and all that entails but still want the LV experience - without all the glitz & glam, this is a great place to stay. You can always drive or cab to the strip for a special meal or show.

reviews.title: Military High-Rollers Bowling Tournament
reviews.text: South Point Hotel and Casino has always been a great place to stay. Fantastic restaurants and good gaming!!  The bowling center and Plaza are fantastic as well! Not too far from the strip, the only unfortunate thing is they no longer use a shuttle to and from the strip.

reviews.title: Good enough
reviews.text: We came to Vegas for a concert, so we are not interested in the craziness on the Strip.  This hotel is reasonable, clean, quiet, and has easy access to the Strip.Pros:Reasonable price Free parking!Quiet and clean roomGood water pressure for showerNot far from the stripCheck-in is easyCons:Pool is crowded.Internet is slow.Cheap soaps/amenities made in ChinaNo complementary spa access to anything ($30 daily resort fee)

reviews.title: Nice hotel but a little dated
reviews.text: We stayed at this hotel because our Hawaiian airlines flight was delayed 15 hours.  Hawaiian airlines gave us vouchers for this hotel and it's buffet to rest up during the delay.   It was nice but a little dated.  It was clean but the rooms you can tell have not been renovated in a while.  The furniture was dated but the room and bathroom were clean.  The cigarette smoke has settled in the carpeting for years.   The buffet was good.  Not great but good.  Just don't go for the steak.  It was tough.  They gave free wine the night we were there, which was a pleasant surprise.  They had a movie theater which the kids took advantage of and I considered that a "plus" as well.

reviews.title: Off-strip haven!
reviews.text: Great pricing on rooms and food options make the South Point a great start to your time in Vegas. Being off-strip is an added bonus for those who want to avoid being in the middle of the chaos. Rooms are larger than competitors and comfortably appointed. Having a multi screen theater complex and 64 lanes of bowling will also help keep you and family occupied. Although Vegas seems to have given up on calling itself a "family" destination, the South Point does a great job of being friendly to family travelers.

reviews.title: Fun and relaxation
reviews.text: This is my second visit to SouthPoint. This hotel wouldn’t have been my first choice when coming to Las Vegas, if not for the many bowling tournaments I attend. The bowling alleys are ok but really cold, so take a sweater and or blanket. Of course, if your bowling, it’s the complete opposite.Our room was really nice and roomy. If you require a lot of room, ask for a corner room. The bathroom was nice and spacious, the toilet and shower were in a room separate from the huge mirror, sink and counter space. The hallways were a little hot, not sure if they are supposed to be that way or if the air conditioners were broken.This place has several great restaurants, movie theater, game room for kids, and of course a swimming pool. Of course you can’t forget the casino floor. Everyone was so helpful when we needed.Needless to say, if you don’t want the hustle and bustle of downtown but still want the feel of Las Vegas, this is the place for you. I am sure we will be coming here again and then I’ll try out the spa!

reviews.title: Las Vegas Excursion
reviews.text: My wife and I recently stayed at the South Point for 2 days.  We received a complimentary room as a result of gambling at the South Point the last time we were in Vegas.I was extremely pleased with everything at the South Point.  Our room was really nice and the bed was very comfortable.  We enjoyed the pool area a great deal as there were plenty of lounge chairs and drinks and food were readily obtainable at reasonable prices from attentive waitresses.  We are serious video poker players and the South Point offers a great variety of machines at the best odds.  For a diversion, we enjoyed playing Bingo where you are served complimentary beverages.We ate at the Mexican restaurant and the Asian fusion place.  Both were very good to excellent and priced fairly.  We saw the Herman’s Hermits.  If you closed your eyes, you would think it was 1966...terrific.As a result of my gaming, the South Point comped my bill which was $350...that did not include the comp tickets to the show.  I did not expect a full comp as I had received the show tickets so I was really pleased.

reviews.title: Great Hotel, Great Casino, Great Hospitality
reviews.text: I first stayed at South Point Hotel in 2010 and fell in love with it - it was clean, it was lively, it was full of amenities, the restaurants were all delicious, the spa was beyond amazing. It is far from the strip, but I like that about it, too. I have since recommended it to anyone planning a trip to Vegas. My parents recently went to South Point for their anniversary and received a small, yet unexpected, treat upon check-in (the small things make a big difference). Without going into too much detail, my mother fell ill the following day and the staff at the hotel could not have been quicker to respond (calling an ambulance) or more helpful to my parents. Their stay had to be extended for an indefinite amount of time and additional rooms had to be reserved for additional family members, and desk clerks were incredibly accommodating and understanding of our situation. They made sure that we had one less thing to worry about during a difficult time.And the hotel and casino were as great as they were in 2010. The hotel and casino are both still clean and well-maintained, the food was delicious, and the amenities were plenty. Parking is available (for free!) outside and in the garage. There is plenty variety of food, tons of slots and tables, a fantastic pool, a relaxing hot tub, a stellar spa, and many family-friendly things to do, like bingo, bowling, and movies.

reviews.title: CASINO
reviews.text: The Casino is not bad but is a little messing through out, it has cups left unattended and ash tray full. I find it very smoking and the air does not flow as well as some of the other Casinos. I find it a little run down. It could use a face lift

reviews.title: Great place to eat
reviews.text: With a variety of different restaurants to choose from you can't beat the steakhouse or the Italian restaurant my two favorites but if you just looking for something quick they have a couple little delis that have some fantastic food and when you go to the deli get the apple turnover or the brown be there huge and only a couple bucks

reviews.title: Decent hotel for families but far from the Strip
reviews.text: Stayed here as a family of 3. Compared to the hotels on the Strip, the hotel cleanliness and amenities seemed a bit better for the money you pay. This is not a fancy hotel by any means, but it was decent if you don't mind being pretty far from the Strip.Like most hotels in Vegas, walking in the ground floor (casino) to get anywhere means inhaling air filled with second-hand smoke. In that respect, hotels like Cosmopolitan seems to do a good job of air filtration.Our room did not smell too bad of old carpet as many guest rooms seem to have been recently renovated. The beds were comfy, with good pillows, and we slept well. As a family with a child, we appreciated the in-house movie theater and bowling alley.

reviews.title: Disappointed Birthday...
reviews.text: While having a birthday dinner in the Bake & Shake,a server dropped a ceramic bowl that he was attempting to balance on a very full tray. The bowl shattered on the hard floor which caused sharp pieces to ricochet , hitting my husbands knee. It caused an injury to him and another guest. At first, he did not want to make an issue, but as we were waiting till security complted their report, it started to worsen. I would estimate us being there an additional hour. We were insulted when the manger only took off $4.00 from our meal. We didn't want to make matters worse for the server, so we let it go. Upon checking out, we truly thought we would be compensated in some way for the injury, ruined birthday meal, and inconvenience. That did not occur. We are repeat customers, and have recommend this hotel to family & friends in the past. No longer. As a guest, like in your own home, you go above and beyond making them feel welcomed, safe and appreciated. We felt none of this.

reviews.title: Nice stay at South Point
reviews.text: 2nd visit for USBC Bowling tournament.  Plenty to eat, state of the art bowling facilities,  nice multiplex movie theater, rooms are very spacious, nice variety of slot machines, not overcrowded,  free hotel shuttle to and from the airport.  Just a great stay overall!

reviews.title: Good stay
reviews.text: Great staff and a lot to offer being a little bit off the main strip. We stayed for a horse show...amazing arena and environment to be in. Parking was also super easy and convenient to main entrance of hotel.

reviews.title: Typical Vegas; overpriced
reviews.text: Participant at the South Point Western Gift Show during Nathional Finals of Team Roping Event, concurrent with the NFR.  Tons of people in town, great competition and one of the richest purses in competitive competition for rodeo events.  The facility is totally geared to western events, horse shows, etc.  Three arenas are housed in the event center; the main one with ample seating to watch the equestrian events.  The Casino, etc. is typical Las Vegas; overpriced for what you receive.  The Hotel, Casino and Spa are privately owned, and it is obvious that the owner is all about the all mighty dollar so don’t expect any considerations or special treatment.  As an artist, I couldn’t not have been treated more distantly.  And I paid almost $2000 to participate in the Western Gift Show. The Event Center is run by a woman who doesn’t have a clue as to how to work with the public nor does she care to accommodate anyone but herself and the owner.  Last year was my last to contribute any more to this capitalistic enterprise who cares nothing for the participants of the show.

reviews.title: Pleasant place to stay
reviews.text: Pleasant place to stay,  as long as you’re not looking for the action that goes on on the main strip. The hotel is huge has plenty of restaurants and the food is good. The rooms are nice and clean the bed is moderately comfortable. The negative being that the hotel is kind of isolated so you can’t really walk anywhere from the hotel. But if you want to vacation where you’re not gonna leave the hotel and just hang out it’s nice. We stay here when we’re going to fly out of Las Vegas airport.

reviews.title: Overall good experience
reviews.text: The room was clean and large.  The casino itself is very large.  Staff was very accommodating.  We had to park our luggage at the bell desk because we arrived very early and could not check in, not a problem. I then had to use the business center (even though we had not checked in) to print our boarding passes.  Saw a movie and the theatre was nice and clean.  It was overall a good experience and we may stay there again in the future.

reviews.title: Great place
reviews.text: Room was great and the price was right.  Pool area was perfect.  Our kids had a great time swimming and relaxing.  Distance from the strip was fine for us because we wanted to stay a ways away. I played the tables and i thought the casino area was nice.

reviews.title: Fantastic Buffet for the Price
reviews.text: The buffet was about $16 for members.  The excellent food included Prime Rib, shrimp and oysters.  The dessert included many flavors of gelato.  Conversation was easy in the restaurant.To be a free member, register at the Club (Rewards window).  The card provided will allow you and one other person the buffet members cost.  The buffet entrance is closed at 9pm although food continues to be available for those already seated. Notes:Gambling seems to pay off better than at the Strip.  My cousin came out a winner from the Dragon game.  Self parking on late Tuesday night was easy.

reviews.title: Fantastic Hotel and Casino
reviews.text: The South Point has newer machines, restaurants, meeting places, equestrian center, arena, hotel and above all FREE VALLET PARKING.  Go to the strip and find that.  We were there for the $1,000,000.00 bingo, and I stopped and talked with the security and I was joking about all the people for the horse shooting competition in the casino on a Wednesday.
