He gave me funny look and said that on Thursday that 1400 more people were coming for the bingo competition.  So yes this hotel can hold a lot of people.

reviews.title: Birthday weekend
reviews.text: I really liked this place. It was away from all the crazy, but close enough to go see it all. Loved the rooms very clean and had a bus take us shopping. The view was great of the mountains. The bad thing was the buildings all look the same kind of hard to find our building

reviews.title: GREAT CONVENTION SITE
reviews.text: Generally I don't like all the noise and crowded casinos of LAS VEGAS. However, I wanted to attend the annual NCRS [ National Corvette Restorers Society ] convention this year held at this resort on July 15-19..What a pleasant surprise. I drove from my rural home in Texas and arrived Tuesday July 17. My room was perfect. I have MS and use a electic scooter to get around, and access to the room and hotel was perfect. Outstand service, very clean and new.I met friends for meals and entertainment the two days I attended. All food and service was excellent. My room was very quiet and excellent quality. The rates were very reasonable comparted to regular motel rates today.

reviews.title: Love this place
reviews.text: Love this place it's almost A one place to do things casino ice cream food buffet movie theater bowling arcade and  a arena for different events when we were there for a week in July we had the quarter horse show that we watch and then after that had a BMX event.

reviews.title: Good value, few things could improve
reviews.text: Overall would probably stay here again.  Stayed in one of the remodeled premium rooms.  It was nice enough, fairly roomy, very clean.  Hotel was fairly quiet.  Parking is easy and not too far a hike, check in was no wait, some decent dining options.  Pool isn't huge but is nice and has a bar there.  Just an easier place to stay than a crowded mega casino on the strip.  If you like to bowl they havea nice bowling center.  The bedding could be better, it was firm and pillows wern't my favorite for sure.  The buffet at lunch was definitely not great.  In lower half of vegas buffets imo and could be so much better in a hotel this size. At around 9:15 am housekeeping was in the hall knocking loudly on doors with a seeming urgency to check rooms.  It was enough that you came to the door.  I didn't understand the exercise but glad i wasn't still sleeping.  So its not perfect but its good for the money. I did not get a chance to try the casino.  It seemed ok. They still have blackjack with decent rules and low table limits.  Plenty of open tables it looked like. Resort fee was around $20 plus dollars a day.  Typical in todays vegas.  Seems a lot for internet, a pool and whatever else should be included anyway.

reviews.title: Superb Service!
reviews.text: Had a Comp Stay here, and they were wonderful the room was immaculate!!!!!Nice and clean, and the room was Huge! The Coronado Cafe  located in the hotel was AMAZING THE FOOD WAS REASONABLE AND DELICIOUS!!!!!

reviews.title: Excellent Location and Casino Hotel
reviews.text: I really love South Point in Las Vegas!  I have stayed several times and always find the resort to be clean, friendly and convenient to the Strip!  There are a number of restaurants to choose from and I have also been to the onsite movie theater!

reviews.title: Loved Hotel, Casino Not So Much
reviews.text: This property has a very nice hotel. Our room was clean and modern. There is also a very nice movie theater, pool and bowling alley. I can see families with teenagers vacationing here. My husband and I went in the summer and were thankful to see an ice cream parlor in the front of the casino. It was nice being at the south part of the strip. Plenty of places offsite to eat in this particular area.

reviews.title: This is not a 4 Star Hotel
reviews.text: Staff at Front Desk are very rude and do not care about the customer. Their Premium rooms do not all look like the ones they advertise. I paid for a Premium room with a view. My view was a roof top and a highway. I was there for 6 nights and when I took the kids to the pool it was closed on two separate occasions that I know about due to a Bio -Hazard issue. So this means people are pooping in the pool. Now to top it off it was so crowded from Thursday thru Sunday that you had to wait in long lines to get on an elevator. Usually 10 to 15 minutes every time you need to go up or down. This was very hard for my 81 year old mother to stand in these long lines every day all day long for 4 days. I will not stay here again.

reviews.title: Nice place out of the way
reviews.text: I visited South Point to see a Corvette shoe. The hotel is way off the strip but worth the ride. It's beautiful inside with the obligatory casino and very moderately priced.  Extremely nice inside and free guarded parking.

reviews.title: Great spot off the Strip to launch your southwest vacation
reviews.text: My wife and I have stayed at the South Point several times over the years. It is where we stay when we fly into Las Vegas when on any trips in the Southwest. Our original motivation for selecting it was that is off the strip and that it seemed to cater to adults. There are three essential highlights of the South Point. First, the rooms are marvelous. They are spacious, comfortable, well-furnished, and easily accessible. Second, the spa is fantastic. My wife and I take full advantage of the spa whenever we stay there, sometimes more than once. Finally, the tequila bar is fantastic. It was there that we were introduced to our favorite tequila, Milagro. The one set back was that the food available at the bar was rather limited. Otherwise, the hotel offers a decent variety of restaurants with diversity in menu and cost - from family dining to more high-end fine dining. The smoke in the casino is not too bad, and it is really easy to get from the South Point to other spots in Vegas if you want, or to the highway to get out and explore the Southwest (which is what we often do). Finally, checking into and out of the hotel is incredibly easy and organized. I highly recommend the South Point for your Vegas trip!

reviews.title: Vacations
reviews.text: fun, relax and good service, don't enjoy the  pool too much, water on pool taste weird. enjoy the restaurants and casino. a great  family friend Hotel , enjoy the  bowling alley, definitively we  will back  again , thanks  for the  great service.

reviews.title: Great hotel, excellent stay!
reviews.text: This is the second time my partner and I have stayed at South Point. The last time being five years ago. We were in Vegas for 4 days, as a side trip to driving Route 66.Quick efficient check in and this time we had a room with a view to the front of the hotel - room 2145 much better than last time. The rooms are a great size with amazing,comfortable beds. Spotlessly clean bathrooms. The only gripe with the housekeeping staff is that even after using the soap for 1 day it is changed.Why?? We would have used the same soap for our stay. There is a good choice of restaurants in the hotel. On site facilities are great and enjoyed one of the free equine events in the enormous indoor arena.The downside is the resort fee which at $21 per day is extreme especially if you don't use any of the facilities is says it covers, but I know the majority of hotels in Vegas charge this. So why not just include it in the advertised room price.Even so, still had a great stay!

reviews.title: Great stay!
reviews.text: Our basic room was huge compared to our on the strip room. The bed was comfy and the sheets were soft. Tuesday just happens to be $5.25 movies all day! Terrific value! Gambling was better than on the strip, too. Buffet is just okay but I don't care for buffet anyways. We both enjoyed our stay here and will definitely be back!

reviews.title: Thrills and Cheap Meals at the Casino
reviews.text: Note: I did not visit the hotel, so I am reviewing the casino.Although this casino is located away from the main tourist attractions, it has all the games and entertainment options of the more prestigious casinos.  Machine games, sports betting, poker tournaments, BINGO, bowling, and a movie theater are just some of the daily entertainment offerings, along with specialty shows.  And then there are the restaurants, offering something for everyone at a much more reasonable price than eateries on the Strip. The waitstaff were friendly and attentive, more so than I’ve found at other casinos.  This place is definitely worth the trip.

reviews.title: Good for a bargain visit to Vegas
reviews.text: We booked a last minute weekend get-a-away to Vegas and decided to go a bit toward the cheaper side. South Point definitely fit our price point. There were pros and cons to staying here. Pros:Easy to get to - south of the strip, away from strip trafficLarge parking garage — even with the BMX championships and a martial arts tournament there was always room in the garageCheck In — Minimal line — we were checked in, in under 10 minutes. Room Size — We had a king bed room — good size room with a couch. Big bathroom and plenty of counter space. Good Lighting throughout the bathroom and main room.Buffet Prices — Used the coupon book we received upon check in — (tip: after you check in, go pick up a club card for further restaurant discounts - it’s free and you don’t have to gamble to get restaurant discounts). We used our 1/2 off buffet coupons for the weekend brunch — We got 1/2 off of both our club rate breakfasts — full buffet, unlimited mimosas for 2 for $21.00M-F with the club card buffet breakfast with unlimited Bloody Mary’s is only $8.95. Buffet is actually good with a wide selection of food. Soundproofing — I don’t know what they used in the doors and the walls but we never heard a peep from the hallway. Pool Area — Nice size pool — no bells and whistles. But if you use it mid-day after check out and before check in, you practically have it to yourself. Also pool and hot tub are open until 10pm — a rarity on the strip!Cons:Pool Area — No shade, not even umbrellas, hot tub is enormous (nice feature) but according to posted signs is just 16 and up — that was never enforced. We eventually left because children were being allowed to dangerously jump off of wet rocks into the hot tub. Elevator Lines — I know there is nothing they can do about this one — they have 12 elevators but the lines were awful. Be prepared to wait. We were on floor 15 and often ended up getting on an elevator going up just to secure a space so we could go down. Otherwise it would always arrive full to our floor and we wouldn’t be able to get on. Housekeeping — Probably the biggest disappointment of the trip. I’m still confused on this one — after night one we were given new bath towels, hand towels and wash cloths and our bath mat was replaced. After night 2 — our dirty towels were left in piles on the floor and we were not given new ones. My husband had to track down the maid cart and take new ones for us. I looked all over for signs saying to leave towels one way for cleaning and another way to re-use. There were none and I found it strange that towels left on the floor were not replaced with new ones. Maintenance— The next biggest disappointment of the trip. We arrived later in the evening and by the time we were heading to bed it was after 1am. At that point we realized our sink stopper was broken - it was down and not connecting so there was no way to drain the sink. At 1am we decided we could live with a non-draining sink until morning and sparingly used the sink so that it wouldn’t over flow. In the morning we then discovered the shower drained extremely slow. My husband took a 5 minute shower and the water was at his ankles when he got out. It took another 10 minutes for it to drain. We hadn’t called about the sink yet, so we figured, no big deal, we’ll report both drains and let them fix both issues while we were out for the day. My husband called down to the desk reported the issue and we were told they would be fixed that day.    We stopped back after breakfast and found the plumber working on our sink. He mentioned we were lucky the pipes hadn’t leaked as there was a bad part. He did get it fixed for us and replaced the bad part. Now at this point, we both assumed he had already fixed the shower drain. I guess it’s our fault for not asking if he had indeed fixed the drain, we discovered later that afternoon that he had not fixed the drain. So we called down again to ask if someone would be coming back to fix the drain. We were told they would try to send someone up that evening. We went back out for our evening plans and returned around midnight to find that no one had fixed our drain and we were still showering in water hovering at our ankles. We checked out the next day. I hope they fixed it before they gave our room to new guests. So...bottom line for us...not a bad place to stay but it won’t be in our go to list for cheaper Vegas stays.

reviews.title: Would stay again
reviews.text: This is a nice hotel not too far from the strip. I did a staycation here with my kids and they didn't want to leave. A couple of things I didn't like was I did not like the "open" bowling times. Every time we went there was a tournament. The staff never even greeted us and let us know what was going on. I had read the sign after standing at the desk for 5 minutes. Another thing was I don't know what schedule housekeeping had but it was very weird to me. In the morning I would have do not disturb sign and they didn't bother us. We returned to the room around 2pm so that my kids could take a nap and one of the housekeepers entered the room. So I know for the next stay to leave the sign all day. Besides those issues I would stay again and just plan activities more accordingly.

reviews.title: Best hotel in Las Vegas!
reviews.text: Our go to place to stay in Vegas.  Can't  beat the price for a fabulous stay. Rooms are large and clean, staff is helpful and friendly.  Casino and restaurants are wonderful.  Free valet parking is a real plus, the valet workers are terrific!

reviews.title: “South” of the Strip
reviews.text: Now I know why hotels located towards the South of the strip are not your TOP hotels. The South Point is a hotel that has many amenities: Spa, Pool, Movie Theater, Bowling, Casino and many restaurants, but still it doesn’t compare to the other hotels in Vegas. The hotel is outdated with its decor and the rooms are Ok, nothing that you wouldn’t find at PRIMM. Overall this hotel needs a major overhaul and don’t expect it anytime soon. The pricing is moderate and yes there is a $21 a day resort fee which covers basically nothing. Next time I will be staying in the gut of the strip.

reviews.title: Off the Strip Casino
reviews.text: Were in Vegas for the Vegas National BMX bike race at South Point. Not necessarily the most modern hotel it far exceeded our expectations. Started with vale parking, it's free at South Point; very courteous. Check-in took about 4 minutes and they were busy. Rooms were spacious and clean. Overall hotel staff was A+. We did not eat in any of the upscale restaurants. Food was OK were we did eat. Checkout was as swift as check-in and the car was available in minutes. Just a great experience. Depending on location in the hotel wifi can be a little weak.

reviews.title: Would Rather Stay Here Than on the Strip
reviews.text: After staying at many of the big name hotels on the strip, we decided to try a hotel off the strip and are so glad we did. We have stayed her five times now and will probably never stay anywhere else in Vegas. The rooms are reasonably priced and are very clean and nice. The pool is great. They have a lovely spa where I had a great manicure and pedicure. The restaurants are good (except the MExican one..pretty BLAH). They even have a bowling alley. It's so nice to be off the strip away from all of the traffic and insanity.

reviews.title: Couldn't of ask for anything better other than a little closer to the strip.
reviews.text: A perfect location for all families, Bowling alley and movie theater on location, Steak and shake located on premises at good price and a great garden Buffet that is discounted with players card. The only place that this place does not have is a free shuttle to the strip.

reviews.title: Massive rooms, clean, comfortable, lovely staff.
reviews.text: We were sent here by the airline for 2 nights due to cancelled flights. Really just expected something basic, but was surprised how nice this hotel was. The rooms are clean and huge, as well as the bathroom. The beds are very comfortable. There is plenty to do on site including a cinema! The only negative is that it is far from the strip, and the airport, and Cabs can get expensive.

reviews.title: Great service
reviews.text: Upon arrival we were greeted by the woman at the desk with a wide smile and a happy to see you demeaner. Check in was a breeze. The room was located on the third floor in a quiet area. It was very large and spacious as was the bathroom. Both were very clean. The breakfast buffet offered an extensive selection of sea food, salads, omletts made to order, and other hot and cold items. The only displeasure was the coffee (ugh!). Although smoking was allowed in the casino, the air filtering system was excellent and no detrimental effects from the smoke were felt. Since Vegas’ hotels introduced the parking fee for parking, it was a pleasant surprise to find a high quality hotel which was reasonably priced and offerred free parking. We would definitely stay at this hotel again.

reviews.title: Pay the extra to stay in the newly refurbished rooms.
reviews.text: Just returned from a week-long stay at South Point.  The first night we were in one of the older rooms because there were no newly refurbished rooms available.  The older room was clean, but a bit tired.  The new room was very nice, everything in good working order and nicely decorated.  The hotel itself has plenty of places to eat; we recommend the Sushi place, the Mexican and Italian restaurants.  The Seattle's Best coffee is also great for oatmeal for breakfast.  We really enjoy their onsite bowling and movies.  Don't worry about the elevators if you are on a higher floor, the express elevators to those floors are quick and efficient, they skip the first 14th floors.  The gym was perfect for my husband in the morning, very clean and well organized.  The pool had plenty of shade until about lunchtime, plenty of loungers and towels available for use.  The staff was very friendly and helpful throughout our stay.

reviews.title: Horrible food
reviews.text: I would not recommend the restaurant to anyone unless you want really cold food. Took forever to get our food then when it came out it was cold. No one checked on us after and then paying the employees were too busy talking to each other to care.

reviews.title: The Best Place to stay in Las Vegas
reviews.text: This is a 5 star property, there is some much to see and do at this Hotel casino, the days roll by and it's time to go home. The restaurants are great Michael Steak house is much better then the Atlantis Steak House I believe. My group of 10 with there wives will be staying here next year, we all just love coming out for a visit. I Hotel is very clean and you can see the Management is on there game, and the prices are very good on the rooms, and it's easy to get to the Strip.

reviews.title: Relax away from the strip!
reviews.text: Huge casino has everything you want inside. Many restaurants with reasonable prices. Slots everywhere and table games galore. Bowling alley and large bingo parlor. They also offer free shows that are quite entertaining.

reviews.title: WARNING THEY ARE UNDER CONSTRUCTION
reviews.text: WARNING THEY ARE DOING CONSTRUCTION!!! Unfortunately they will not disclose this to you when making a reservation nor will they disclose this to you when you check in. However, you will find out about it when you are woken up by the loud hammerinh, drilling, grinding, banging, ect. The fact that they did not disclose this info is far beyond unprofessional, in very poor taste, deceptive, and just down right rude! I reported this to the front desk supervisor Desiree and all I got was a repeated non genuine fake, "oh I'm sorry you weren't informed." She offered to move me to another room but at this point I'm already awake, can't go back to sleep, and will thankfully be checking out in the morning hopefully before they get started with their construction. COMMON COURTESY GOES A LONG WAY IN PROVIDING GREAT CUSTOMER SERVICE. Southpoint, you obviously have a lot to learn about that. Next trip I'll bypass your "resort".

reviews.title: Perfect quick stay
reviews.text: We stayed over one night on a Friday and it was perfect. Found parking right away. Front desk was nice. Room was quiet. Several miles from the strip but that was nice. Was able to get a meal at a local fast food place before driving into the busy strip. Would stay again. Only a $7 Uber to Bellagio was nice.

reviews.title: South point review
reviews.text: The room was clean, the staff was friendly and were quick with service. The food was good and plenty of fun activities. I enjoyed the perks of the club card, the movies and quiet pool areas, the conference room was large and accommodating to our needs. The only negative was the smell that came from the equestrian  arena by the elevators when it was windy.

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: This place is awesome!!!!! It kept the kids entertained and the adults had fun as well. The staff in the bowling alley could take some customer service tips but overall we enjoyed the amenities of this place

reviews.title: Nice hotel and casino!
reviews.text: I’ve been to Vegas more times than I can count and this is the first time enjoying The South Point hotel. I was here for a dance convention and spent time in the hotel, restaurants and exhibit rooms. Everything was very clean. The rooms are big and comfortable. The restaurants all had really good service and the food was great. I played some at the tables and a session of Bingo and had fun. It may have been my first stay at South Point but it won’t be my last!

reviews.title: Excellent Stay
reviews.text: Clean and lots to do. Shuttle to from airport/strip if needed. Good pool and lots of places to eat at reasonable prices. Stayed all over Vegas and eaten here in the past. Should we return, would certainly stay here.

reviews.title: Dissapointment
reviews.text: If you'r not a cowboy or bowler im confident there is lots of better alternatives.Food  is average - getting a drink playing games takes forever. Out keys keept breaking down and not funn waiting in line for 20 min. To get replacement.

reviews.title: Good Vegas Hotel
reviews.text: South Point Hotel and Casino is a good hotel.  Accessible and free covered parking (nice when it's 107 degrees).  Rooms clean, good linens.  Restaurants good and reasonable.  If you don't have to be right on the strip, this is a good one!  While you are there, eat at the Black Bear Diner right down the street.  Outstanding comfort food.

reviews.title: VEGSA
reviews.text: Nice that this is off the strip.  Wish we would have gotten one of the new rooms since they have hardwood floors and a refrigerator.  Our room was huge and it was nice.  Lots of things to do.  Casino is slow to give multi games on the slots but if you get one you do get paid for it.Loved that there is a bowling ally, movie complex, and even horse shows.....family friendly.  Pool was ok, not as big as it looks in pictures.   Lots of resturants for many different tastes.  Be sure to use the coupon book you get at check it for some more freebies.

reviews.title: GREAT stay at the South Point !!!
reviews.text: Our family (me,my wife and our 16- and 12-year old) stayed at the South Point for 3 nights before checking into our week-long timeshare at the Hilton Grand Vacation Club on Paradise and, to be completely honest, we enjoyed our stay at South Point a lot more than we did the Hilton property.We paid on average $120/night for Wed-Fri night and the $21/day resort fee included in that price gave us a coupon book which we used to save money at the onsite Garden Buffet (we enjoyed a great breakfast), the onsite bowling center, the onsite bingo, and the onsite Cinemark movie theater.We had the 2 queen deluxe mid view unit and it was a bit more roomy than a typical 2-bed hotel room as others here have mentioned.  My wife enjoyed the fact that the bathroom actually had decent counter space (see attached picture).Aside from having the casino downstairs, there are several onsite restaurants with various price ranges.  Our family enjoyed the Steak n Shake a couple times during our 3-night stay and we even came back for the afternoon Happy Hour (2:00-5:00pm weekdays) 50% off milkshakes during our subsequent stay at our Hilton timeshare.  In addition, the Garden Buffet breakfast was really good.  And what made it better was that we signed up for a South Point Club Card (which was very easy to do) to get the $8.95 discounted price and THEN used the 50% off coupon from the coupon book that we received at check-in.  Nice!We also enjoyed the bowling center (50% off in the coupon book) and the $5.25 all-day price on Tuesdays at the onsite movies.  And the swimming pool was huge and the pool area was really nice.  The only issue if that there isn't a lot of shade by the pool so we waited until early evening to avoid the strong sun.  Oh, and my wife actually won some $$$ one night at the onsite bingo room!  :)My wife and kids thought the casino was a little smoky but I didn't find it too bad.  I would have liked to see the Motown show at the onsite theater--maybe next time.So in summary, there's a lot to do at the South Point.  And the prices are very reasonable for what you get.  I will gladly look to book here again on a future trip to Las Vegas.  Highly recommended by this reviewer and his family.  Well done, South Point!

reviews.title: Great price!
reviews.text: Overall, a good "non-strip" location with all the normal amenities. Great price for a person going through town but more than enough "stuff" to do on site. Good buffet and AMAZING movie theater. (discounts on Tuesday's and/or in coupon book provided at check-in)

reviews.title: premium rooms
reviews.text: We booked 3 premium rooms for our extended family for a weekend in Vegas. The difference between the deluxe rooms are the floor having a carpet and hardwood floors on the premium rooms. The premium rooms has a mini fridge and located on higher floor which means having a better view. Our room was clean, staff are friendly and easy checking in and out.This is a family friendly resort offering a theater, arcade (although small), bowling and the pool area is huge. There are multiple restaurant ranging from buffet of course to snack stands. They also give a booklet of offers at check in with my favorite which is a 50% off buffet. This resort is not in the strip (south) but has a shuttle to the strip and it's about 5 minutes drive. It offers free valet and self parking which is a plus since most if not all strip hotels charge for parking fees these days. A $21 resort fee is not bad as compared to $35 to $40 resort fees to the hotels on the strip.

reviews.title: Very Good Value, Nice Rooms if Upgraded
reviews.text: South Point is off the strip. These are the least expensive hotels rooms in Vegas and they give you a good value if you get an upgraded room. We were on the second from the top floor. The room was large with two lounge chairs and a table and king size bed. The bathroom is a little on the small size. The bed was comfortable. There is a small under counter refrigerator in the room. The upgraded rooms are only about $10 more a day but well worth it. The hotel has many places to eat. The buffet is good. Avoid the Mexican restaurant as it is awful. I have not tried the others. They have a large pool and a spa but finding a chair on hot day can be daunting. Seems like there were less chairs than people. Join their player's club to get some 2 for one coupons and other stuff. I have stayed her twice and was not disappointed either time. But prepare to walk. It is a huge hotel and it is a long walk from the casino to the rooms and from the parking structure to the casino. I suggest that you find places to eat outside the hotel if you are willing to drive a little.

reviews.title: Great Value Exceptional Quality
reviews.text: I stayed here two nights for business on my first visit to their property and was surprised by clean well appointed room at such a great rate. The room was decorated with modern touches and very big compared to most standard Vegas rooms.   Mr. Vaughn clearly prides himself on the property and it’s reputation—which in turn benefits each guest. The eating venues are great with quality food at great prices. Although it is off the beaten strip path it is only a quick $15 Uber rider to the heart of the strip. I will definitely return here on my next Vegas trip regardless of my business based on my the quality and cleanliness!

reviews.title: Decent Place to stay
reviews.text: Stayed on my way through Vegas on a work trip.  Room was nice, clean and comfortable.  Went down to the pool for a little relaxation after a long drive.  The pool area was nice with a decent amount of seats available although it was a Sunday afternoon.  The pool itself wasn’t exactly clean, leaves dirt and debris was visible everywhere.  Now I know its difficult to clean a pool of this size and all but its seems that a better jib could be done.  All in all, I still think its a nice place if you don’t have the desire to stay on the strip proper.

reviews.title: Great value for the money
reviews.text: Whatever you plan to do, we get back to South Point. Makes it easy to have everything around. They have great deals. The rooms are clean and we noticed they are remodeling. The pool area is awesome.Great restaurants to choose from.  Lots of options for things to do. 5 min away from the airport, easy access to the Strip, but staying away from the madness.

reviews.title: Great accommodations!
reviews.text: Found this on Hotwire and will definitely be back. The rooms are huge with tons of room for a hotel room.  Hotel staff was great, gave tons of extra coffee when requested, easy check in/out not a huge wait.  Beds super comfortable and rooms were very clean. Hotel has live free comedy Friday nights, casino isn’t filled with smoke like most of the hotels on the strips and seems to be more open and bright. Lots to do just in the hotel.  Pool and hot tub are are decent and roomy. Very relaxing atmosphere around the hot tub especially with it being 16 and over for hot tub. Shuttle service was great and on time as well. A+ i will be back!

reviews.title: Excellent value and good for off-strip hotel
reviews.text: If you are not coming to Vegas for the Strip and are looking for good value then the South Point is a good option.  We booked this for 1 night as an addition to our stay on the Strip as our plans changed and we needed another night at the start of our stay in Vegas.  Our other hotel was going to be $300-$400 for 1 night and this hotel was about $45!We checked in with 4 friends, each of whom had booked a Queen room and they all got upgraded to a King Suite on one of the top floors, yet when we checked in next, we still got the Deluxe King we booked on one of the bottom floors (5).  Not to mention, we were the only actual couple - so not sure how they work their upgrades.We had a king bed which was comfortable in a huge room.  The bathroom was off the main room, but then within this there was another door to the shower and toilet.  This is great if someone needs to use the sink while someone else is in the shower/toilet.  The shower pressure was amazing - always a great thing for a hotel room.  Consequently, when you opened our curtain, we had a view of a fence about 1 metre from our window.The hotel has a shuttle to and from the airport and this was easy to find and very good.The resort fee had gone up to $21 a night (this was after our booking).  This hotel is a good budget hotel and you can definitely tell this from the clientele of the patrons in the casino.  The buffet restaurant was good for dinner and very well priced.  You can also get a reduced rate by getting a membership to the hotel as well (which is free).The location is definitely not within walking distance to the Strip at all and other than the hotel, there is not much around the local area.  Saying that, the hotel does have a range of restaurants, bars, activities and even shops.

reviews.title: Good location for a conference
reviews.text: Hotel has convenient access to Interstate and Las Vegas Boulevard, but without traffic congestion. Convenient parking. Meeting rooms were flexible and well-suited to accommodate large or small gatherings. Staff handled well the refreshments and food service needs of meetings and banquets..

reviews.title: Great Value, location and no parking fees!
reviews.text: This is an excellent hotel. It has all the amenities and the rooms are very spacious and kept up. The bathroom is 2 separate rooms. There is a coffee maker in the room as well. No parking fees and it's close to the strip. Large casino, many restaurants to choose from and large pool area. Very quiet in the guest rooms.

reviews.title: Brilliant
reviews.text: My wife and I stayed here for 2 sets of 2 and 3 nightsIn between went to a conference and Grand Canyon The staff at reception are so friendly Valet parking helpful We had a fabulous stayPlenty of choice Thank you South Point

reviews.title: Excellent Hotel - great value
reviews.text: We stayed here for a few nights whilst visiting Las Vegas, check in was very quick and the reception lobby is very impressive as it leads straight onto the casino floor. The front car park is huge but fills up very quickly in the evening. This may be due to the casino itself but also possibly due to the 16 screen cinema complex located here. We were given a room on the 22nd floor and were surprised that we had to drag our own bags through a very very large casino hall, right to the back of the property to where the lifts are located. Dragging wheeled luggage and hand luggage across thick carpet isn't easy. This to me is a very strange set up. However, there are lots of lifts and it doesn't take too long for one to arrive. The rooms themselves are a very nice size and looked fresh. bed was super comfy and large. We had a front view across the huge flat roof onto the parking lot. if you need snacks or have forgotten anything there is a gift shop / mini mart on the ground floor along with coffee shops, cafe, a Krispy Kremes and other food outlets. This place has it all! We were disappointed by what we were told was a courtesy bus that never arrived after waiting 45mins and we had to Uber it into the Strip. Taxis were asking a lot of money for what was a 15 minute journey ($37-45) and we paid the Uber guy $12 for the same trip - to Mandalay Bay. We booked this hotel through booking.com and had a great room rate $66 per night and the rooms were being advertised at the hotel for $200 per night. So a bargain using the app. The hotel is very close to the South side Designer Outlets and there are also restaurants and coffee shops here too. This journey in the car was 5 mins. The hotel has a number of entry points so just remember which one you need and use the same one - this place is so big its easy to get confused and then you'll have a long walk to the reception lobby. Wifi is free, strong and uninterrupted.The room has an iron and board, safe and a tv. Wardrobe had plenty of space with hangers and bathroom was well equipped.

reviews.title: Good Location, value for money
reviews.text: We booked this a hotel for a very good price through booking.com for three days. The hotel is close enough to the strip to be there in a matter of minutes. The hotel offers a shuttle service three times a day but the once that we tried to use it, it never arrived and we booked an Uber instead which  cost about $13.There's a lot to do in the hotel itself like bowling gambling or watching a movie. There are also plenty of coffee shops and snack bars in the hotel. The staff were very quick for check in and check out and friendly. There is lots of parking on site for free. We had room on the 22nd floor which had views of the strip. The hotel also has a swimming pool which looked amazing but unfortunately we didn't get tie to use it instead we wondered off to the shopping outlets five minutes down the road.

reviews.title: Huge Complex that needs attention to detail
reviews.text: We were staying at the Southpoint for a conference. We were told we could check in at 12 and then upon arrival we were told the room would not be ready until 3. Ok we were in a casino so we went to grab lunch and check out the resort.  There are several restaurants but only a couple were open for lunch. Looking at all the menus though we came to the conclusion that the hotel must think it has a captive audience because it is so far off the strip that it can charge huge prices for what I consider medium to fair food.  Going back to desk to check in at 3 and we were told another hour. Geez Louise. So the next day I had a pedicure scheduled.  I arrived and the lady was there ready for me. She seemed personable. I have had years of mani- pedis.  I was somewhat confused by the steps this person took. She first removed and then applied my polish (gel). Then she soaked my feet and exfoliated my skin so hard that I had actual sores form.  In my opinion this was the absolute worst pedicure I have ever had. The rest of our trip was blah and I spent most of my time just sitting at their pool. That is until a boys wrestling conference started and all of the kids and their puffed up parents arrived and over crowded the pool area. By Thursday we checked out and moved to the Venetian.

reviews.title: Love this hotel casino
reviews.text: Two weeks stay great room floor 24 overlooking the pool,good check in with a pleasant smile from the desk gaming was good a great sports book and hot dogs $1.25 each brilliant,buffet brunch with mimosas unlimited with great food even put your beef on the grill when asked been staying here for the past 7years and always had a great time with all that work there and the pool is large with plenty of sun beds!

reviews.title: Away from strip
reviews.text: This hotel is away from the strip making it easier to weave out of traffic. Rooms are big and equipped with a fridge upon request (extra charge per night). Didn’t like the smoky smell of walking to and from restaurants.

reviews.title: Great Value for Your Money
reviews.text: Our room was on the 10th floor. We enjoyed it because it was very quiet. We had a great view of the sun risoing very morning. We ate everyday at the Coronado. Great food, great service and friendly staff.

reviews.title: South Point Hotel Hits High Review
reviews.text: I loved all this hotel had to offer from Krispy Kreme Doughnuts to bowling or a movie right on site especially if you are traveling with kids under 21. The food was good too, calamari was probably best I have had at little place right inside casino I cant remember the name of it.

reviews.title: Hard to beat
reviews.text: For those who value the entertainment part of a stay, the South Point Hotel Casino and Spa is hard to beat. Families will definitely find ways to enjoy their stay, plus adults on their own can try their luck on the huge Bingo hall that offers lucrative games throughout the day. Drinks are on the house, of course, honoring the old Vegas tradition intended to keep all kinds of gamblers on the happy side, or should I add the inebriated side, for a tipsy gambler is more open to try winning more often. Families can enjoy the swimming pool in those hot days, which are plenty. Movies are big deals on their theater, which boasts like 16 screens? All latest releases available some times at bargain prices, and who among us doesn’t like a good movie (who amI kidding here? Once inside is rather tempting to catch an extra show! Sshhh what happens in Vegas, you know...), there are all kinds of events going on such as Rodeos, Comedy Shows, and do not pass on the huge Bowling center where after midnight cost very little to play. The reason i give it 4 Stars instead of 5 is because of some limitations on their dining deals, which can and should improve specially on the Buffet sometimes. Not to say that a person can not eat to their heart’s content. Rooms are adequate with in room safes available. Sometimes one doesn’t have to leave the property to have a good time. 4 Stars.

reviews.title: Father’s Day Gateway
reviews.text: Spent the weekend here.  Spacious deluxe king size room.  Bathroom was spacious too.  Only drawback was the towels were of lower quality than them the hotel classification (4.5 Star)And there was limited quantities.  They should at least provide 3 towels each instead of two for the king size rooms.  Love their restaurants and the price was reasonable and brings back memories of Vegas once upon a time when Vegas meals were around $3 - $4 for NY Strip Steak😄.

reviews.title: Lots to offer!
reviews.text: Wide variety of things to do right inside Casino. Conveniently located off strip. Comfy rooms. Responsive staff. Big pool areas. Many restaurants to pick from - coffee houses to FABULOUS deli to fine dining.

reviews.title: Bachelorette trip
reviews.text: Perfect place to stay.  Spacious clean rooms!  Restaurant options are fantastic. The pool is nice.  Time at the spa is a must and I highly recommend a massage.  This is my 5th stay at South Point and have never been disappointed--well minus the bad luck at the casino :)

reviews.title: A city within a city
reviews.text: Clean rooms, efficient and friendly staff. Complimentary valet for vehicle and room. Many amenities, 11 restaurants especially the excellent buffet. Only drawback is no refrigerator in our room. Do have some rooms with them. Situated away from the strip. Was not expensive for the room, do have resort fee.

reviews.title: Love everything about this hotel!
reviews.text: We love NASCAR and this is the best place to stay during a race weekend or just anytime.  Great restaurant choices.  Rooms are nice and clean.  Easy parking.  Nice location with free shuttle to the Strip.  No complaints.  Planning on staying again this October.

reviews.title: Strange Feeling... Not good or bad
reviews.text: We needed a place to stay for one night and the prices were pretty good for the evening and we always wanted to give South Point a try. We did and I don't know what to think. Parking and check-in were easy as well as finding the room. The room was big and clean albeit a view of a wall, literally. We didn't eat here, but food looked okay. The hotel just had a strange feeling. Maybe the color scheme or layout. The pool was okay, nothing great but clean. Something just felt off and we couldn't relax. Much different feeling than staying on strip.

reviews.title: Love this hotel!
reviews.text: Very clean! Spacious rooms! Many delicious food selections! Large variety entertainment within the hotel! Friendly staff! Beautiful pool! Nice views! Large and clean fitness room! Relaxing hot tub! Insulated walls (can not here others in next room)

reviews.title: Very Nice Hotel and Casino
reviews.text: Stayed here just one night in May because it was close to the airport and we were leaving the next day after a trip to the Grand Canyon.  It was about 5 miles south of the main hotels on the Strip.   The hotel and casino were bigger than I expected and it was fairly crowded. The room was huge and had all of the amenities.  Ate at the buffet after joining their club to get the $4 a person discount.  Couldn't use any of the discounts in the coupon book and they were a waste.  The buffet was excellent and had anything you could ever want, including oysters on the half shell.  I believe the price we paid with the discount was $15.99.  The breakfast the next morning at the 24 hour café was good and very reasonably priced.  The casino was great and no problem finding a $5 blackjack table.  We both played for about two hours and between us won a grand total of $6.50 which we were just pleased to come out ahead.  The check-in was easy and everyone at the casino was very nice.

reviews.title: Reasonable resort fee
reviews.text: I stayed one night at the South Point casino and hotel. If you are flying in there’s a shuttle, but it stops running at 9:30 pm,  and you need to make reservations in advance. The staff from what I experienced are all very friendly. The room was Spacious, and the bed was comfortable. If you like breakfast the Coronado restaurant runs a special from Midnight to 6:00 am (don’t be late) Last and probably least among other resorts,the resort fees are only 21 dollars a day. I will definitely stay again.

reviews.title: Great time at the South Point!
reviews.text: A great place to stay about 10 minutes south of the crowded Vegas strip. Rooms are very clean and spacious. Plenty or room in the casino. The staff was great! The pool was fantastic! You could go out there ant time of day and get a couple nice lounge chairs and a cool drink and relax.  We also enjoyed a day in the Spa which was fantastic. The Del Mar Deli located in the casino had great sandwiches and the food over all was good. I definitely recommend this place forn a more relaxed visit to Vegas....oh yes free shuttle to and from the airport!

reviews.title: relaxed and friendly
reviews.text: We stayed off-strip and decided to check this place out - glad we did.  We only went in to do a little gambling and found the staff very friendly and the overall environment pretty relaxed.  It was nice to have free parking right out front and a very clean casino.  Definitely recommend this place if you are south of the strip and looking for some relaxed gambling fun.

reviews.title: Pleasantly surprised!  Great place to stay....
reviews.text: We stayed at this casino for a wrestling tournament.  The wrestling venue was amazing. It has a very friendly staff.  Maid service was excellent.  We really enjoyed the buffet especially the Mongolian style grilling station.  The movie theatre was a bonus after a busy night it was fun to catch a good movie.  Was a located about 5 miles from the main strip so the drive took a little time.  The pool was very nice, bar prices were decent.  Would recommend this casino for a quieter Las Vegas vacation.

reviews.title: Las Vegas with Commotion Optional
reviews.text: South Point is about 15 minutes away from the Strip and this is a blessing. All it took was one visit to the Flamingo to see a show and we gladly skedaddled back to the hotel. There's an equestrian center (yes, horses), a bowling alley, a spa, pool and fitness center as well as places to eat and snack. Bars and a casino go without saying. All this wouldn't be so great if everything was outlandishly priced, because it could be. They were reasonable for the area and perhaps less expensive in some ways. (Not sure.) We would not go back to Vegas, but we would definitely go back to South Point.

reviews.title: New Premium grade rooms are worth the price
reviews.text: The hotel is currently in the midst of a conversion, to upgrade existing "Deluxe" grade rooms from the 24th floor and working on down gradually to lower floors, to convert rooms to the new "Premium" grade room category.  They gradually began the conversion process at the beginning of the year in the first two of the three towers that comprise the hotel.  Towers 1 and 2 (which run North and South, and are parallel to Interstate 15 and Las Vegas Blvd.) have had the conversion completed.  Tower three's conversion is to take place over the Summer.  I had the opportunity to one of the first few guests that were allowed to be booked into the new "Premium" room category over the past Memorial Day Holiday weekend.  When you open the door to a Premium room, the first thing you are pleasantly greeted by is the dark wooden flooring instead of carpeting.  Also, to match the room's wooden floors, the furniture is also new in a much darker wood grain.  The furniture pieces are all dark brown, withdark brown or black painted finishes such as around the mirror or around the bed sconces.  The typical settee next to the beds has been replaced with a rich, cream colored leather highback chairs and a foot stool.  I liked the new dressor drawers at the foot of the bed, because it not only had ample and deep drawer space, but now the center drawers conveniently conceal a small working refrigerator (which in the standard "Deluxe" rooms is an option, at $15 per night).  The bathroom sink and vanity areas also got an upgraded bronze- colored lighted and adjustable make-up mirror, new hair dryer that has a circular holder that also doubles as a circular l.e.d. night light, as well as a new vanity mirror with darker wood accents.  The high speed room internet service (which is one of the many benefits included in the $21/day resort fee assessed) was easy to connect to, and was reliable and fast.  Right now, depending upon the season and day of the week, these new Premium room categories are only (on average) an additional $20 per night than the Deluxe rooms.  Its worth the price for a higher floor room as well as having a refrigerator in the room.

reviews.title: Fun
reviews.text: This hotel is awesome. Everything you need for a family vacation is there. Movies, bowling, bingo, restaurants, and casinos. The staff are friendly and carando cafe prime rib is the best. I will definitely stay again.

reviews.title: More Value..........
reviews.text: This hotel is far from the strip, but has everything the strip has. Great prices, clean spacious rooms, many different resturants for every taste. Wonderful service at check in Bell Service, Valet........now the bad.......The bartenders at ALL the bars are lethargic, slow, hang with the locals, in other words they are pitiful. I could have gone behind the bar and made my own drink and I don't thing anybody would notice.......

reviews.title: Best in Vegas
reviews.text: Just excellent Hotel and Casino. Superior personnel through out. Plenty places to eat, drink, be merry and play and the slot machines pay. Love, love love this venue! There is ample parking. Check in and check out is a breeze. It's far enough from all the traffic on the Strip and close enough to get there in minutes.

reviews.title: Jerry
reviews.text: Had a great time; even won some money.  South Point has an awesome array of gaming machines.  Video Keno is our game of choice and they are spread throughout the casino.  We ate at the Big Sur seafood restaurant, unbelievably delicious.  We will definitely return to South Point!

reviews.title: Perfect in every way
reviews.text: We have been coming to Vegas for thirty years and have stayed in most of the hotels/casinos. This is now the only hotel which we stay in. This hotel/casino goes out of its way to make the visitor feel welcome and appreciated. Not the usual 'take it or leave it' attitude from the strip hotels now adopt. We wholeheartedly recommend it to all who visit Vegas

reviews.title: Great resort with lower resort fees.
reviews.text: Very nice hotel & casino. Lots of restaurants including a great buffet reasonably priced, cant beat it!! Located on LV Blvd a few miles south of the airport but right off Interstate 15 so if you want to get to the central strip it takes only a few minutes. Southpoint also has a beautiful pool. Friendly staff throughout the resort.

reviews.title: Great hotel
reviews.text: I really liked this hotel.  I had initially booked the hotel for an extended stay for a equine event which unfortunately was cancelled.  However, I decided to stay one night anyway for business, and the reservations agent made it very easy to make the change, no hassle!  I definitely appreciated it.  My room was very clean, and spacious.  I used the fitness facility which was open 24 hours (thank goodness!  So tired of those hotels that seem to think people only work out between 9-6 pm!) and nicely equipped.  And the restaurant I chose had excellent service, huge portion, and a comfortable vibe.  Finally, parking was free!  I will definitely stay at the hotel again.

reviews.title: 2 week trip
reviews.text: We have stayed here before, and spend a lot of time here during the NFR, because this is where it all happens during that  time.  The rooms are clean and quiet, but they are starting to show some wear, they are needing to upgrade the rooms. But as always it is a fun place to stay with the gaming, places to eat.

reviews.title: Still decent
reviews.text: I've stayed here many times over the years.  I personally don't care for staying in casinos but this one is a different experience than the mega-casinos on the strip.  It's worth staying here and was a good experience.

reviews.title: Stay overnight, nothing outstanding
reviews.text: We were on the way to San Diego. The room we had was spacious but not very much different than a regular hotel. We had to walk through the casino area in order to assess to accommodation area. The hotel is far away from the strip, so if you are not visiting Las Vegas, you can avoid all the traffic on the strip and leave the city easily. Gas station is nearby, gas up then go.

reviews.title: Shuttle and facilities were as expected---good
reviews.text: The shuttles from the airport were good, the overall facility is very Las Vegas. You walk into a casino which is busy. South Point is full of bowling lanes, movie theatres, stages for shows, and 13 Restaurants. There is a $21.00 Resort fee for the WI-FI, shuttles etc..Huge complex, but it was enjoyable and room was very quiet. Would stay here again.

reviews.title: 5-day stay
reviews.text: Stayed here for a work conference in April. Very nice facility for this. Large conference rooms with great a availability. Ate primarily at the garden buffet, which was good. Overall stay was good, only drawback is the remoteness of the hotel. About 14 miles +/- from the hotel to downtown.

reviews.title: Another relaxing week at South Point
reviews.text: We have stayed at South Point every other year since it opened as South Coast.  Our experience has ALWAYS been one of excellent service and value for our dollars.  We value knowing our stay will always be a great one....and value NOT having to worry about... well... everything involved in staying at a different property.  Parking valet, luggage delivery, check in, housekeeping, casino, cafe staff, steak house staff, ..... in every instance where South Coast personnel were involved, service was delivered with courtesy and a smile.  How nice it is to have everyone greet us as if they were glad for us to be there.Aside fromt the one small disappointment of the food quality at that buffet (which we felt had slipped a bit... or they were just having a bad day).... everything was 5 stars during this trip.We look forward to our next visit... and...now that we're retired, we'll perhaps change our frequency of trips to once per year.  We're not sure we want to wait 2 years to return.

reviews.title: Fun at South Point
reviews.text: Excellent value. Great staff. Great selection of slots and table games. Arcade, bowling alley, movie theaters, fine dining and a pool. Family friendly. Also offers entertainment for the adults like shows.

reviews.title: Great place for a massage
reviews.text: *This review is specifically for the spa services at South Point.* When I am in town and I have the time, I schedule an appointment with Cynthia at the Spa at South Point. I have had many massages and, by far, she is the best massage therapist I have visited. She is thoughtful, professional and friendly. I have really tight shoulders so I always ask massage therapists to target that area. Not only was she responsive to my needs, she really was knowledgeable on how to loosen up that problem area. Afterwards, you can enjoy the spa and all the amenities which is an added bonus. Thanks Cynthia!

reviews.title: Mini Vacation
reviews.text: The room was large enough to be comfortable ... the a/c did not cool very well... the noise from construction woke us up every morning ... maid did not replace incidentals on a daily basis ... staff were friendly and helpful ... slots no better nor worse than others ...Food at the Coronado Cafe was awful !   Best mode of transportation is Uber, definitely !!!

reviews.title: Big Resort with a lot of options
reviews.text: My family of 7 recently stayed at South Point Hotel for a cheer competition being held in the arena. There was plenty of room in the arena, and the hotel/casino was very spacious.  I use a mobility scooter and had plenty of room to maneuver about. The pool was nice, although it was incredibly windy while we were there so we didn't stay in the pool for long.  There was a wide variety of food options, the buffet was decent with a lot of options, the desserts were very tasty, not your everyday puddings and ice cream. The beds were roomy and I appreciated the accessible shower in my room.  Valet was fast and efficient.  The Bowling Alley's snack bar was our best bet for breakfast.  Their bagel sandwiches were HUGE and fresh made.  Affordable food that filled you up.

reviews.title: Cheap Hotel
reviews.text: South point.This hotel is a long way from the strip and it appears to be wholly  aimed at gamblers.There is no foyer as such, you enter straight into the casino where you are met with half dressed hostesses with there buttocks showing covered only by thin black tights. Not a sight for young children in my opinion, there were a lot there!The hotel is enormous and it takes you a while to get to the rooms. It also has a lot of other facilities, a bowling alley etc. what ch we did not use.The food in the restaurant was ample and the waiting staff varied from very helpful to the opposite.I have requested a room with a roll in shower and adjustable height bed (they have them in  the Mandalay Bay) so we went to our room.The bed was not adjustable and was far too high. The bathroom had a roll in shower but the lip of the shower intruded in front of the sink so it was difficult to reach the sink on my mobility scooter.Secondly the shower hose was not adjustable so my partner had to hold the shower at my level in order for me to was and there were not enough grab rails.The light n the bathroom was very poor.The pool area was lovely.I would not choose to stay here again!

reviews.title: Spacious, Accessible, and Convenient from the Airport
reviews.text: This hotel provides complimentary shuttle service from the airport near which it is conveniently located--not too far or close.  Guest parking is convenient, too, and the hotel also provides valet service.  The restaurants, cafes, rooms, and casino floor were expansive.  The casino and restaurants were busy, but never seemed congested, and we were there on the weekend.  This is a family-friendly hotel well-suited for casual vacationing, but it is not within walking distance to the Strip.

reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: Stayed here from April 22-27 for the 10th time and as always had an excellent stay. Funny enough a lot of hits on the penny slots and none on other denominations.As a cigar smoker  I preferred to sit outside and enjoy my cigar. Bummed out that they don’t allow smoking in sports book but allow cigarette s.

reviews.title: Love it here.
reviews.text: Best casino in Las Vegas! Love everything about this place! The only casino that actually caters and take cares of their customers. Much respect to this casino and their staff. Every restaurant and bar has friendly staff and service. It's great place for locals, pai gow, bowling and sports books are my favorite there! Of course the oyster bar as well. Always looking forward for another visit.. Enjoyed our stay and always will be staying here.

reviews.title: Great Venue off the Strip
reviews.text: The South Point is a great venue for family or business. The hotel has a pool, hot tub, theaters, bowling and a dozen dining options with diverse cuisine and prices for a variety of needs. The rooms are over sized, clean and comfortable.

reviews.title: If it were not so smoky I would have played much more.
reviews.text: This place is a busy, local smoke filled casino. The pool is nice and large as is the hot tub. Hot tub is adults only. Of course there are rude parents who feel that they can bring their infant to the adult only local. Not cool and rather rude of the parents. But keep in mind this is a cheap local hotel with nothing else to do but gamble or hang by the pool. The fish restaurant in the middle of the casino is good. Go there.And like all the other places without telling me upon check in , I learned upon check out that they tacked on a $21.00 nightly resort fee. Again I ask, how can I use your resort or consider it fair when your teaser rate reflects almost a 50 percent resort fee.Enoug. Include the fee with the rate. I will feel less nickel and dimed.Hats off the Esteban at the front desk for placing me in a perfect quite room.

reviews.title: Enjoying the South Point
reviews.text: We thoroughly enjoyed our recent stay at the South Point and are scheduled to return in Nov. 2018. Am looking forward to staying in an upgraded room. Enjoy early morning coffee and love the ice cream service. The cafe is very nice, my husband looks forward to the daily specials.

reviews.title: first time here,not my last !
reviews.text: really enjoyed my stay, poker room,sportsbook, in- house entertainment, very good ! casino bars were all outstanding,priceing on food(restaurants and buffet),were reasonable and the quality of the food very good.

reviews.title: Love Southpoint
reviews.text: We love staying at South Point. The rooms are spacious and comfortable and very affordable. The hotel has a movie theatre, bowling, casino, and a Steak & Shake as well as several other restaurants. The coupons you get are also very generous. If you have a car this is a great affordable place to stay off strip with lots to do inside the resort.

reviews.title: Fantastic!
reviews.text: I cannot say enough about the friendly professional staff and high quality facilities at the South Point Casino and Spa.  Food, gaming and amenities were all top-notch. Parking and shuttle services were great.  Very impressed.

reviews.title: Ok hotel, great staff
reviews.text: 4 couples stayed here 3 nights. 3 got standard rooms & we got a junior suite.ROOMS:The suite was spacious but had coffemaker only. No microwave, fridge, etc. the bathroom was quite large with a garden tub- no jets though. The towels, toiletries, bedding, etc were mediocre. & the TVs needed to be bigger. The bed was very firm.POOL: the pool area was good- the pool had different offshoots to provide separate areas instead of being in one big square pool. There were no shade umbrellas though. There was a bar/snack area but we never saw roving waiters.BUFFET: at check in we got a coupon book which had half off the buffet so we tried it. I liked the salad bar but the hot food was mediocre. My husband said it was the worst vegas buffet he has ever had.LOCATION: this hotel is several miles south of the main strip area. There is a shuttle you can book to get there but it is $12 a person round trip. We found it cheaper & easier to take uber. There is a movie theater & bowling alley here but we didn’t patronize them. The staff was great though. I called housekeeping twice for items & they responded promptly.Overall unless you are attending an event here I don’t see the draw of staying here.

reviews.title: They have it all
reviews.text: They have a movie theatre, bowling, etc.....Its all here. Only problem is distance to downtown Las Vegas. With traffic it took up to 35 minutes to get into town for the Beatles show at the Mirage for a 9:30 show. They raised the shuttle price so I drove in. This is my 3rd time staying here. They need to update rooms since they are now charging resort fees

reviews.title: VERY NICE PROPERTY
reviews.text: The first thing I noticed when I walked into this hotel is how fresh,clean and modern it was. The parking was excellent and easy to get to. The service and servers where friendly and attentive. The gaming floor was spacious and the sports book was excellent. The food and beverage prices were inline with other hotels.This an exceptional off strip hotel and I would certainly visit this hotel again.

reviews.title: Great place a little out of town
reviews.text: We saved some money and had a couple of nights here before moving up to a luxury property on The Strip.We loved it and didn't mind the short drive up to the end of the main Strip. This is a lovely hotel and casino. The staff are great. The room we had, high up could not be faulted and we had a great view looking south.We thoroughly enjoyed our stay here and will be back! Recommended.

reviews.title: Friendly staff and well kept property
reviews.text: I had a five night stay at South Point for business.  I had gambled here before but never stayed here.  The room was  perfectly satisfactory. Housekeeping did a great job. If I were to nit pick I would wish for a larger TV with more channels, but not a big issue.  I'd also wish for a refrigerator, but I heard those are coming in more rooms this Spring.  Every staff member at the South Point I talked to told me how much they like working for the Gaughan family.  It's nice to stay at a place where the staff knows the owner instead of it being some mega corporation.There's a nice compliment of restaurants on site.  You could do worse than just sticking around for your meals.  Everything from Steak 'n Shake to seafood to Asian to prime rib.Given the reasonable room rates here, this is a good option. Especially if you have a car.  If you are without a vehicle the distance to the heart of the strip might be an issue.  But the Uber fares weren't as much as out would have cost to park at the major resorts.The complex also includes bowling lanes, a movie theater, and an equestrian arena.

reviews.title: HORRIBLE CUSTOMER SERVICE
reviews.text: Excuses EXCUSES.... stayed here and were never told that we were given a room with a WALL VIEW!!!! Customer service desk could HAVE WARNED US AND ASKED IF WE WANTED A DIFFERENT ROOM FOR A HIGHER PRICE... but she didn’t. So I paid the same for a room with a view. I of course called and had us moved rooms!! In the “NEW ROOM” the shower faucet was BROKEN the service man cane repaired some of it so that we had water with low pressure very low pressure and said it would take an HOUR TO repair it correctly - we couldn’t wait as we had somewhere to go... we tried to iron and the IRON WAS BROKEN!!!! upon checking out and PAYING FOR ALL THIS NONSENSE.... I let the supervisor know and she apologize and stated that the HOTEL/RESORT SPA IS OLD AND IN NEED OF MANY REPAIRS... she CHARGED ME AND SAID “HAVE A WONDERFUL DAY”!!!  THANKS FOR A GREAT EXPERIENCE AFTER GAMBLIMG THERE EATING THERE STAYING THERE AND ALL WE GOT WAS “SORRY THIS PLACE IS OLD”

reviews.title: Nice Place to Stay
reviews.text: The rooms are  a little older considering the carpet and all otherwise just needs a little better maintenance.  They moved me from a room facing a wall to the 25th floor for a small fee.  Turned out to be a two-room suite.  I could have fit 50 people in this room.  Food at the buffet was good, the prime rib restaurant was excellent with good prices.  The casino was very crowded, but good for them.  Free shuttle service but you MUST make a reservation.  Nice pool area.

reviews.title: Southpoint is great!!
reviews.text: First time at this hotel. It was great, no parking or valet fees. Rooms were great, had a living room, bedroom and bathroom. Shower was great. The hotel had 11 restaurants, work out room, pool, bowling, theater, arena. One stop shop if you didn't want to leave the premises. I would recommend to anyone staying in Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Should have been called Smokey Point instead
reviews.text: I understand that smoking is allowed in the casino only but first of all, you need to walk through the fog there no matter where you want to go. And their ventilation system is not capable of keeping the smoke limited to that area only. Bottom line, attending a 5 day conference with allergies flaring up all the time. But I guess that’s what you get for $69/night. The room was nice and big, though.

reviews.title: Decent
reviews.text: The positives:- Breakfast Buffet was reasonably priced with a good selection.- Drink prices were moderate- Pool was clean- Room was largeThe not-so-positives:- Bathroom wallpaper was peeling- Was told by staff there was no shuttle to The Strip, but other reviewers said they took the shuttle.- WiFi (that was charged for in the Resort Fee) was unreliable.  I gave up and used my data.Hotel is located 10-15 minute drive from The Strip.  This can be good or bad, depending on your perspective.

reviews.title: A great stay
reviews.text: This was our first stay at South Point. We were looking for the Vegas-experience without paying the high prices on the strip—SP turned out to be the perfect solution. We found the room very comfortable and quiet. The pool was really nice and the majority of the restaurants were pretty good at a reasonable price. The casino was decent size. Additionally, it was only about a 10-minute ride or so to get to the strip. My only “ding” is that the hotel shuttle to the strip seemed a bit pricey ($14/day/person). Other than that, I have no complaints, as we really enjoyed our stay. We definitely recommend SP and would gladly stay there again.

reviews.title: Reasonably priced, good sleep but far and smoky
reviews.text: This is a hotel casino located away from the Strip (15 minutes driving). Like many hotel casinos the lobby is noisy, rowdy, crowded and smoky. I would have liked it if the reception area was separate from the game floor so you could avoid the crowd and the smoke. Unfortunately, that is not the case. Fortunately, the rooms are away from the noise and very quiet. I found the room to be very spacious, clean and comfortable. My king size bed was large, clean and comfortable. The room came with a standard flat TV, refrigerator and good Wi-Fi coverage. Large windows bringing in plenty of sun lights as well as the view of faraway mountains. The shower was decent, clean and well equipped. My only complaint is the amount of smoking all over the lobby and the gambling floor. The hotel also offers several bars (some equipped with slot machines) and restaurants. They have a breakfast buffet which is worth trying using the voucher coupon they offer when you check-in. Over all it is reasonable if you don’t mind being away from the Strip for a short period of time.

reviews.title: Great Property
reviews.text: Went for two nights comped.  Really quiet room given the young crowd at the event center.  Room was really nice and clean.  Nice view to the strip.  Great service at check in and check out.  Pool area was really nice and couples spa is worth it.  We stuck to the buffet when we did not leave to go out to eat.  Love the free parking but definitely needs EV charging.

reviews.title: Out of the way
reviews.text: The hotel itself is nice and reasonably priced but it’s nowhere near the strip or anything else fun for that matter. The pool is nice and has s few decent restaurants.We only stayed here due to a convention there but would never stay here if it wasn’t work related. Far better options out there.

reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text: My latest stay was April 19-25,2018. The Hotel is generally pretty well maintained and clean very important to a frequent traveler. The staff is friendly and generally helpful. The purpose of my stay was for business.  Some of the properties down falls are the casino area's ventilation is poor and full of cigarette smoke. It was not always like this. The second strike is poor food quality. There are much better places to eat. During my recent stay the hotel had a water problem which I am not blaming them for because things break. However the way that it was handled with the guest in effected rooms left a lot to be desired. I woke up to no water not seeing the notice thrown on the floor stating that they had to make a repair from 1:00 am to 5:00 am. Of course as when you repair things it doesn't always go as planned, again not the hotels fault.I called the front desk and was told by the hotel operator that they were short staffed and the desk couldn't take my call this was at 7:00 am . No shower no teeth brushing that morning right before a business presentation. I went to the front desk and was told instead of being offered a room that had water to shower was told we are waving the resort fee which by the way is a scam to make money and provides no value. I ask to speak to the GM and was givien  women's name who was not the GM but represented herself as the GM. Upon researching on line found that she was in fact not the GM. And long story short she was unprofessional and not in the least sympathetic or even apologetic. They new enough to place notices in the room with the normal  housekeeping duties but they didn't move guest or leave a message on the phone in the room. The long and short of this is there are plenty of good hotels in Las Vegas with much better customer service. Also my tube was left with dirty water on the last night of my stay, I guess a remnant of the water problem. I generally don't leave reviews like this however the hotel was unresponsive so this hotel should be avoided.

reviews.title: Another Wonderful Stay At South Point
reviews.text: Began staying here in 2016 and have never been disappointed. The entire staff is very accommodating.  The rooms are large with great amenities.  Pool area is terrific.  There are a variety good variety of restaurants for every taste.  We especially like Don Vito's. We celebrated my wife's birthday there and Roxanne and Francesco gave us excellent service.  Free shuttle to and from the airport is great.  I could go on and on about how nice South Point is.  It's not downtown or in the action, but it is a wonderful, accommodating and relaxing hotel.  Won't stay anywhere else when we go to Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Plush mattresses??
reviews.text: They advertise plush mattresses. FAR from it!!  The mattresses are AWFUL.  I have slept on better than these a discount motel chains!!!   This is our first night here so far the food has been good.  Hard to get over this board I am currently laying on and already prepaid for for the next 3 nights.

reviews.title: Shelly  was wonderful
reviews.text: Shelly was wonderful she helped above and beyond the elevator is too hard for someone with disabilities.The restaurants were good. the gambling was good but couldn't get into the poker room without a long wait.

reviews.title: Nice.  Ok not great for vegas
reviews.text: South Point is the southern most hotel before the strip I believe.  They do have a shuttle to the strip I didn't try it so can't comment. Parking is plenty so no worries with free valet and self park available.Rooms are ok. Clean and good TV and no complaints. Casino is fine not huge but has most what u want.But I have to say blackjack dealers are generally not the happiest people. They all just seemed to have attitudes especially last night April 21.Internet is horrible.  It works ok when u are in a room but everywhere u go u have to sign in again to another wifi like pool, bar, poker room, etc.  really a pain if U need internet access.Facility is quite nice with bowling, horse center, 11 restaurants, sports book, etcNegative is not on strip. For sure car ride.Getting drinks while gambling is also a problem. Very slow service stinks.  Playing $25 tables and always waiting for a server.  Not good for players wanting to have a good time with friendsLower price rooms is good

reviews.title: Great quality for a better price than the strip
reviews.text: We stayed on the top floor in a two bedroom suite and it was fantastic. We had a view of the strip and mountains. The rooms were super clean and the beds were comfortable. The bowling alley and movie theater are top notch and super cheap. The cafe food was really good and we could get two meals for less than 20 bucks. The casino was clean and we never had to look for a drink girl. I had a really bad blister and asked the cashier at the gift shop if they had flip flops. They didn't, but they opened the pool gift shop for me so that I could grab some from there. Everyone was super friendly.

reviews.title: First time at South Point and certainly will not be the last time.  Hotel/Casino very open, aerie and welcoming.
reviews.text: First time at South Point and certainly will not be the last time.  Hotel/Casino very open, aerie and welcoming.

reviews.title: AWFUL EXPERIENCE
reviews.text: I was VERY DISAPPOINTED with this hotel. This hotel with 4 stars is a BIG lie.I arrived around 8pm on the first day of my stay. The room and the furniture looked old and I was able to see the dust. The bed was not comfortable.The WORST part of the story was when I uncovered the bed and there was PERIOD BLOOD ON THE BLANKET!!!!WAS SO GORSE!!!!!!My wife and I almost threw up because of what we saw.When I spoke to the manager regarding this matter, he almost made it as it was our fault because they usually clean up the rooms after every stay. The staff including the manager were very rude.They did not offer any compensation except cancelling my reservation even though it was at the end of the day. They also did not care if I leave a bad feedback regarding my stay when I told them that I will do soI had to look for another hotel and paid extra because it was a last min booking.I strongly do not recommend this hotel.

reviews.title: Good for locals
reviews.text: It's a bit of a hike from check-in to the elevators. Several great restaurants and a [pretty good buffet.Rooms are nice and comfortable. Great sports book and bar. There is an arena where various rodeo and equestrian events are held.

reviews.title: The usual Vegas hotel
reviews.text: Lots of gambling, lots of overpriced restaurants.  Hot tub was used by entitlement type young kinds “attended” by parents, needs better rules.  The staff was very courteous, helpful, and attentive.  Plan for meals, places are always busy.

reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.text: This was like an indoor city type of place. Nice rooms and very clean! They had really good food here and cheap prices. It’s a nice size hotel. It’s about 15 minuets away from the strip. I highly recommended this hotel if you want to be away from the strip.

reviews.title: Ok stay
reviews.text: After reading so many reviews about he place and seeing the 4 star rating we decided to book it for a night. The price was decent, parking and WiFi free and room was a good size. However, despite being on a non smoking floor the whole place smelled like smoke. Pool was closed which was disappointing because we were looking forward to it. They charge $30 to use the fitness center for 24 hours. If I had known that there were others hotels in the center of Vegas for the same price and better amenities & location I would have definitely booked somewhere else. But this was our first visit to Las Vegas.

reviews.title: VERY UNFAIR
reviews.text: To play the "super gala bingo" is impossible.
